Pomogę Ci wgrać firmware na ESP. Zanim dam Ci instrukcje, muszę sprawdzić konfigurację Twojego projektu.  Widzę, że masz projekt ESP32-S3, ale brakuje Ci kluczowego pliku **`platformio.ini`**. To jest właśnie problem! Bez niego PlatformIO nie wie jaką płytkę zainstalować.

## Szybkie kroki:

### 1. **Utwórz plik `platformio.ini`** w katalogu `firmware`

Tworzę go dla Ciebie teraz: ### 2. **Ustal port USB Twojej ESP**

W PowerShell uruchom:
```powershell
Get-WmiObject Win32_SerialPort | Select-Object Name, Description, DeviceID
```

Pokaże Ci coś jak `COM3` lub `COM4`. Znajdź port dla "Silicon Labs CP210x" lub "CH340" (zależy od płytki).

### 3. **Zmień port w `platformio.ini`**

Jeśli masz inny port (np. `COM4`), zmień tę linię:
```
upload_port = COM3  ← zmień na swój port
```

### 4. **Wgraj firmware**

W VS Code (przy instalowanym PlatformIO extension):
- Kliknij ikonę **Alien** 👽 po lewej
- Rozwiń swój projekt
- Kliknij **Upload** 

Lub w terminalu PlatformIO:
```bash
platformio run --target upload
```

**Jeśli to nie działa**, powiedz mi jaki błąd widzisz, a pomogę. 🚀

Doskonale! 🎉 Twoja ESP jest na porcie **COM3**.

To jest dokładnie port, który już wstawiłem w `platformio.ini`, więc konfiguracja jest gotowa!

## Teraz możesz wgrać firmware:

### Opcja A: Z VS Code (najprościej)
1. Zainstaluj rozszerzenie **PlatformIO IDE** (jeśli jeszcze nie masz)
2. Podłącz ESP32-S3 kablem USB
3. Kliknij ikonę **Alien 👽** na lewym pasku
4. Rozwiń `esp32-s3-devkitc-1`
5. Kliknij **Upload** ⬆️

### Opcja B: Z terminala
```powershell
cd j:\inkubator\firmware
pio run --target upload
```

Po wgraniu będziesz widać komunikaty. Jeśli wszystko będzie OK, pojawi się `✓`:

```
Leaving...
Hard resetting via RTS pin...
```

**Masz pytania albo błędy?** Podaj mi całą wiadomość błędu z terminala 📋

// Helper: pobierz harmonogram dla gatunku
const IncubationDay* get_schedule(const char* species, int& out_days) {
  if (strcmp(species, "CHICKEN") == 0 || strcmp(species, "🐔") == 0) {
    out_days = 21;
    return SCHEDULE_CHICKEN;
  } else if (strcmp(species, "DUCK") == 0 || strcmp(species, "🦆") == 0) {
    out_days = 28;
    return SCHEDULE_DUCK;
  } else if (strcmp(species, "GOOSE") == 0 || strcmp(species, "🦢") == 0) {
    out_days = 30;
    return SCHEDULE_GOOSE;
  } else if (strcmp(species, "QUAIL") == 0 || strcmp(species, "🐦") == 0) {
    out_days = 17;
    return SCHEDULE_QUAIL;
  }
  // Default
  out_days = 21;
  return SCHEDULE_CHICKEN;
}

// ⭐ NOWY ENDPOINT: Reboot urządzenia
void handle_api_reboot() {
  if (webServer.method() != HTTP_POST) {
    webServer.send(400, "text/plain", "Method not allowed");
    return;
  }
  
  Serial.println("🔄 REBOOT: Urządzenie restartuje za 1 sekundę...");
  webServer.send(200, "application/json", "{\"status\":\"rebooting\"}");
  
  delay(1000);
  ESP.restart();
}

// ⭐ NOWY ENDPOINT: Harmonogram inkubacji dla gatunku
void handle_api_schedule() {
  String species = webServer.arg("species");
  if (species.isEmpty()) {
    species = "CHICKEN";  // Default
  }
  
  int total_days = 0;
  const IncubationDay* schedule = get_schedule(species.c_str(), total_days);
  
  String json = "{\"species\":\"" + species + "\",\"total_days\":" + String(total_days) + ",\"schedule\":[";
  
  for (int i = 0; i < total_days; i++) {
    char entry[256];
    snprintf(entry, sizeof(entry),
      "{\"day\":%d,\"temp_min\":%.1f,\"temp_max\":%.1f,\"hum_min\":%.0f,\"hum_max\":%.0f,\"turn\":%s,\"stop\":%s,\"notes\":\"%s\"}%s",
      schedule[i].day,
      schedule[i].temp_min,
      schedule[i].temp_max,
      schedule[i].humidity_min,
      schedule[i].humidity_max,
      schedule[i].turn ? "true" : "false",
      schedule[i].stop_turn ? "true" : "false",
      schedule[i].notes,
      (i < total_days - 1) ? "," : ""
    );
    json += entry;
  }
  
  json += "]}";
  webServer.send(200, "application/json", json);
}

// ⭐ NOWY ENDPOINT: Parametry dzisiajszego dnia
void handle_api_today() {
  String species = webServer.arg("species");
  if (species.isEmpty()) {
    species = "CHICKEN";
  }
  
  int current_day_num = (last_sensor_data.timestamp / 86400000) + 1;
  
  int total_days = 0;
  const IncubationDay* schedule = get_schedule(species.c_str(), total_days);
  
  // Ograniczamy do zakresu
  if (current_day_num > total_days) current_day_num = total_days;
  if (current_day_num < 1) current_day_num = 1;
  
  const IncubationDay& today = schedule[current_day_num - 1];
  
  // Sprawdzamy czy parametry zgadzają się z dzisiajszym dniem
  float temp_diff = abs(last_sensor_data.temp_inside - ((today.temp_min + today.temp_max) / 2));
  float hum_diff = abs(last_sensor_data.humidity - ((today.humidity_min + today.humidity_max) / 2));
  
  char status_temp[32] = "OK";
  char status_hum[32] = "OK";
  
  if (last_sensor_data.temp_inside < today.temp_min - 0.5) strcpy(status_temp, "TOO_LOW");
  else if (last_sensor_data.temp_inside > today.temp_max + 0.5) strcpy(status_temp, "TOO_HIGH");
  
  if (last_sensor_data.humidity < today.humidity_min - 2) strcpy(status_hum, "TOO_LOW");
  else if (last_sensor_data.humidity > today.humidity_max + 2) strcpy(status_hum, "TOO_HIGH");
  
  char json[512];
  snprintf(json, sizeof(json),
    "{"
    "\"day\":%d,"
    "\"species\":\"%s\","
    "\"temp_min\":%.1f,"
    "\"temp_max\":%.1f,"
    "\"temp_current\":%.1f,"
    "\"temp_status\":\"%s\","
    "\"hum_min\":%.0f,"
    "\"hum_max\":%.0f,"
    "\"hum_current\":%.0f,"
    "\"hum_status\":\"%s\","
    "\"should_turn\":%s,"
    "\"is_lockdown\":%s,"
    "\"notes\":\"%s\""
    "}",
    current_day_num,
    species.c_str(),
    today.temp_min,
    today.temp_max,
    last_sensor_data.temp_inside,
    status_temp,
    today.humidity_min,
    today.humidity_max,
    (int)last_sensor_data.humidity,
    status_hum,
    today.turn ? "true" : "false",
    today.stop_turn ? "true" : "false",
    today.notes
  );
  
  webServer.send(200, "application/json", json);
}

void handle_not_found() {
  webServer.send(404, "text/plain", "404 - Nie znaleziono");
}

    // Odśwież na starcie
    fetchStatus();
    
    // 📋 Funkcje do harmonogramu
    let schedule_data = null;
    let today_data = null;
    
    async function loadSchedule() {
      try {
        const response = await fetch('/api/schedule?species=CHICKEN');
        schedule_data = await response.json();
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Błąd harmonogramu:', error);
      }
    }
    
    async function loadTodayParams() {
      try {
        const response = await fetch('/api/today?species=CHICKEN');
        today_data = await response.json();
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Błąd parametrów dzisiaj:', error);
      }
    }
    
    function showScheduleTable() {
      if (!schedule_data) {
        alert('Ładowanie harmonogramu...');
        return;
      }
      
      let table = '<table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:12px;">';
      table += '<tr style="background:#667eea; color:white;"><th>Dzień</th><th>Temp (°C)</th><th>Wilg. (%)</th><th>Obrót</th><th>Uwagi</th></tr>';
      
      for (let day of schedule_data.schedule) {
        let row_color = (today_data && day.day === today_data.day) ? '#fff3cd' : '#f8f9fa';
        table += `<tr style="background:${row_color}; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">`;
        table += `<td style="padding:8px;">${day.day}</td>`;
        table += `<td>${day.temp_min.toFixed(1)}-${day.temp_max.toFixed(1)}</td>`;
        table += `<td>${day.hum_min.toFixed(0)}-${day.hum_max.toFixed(0)}</td>`;
        table += `<td>${day.turn ? '✓' : '✗'}</td>`;
        table += `<td>${day.notes}</td>`;
        table += '</tr>';
      }
      table += '</table>';
      
      alert('Harmonogram ' + schedule_data.species + ' (' + schedule_data.total_days + ' dni):\n\nZobacz w konsoli F12');
      console.log(table);
    }
    
    // Załaduj harmonogram na starcie
    loadSchedule();
    loadTodayParams();
    
    // Auto-refresh co 30 sekund (zamiast co 5 - oszczędza transfer)
    setInterval(fetchStatus, 30000);
```

            <div class="info-box">
              <div class="status-line">
                <span>Dzien:</span>
                <span><strong>${current_day}/${data.incubation_days}</strong></span>
              </div>
              <div class="status-line">
                <span>Lockdown:</span>
                <span><strong class="${lockdown_active ? 'status-error' : 'status-ok'}">${lockdown_active ? 'AKTYWNY' : 'Nie'}</strong></span>
              </div>
              <div class="status-line">
                <span>Drzwi:</span>
                <span><strong class="${data.door_open ? 'status-warning' : 'status-ok'}">${data.door_open ? 'OTWARTE' : 'Zamkniete'}</strong></span>
              </div>
              <div class="status-line">
                <span>Cel temperatury:</span>
                <span><strong style="color: #28a745;">${data.target_temp}C</strong></span>
              </div>
              <div class="status-line">
                <span>Status czujnikow:</span>
                <span><strong class="${data.dummy_sensors ? 'status-warning' : 'status-ok'}">${data.dummy_sensors ? 'TEST DANE' : 'Rzeczywiste'}</strong></span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          
          <div>
            <div style="margin-bottom: 15px;">
              <h3 style="margin-bottom: 10px;">Ostatnie 2-3 godziny</h3>
              <div class="chart-container">
                <canvas id="sensorChart"></canvas>
              </div>
            </div>
            
            <div class="control-panel">
              <h3>Sterowanie</h3>
              
              <div class="control-buttons">
                <button class="btn-danger" onclick="resetDay()">Reset Dnia (1)</button>
                <button class="btn-warning" onclick="rebootDevice()">Restart Urzadzenia</button>
              </div>
              
              <div class="control-buttons" style="margin-bottom: 15px;">
                <button class="btn-info" onclick="showScheduleTable()" style="grid-column: 1 / -1;">Pokaz Harmonogram</button>
              </div>
              
              <div style="margin-bottom: 10px;">
                <label style="display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; font-weight: bold;">Ustaw Konkretny Dzien:</label>
                <div class="day-input-group">
                  <input type="number" id="dayInput" min="1" max="30" placeholder="Wpisz numer dnia" value="1">
                  <button class="btn-success" onclick="setDay()">Ustaw</button>
                </div>
              </div>
              
              <p style="font-size: 12px; color: #666; margin-top: 10px;">
                INFO: Reset dnia wymaза historię! Uzywaj do testow.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
        
        document.getElementById('content').innerHTML = html;
        await updateChart();
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Blad:', error);
        document.getElementById('content').innerHTML = '<div style="padding: 40px; text-align: center;"><p>Blad polaczenia</p></div>';
      }
    }
    
    async function resetDay() {
      if (!confirm('Zresetowac licznik dni na 1?')) return;
      try {
        const response = await fetch('/api/reset-day', { method: 'POST' });
        const data = await response.json();
        alert('OK: Dzien zresetowany!');
        fetchStatus();
      } catch (error) {
        alert('Blad: ' + error);
      }
    }
    
    async function setDay() {
      const dayInput = document.getElementById('dayInput');
      const day = parseInt(dayInput.value);
      
      if (isNaN(day) || day < 1 || day > 30) {
        alert('Podaj dzien 1-30');
        return;
      }
      
      try {
        const response = await fetch('/api/set-day?day=' + day, { method: 'POST' });
        const data = await response.json();
        alert('OK: Ustawiono dzien ' + day);
        fetchStatus();
      } catch (error) {
        alert('Blad: ' + error);
      }
    }
    
    async function rebootDevice() {
      if (!confirm('Restart urzadzenia. WiFi przerwane na ~5s. OK?')) return;
      try {
        await fetch('/api/reboot', { method: 'POST' });
        alert('Urzadzenie restartuje...');
        setTimeout(() => fetchStatus(), 8000);
      } catch (error) {
        // Expected
      }
    }
    
    async function updateChart() {
      try {
        const response = await fetch('/api/history');
        const historyData = await response.json();
        
        if (!historyData.data || historyData.data.length === 0) return;
        
        const labels = [];
        const tempInside = [];
        const tempAquarium = [];
        const humidity = [];
        
        for (let d of historyData.data) {
          labels.push(d.t);
          tempInside.push(d.te);
          tempAquarium.push(d.ta);
          humidity.push(d.h);
        }
        
        if (chart) chart.destroy();
        
        const ctx = document.getElementById('sensorChart').getContext('2d');
        chart = new Chart(ctx, {
          type: 'line',
          data: {
            labels: labels,
            datasets: [
              {
                label: 'Temp Jaj (C)',
                data: tempInside,
                borderColor: '#667eea',
                backgroundColor: 'rgba(102, 126, 234, 0.1)',
                yAxisID: 'y',
                tension: 0.3
              },
              {
                label: 'Temp Akwarium (C)',
                data: tempAquarium,
                borderColor: '#28a745',
                backgroundColor: 'rgba(40, 167, 69, 0.1)',
                yAxisID: 'y',
                tension: 0.3
              },
              {
                label: 'Wilgotnosc (%)',
                data: humidity,
                borderColor: '#ffc107',
                backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 193, 7, 0.1)',
                yAxisID: 'y1',
                tension: 0.3
              }
            ]
          },
          options: {
            responsive: true,
            maintainAspectRatio: false,
            interaction: { mode: 'index', intersect: false },
            plugins: {
              legend: { position: 'top' },
              title: { display: false }
            },
            scales: {
              y: {
                type: 'linear',
                display: true,
                position: 'left',
                title: { display: true, text: 'Temperatura (C)' },
                min: 30,
                max: 40,
              },
              y1: {
                type: 'linear',
                display: true,
                position: 'right',
                title: { display: true, text: 'Wilgotnosc (%)' },
                min: 0,
                max: 100,
                grid: { drawOnChartArea: false },
              }
            }
          }
        });
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Blad wykresu:', error);
      }
    }
    
    async function loadSchedule() {
      try {
        const response = await fetch('/api/schedule?species=CHICKEN');
        schedule_data = await response.json();
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Blad harmonogramu:', error);
      }
    }
    
    function showScheduleTable() {
      if (!schedule_data) {
        alert('Ladowanie harmonogramu...');
        return;
      }
      
      let table = '<table class="schedule-table"><tr><th>Dzien</th><th>Temp (C)</th><th>Wilg (%)</th><th>Obrot</th><th>Uwagi</th></tr>';
      
      for (let day of schedule_data.schedule) {
        let row_class = (today_data && day.day === today_data.day) ? 'today' : '';
        table += '<tr class="' + row_class + '"><td>' + day.day + '</td><td>' + day.temp_min.toFixed(1) + '-' + day.temp_max.toFixed(1) + '</td><td>' + day.hum_min.toFixed(0) + '-' + day.hum_max.toFixed(0) + '</td><td>' + (day.turn ? 'X' : '-') + '</td><td>' + day.notes + '</td></tr>';
      }
      table += '</table>';
      
      let popup = window.open('', 'Harmonogram', 'width=800,height=600');
      popup.document.write(table);
      popup.document.close();
    }
    
    // Start
    fetchStatus();
    loadSchedule();
    
    // Auto-refresh co 30 sekund
    setInterval(fetchStatus, 30000);
  </script>
</body>
</html>

# WYMAGANIA INKUBATORA - Analiza użytkownika

## Główne gatunki do inkubacji
- **Kury** (21 dni) - PRIORYTET
- **Kaczki** (28 dni) - PRIORYTET
- **Przepiórki** (17 dni) - przyszłość
- **Perliski** - przyszłość

## Modele pracy
- Inkubacja **osobna dla każdego gatunku** LUB
- Inkubacja **mieszana** (jeśli temperatury kompatybilne)
- Potrzeba **elastyczności** w wyborze

## Przyszłe rozszerzenia
- Kiełkowanie nasion
- Hodowla grzybów
- Uprawa grzybów do sake
- Inne projekty

## DANE DO MONITOROWANIA - co użytkownik musi wiedzieć DZISIAJ

### Status bieżący (co 30 sekund)
- ✅ Temperatura jaj
- ✅ Temperatura akwarium (system hybrydowy)
- ✅ Wilgotność
- ✅ Dzień / faza inkubacji
- ✅ PWM grzejnika
- ? Status obrotu jaj (czy tace się obracają?)
- ? Status wentylacji
- ? Alert o lockdown

### Dane historyczne / trendy
- ? Wykres temp/wilg. ostatnie 24h (a nie 2-3h)
- ? Czy temperatura trzymana +/- X°C od celu
- ? Czy wilgotność w normie
- ? Czy obrót się wykonywał regularnie

### Raport dzienny / alerty
- ? Ile dni do wylęgu
- ? Czy wszystko w normie dzisiaj
- ? Czy były jakieś błędy/odchylenia
- ? Zalecenia na dzisiaj (np. "zwiększ wilgotność")

## FUNKCJONALNOŚCI POTRZEBNE
- Zmiana gatunku (Kurze/Kaczki/Przepiórki/Perliski)
- Obserwacja harmonogramu dla wybranego gatunku
- Alerty gdy temp/wilg. poza normą
- Raport dzisiejszego dnia
- Możliwość manualnego resetowania dnia (testowanie)
- Możliwość wyboru trybu: DEMO/TEST/PRODUKCJA

<summary>Tool use: **create_file**</summary>

**Input:**

- content:

```
// ============================================================================
// TRAY CONTROLLER - Obsługa 3 niezależnych tacek z własnymi licznikami
// ============================================================================
// Każda taca:
// - Ma własny PIN (PWM/SSR do wyłączenia w lockdown)
// - Ma własny licznik dni w EEPROM
// - Ma własny gatunek (CHICKEN, DUCK, QUAIL, GOOSE)
// - Może być włączana/wyłączana niezależnie

#ifndef TRAY_CONTROLLER_H
#define TRAY_CONTROLLER_H

#include "incubation_schedule.h"

// ============================================================================
// KONFIGURACJA TACEK - PIN i EEPROM ADRESY
// ============================================================================

#define NUM_TRAYS 3

// Piny PWM/SSR dla każdej tacy
#define PIN_TRAY_1  18  // GPIO18
#define PIN_TRAY_2  19  // GPIO19
#define PIN_TRAY_3  20  // GPIO20

// EEPROM adresy - każda taca ma 8 bajtów
#define EEPROM_TRAY_1_TIME_ADDR  0x00    // 4 bajty: start_time dla tacy 1
#define EEPROM_TRAY_1_SPECIES_ADDR 0x04  // 1 bajt: species ID dla tacy 1
#define EEPROM_TRAY_2_TIME_ADDR  0x10    // 4 bajty: start_time dla tacy 2
#define EEPROM_TRAY_2_SPECIES_ADDR 0x14  // 1 bajt: species ID dla tacy 2
#define EEPROM_TRAY_3_TIME_ADDR  0x20    // 4 bajty: start_time dla tacy 3
#define EEPROM_TRAY_3_SPECIES_ADDR 0x24  // 1 bajt: species ID dla tacy 3

// Mapowanie gatunków
#define SPECIES_CHICKEN 0
#define SPECIES_DUCK    1
#define SPECIES_QUAIL   2
#define SPECIES_GOOSE   3
#define SPECIES_EMPTY   255  // Taca nie użyta

// ============================================================================
// STRUKTURA TACY
// ============================================================================

struct Tray {
  int id;                    // 0, 1, 2
  int pin;                   // GPIO pin dla PWM/SSR
  uint8_t species;           // SPECIES_CHICKEN, SPECIES_DUCK, etc.
  unsigned long start_time;  // kiedy wkładaliśmy jaja (millisecond)
  
  // Pochodne (obliczane)
  int current_day;
  int total_days;
  int lockdown_day;
  float target_temp;
  float target_humidity;
  bool should_rotate;        // czy tace powinny się obracać (nie-lockdown)
  bool rotating;             // czy PWM_PIN jest HIGH
};

// ============================================================================
// GLOBALNE TABLICE TACEK
// ============================================================================

Tray trays[NUM_TRAYS] = {
  {0, PIN_TRAY_1, SPECIES_CHICKEN, 0, 0, 21, 37.5, 55.0, true, false},
  {1, PIN_TRAY_2, SPECIES_DUCK, 0, 0, 28, 37.5, 55.0, true, false},
  {2, PIN_TRAY_3, SPECIES_EMPTY, 0, 0, 0, 37.5, 55.0, false, false}
};

// ============================================================================
// FUNKCJE POMOCNICZE
// ============================================================================

/**
 * Załaduj start_time dla tacy z EEPROM
 */
void load_tray_from_eeprom(int tray_id) {
  if (tray_id < 0 || tray_id >= NUM_TRAYS) return;
  
  EEPROM.begin(512);
  
  uint32_t eeprom_addr_time = (tray_id == 0) ? EEPROM_TRAY_1_TIME_ADDR :
                               (tray_id == 1) ? EEPROM_TRAY_2_TIME_ADDR :
                               EEPROM_TRAY_3_TIME_ADDR;
  uint32_t eeprom_addr_species = (tray_id == 0) ? EEPROM_TRAY_1_SPECIES_ADDR :
                                  (tray_id == 1) ? EEPROM_TRAY_2_SPECIES_ADDR :
                                  EEPROM_TRAY_3_SPECIES_ADDR;
  
  unsigned long saved_time = 0;
  EEPROM.get(eeprom_addr_time, saved_time);
  
  uint8_t saved_species = 255;
  EEPROM.get(eeprom_addr_species, saved_species);
  
  EEPROM.end();
  
  // Jeśli EEPROM puste (0xFFFFFFFF lub 0), to nowy start
  if (saved_time == 0xFFFFFFFF || saved_time == 0) {
    trays[tray_id].start_time = millis();
    trays[tray_id].species = (tray_id == 0) ? SPECIES_CHICKEN :
                              (tray_id == 1) ? SPECIES_DUCK :
                              SPECIES_EMPTY;
    Serial.printf("Taca %d: Nowy start (domyslny gatunek)\n", tray_id + 1);
  } else {
    trays[tray_id].start_time = saved_time;
    if (saved_species != 255) {
      trays[tray_id].species = saved_species;
    }
    Serial.printf("Taca %d: Zaladowana z EEPROM (start_time=%lu)\n", tray_id + 1, saved_time);
  }
}

/**
 * Zapisz stan tacy do EEPROM
 */
void save_tray_to_eeprom(int tray_id) {
  if (tray_id < 0 || tray_id >= NUM_TRAYS) return;
  
  EEPROM.begin(512);
  
  uint32_t eeprom_addr_time = (tray_id == 0) ? EEPROM_TRAY_1_TIME_ADDR :
                               (tray_id == 1) ? EEPROM_TRAY_2_TIME_ADDR :
                               EEPROM_TRAY_3_TIME_ADDR;
  uint32_t eeprom_addr_species = (tray_id == 0) ? EEPROM_TRAY_1_SPECIES_ADDR :
                                  (tray_id == 1) ? EEPROM_TRAY_2_SPECIES_ADDR :
                                  EEPROM_TRAY_3_SPECIES_ADDR;
  
  EEPROM.put(eeprom_addr_time, trays[tray_id].start_time);
  EEPROM.put(eeprom_addr_species, trays[tray_id].species);
  EEPROM.commit();
  EEPROM.end();
  
  Serial.printf("Taca %d: Zapisana do EEPROM\n", tray_id + 1);
}

/**
 * Oblicz parametry bieżące dla tacy (dzień, total_days, lockdown_day, etc.)
 */
void update_tray_status(int tray_id) {
  if (tray_id < 0 || tray_id >= NUM_TRAYS) return;
  
  Tray &t = trays[tray_id];
  
  // Jeśli gatunek = EMPTY, nie obliczaj nic
  if (t.species == SPECIES_EMPTY) {
    t.current_day = 0;
    t.total_days = 0;
    t.lockdown_day = 0;
    t.should_rotate = false;
    return;
  }
  
  // Oblicz bieżący dzień
  unsigned long elapsed = millis() - t.start_time;
  t.current_day = (elapsed / 86400000) + 1;  // millis → days
  
  // Pobierz harmonogram dla gatunku
  int schedule_size = 0;
  const IncubationDay* schedule = get_schedule_by_id(t.species, schedule_size);
  
  if (schedule) {
    t.total_days = schedule_size;
    // Lockdown_day to dzień gdzie stop_turn == true
    t.lockdown_day = schedule_size;  // Default na koniec
    for (int i = 0; i < schedule_size; i++) {
      if (schedule[i].stop_turn) {
        t.lockdown_day = schedule[i].day;
        break;
      }
    }
    
    // Czy powinny się obracać?
    t.should_rotate = (t.current_day < t.lockdown_day);
    
    // Pobierz target temp/humidity dla dzisiejszego dnia
    if (t.current_day >= 1 && t.current_day <= schedule_size) {
      const IncubationDay &day = schedule[t.current_day - 1];
      t.target_temp = day.temp_min;  // Używamy minimum
      t.target_humidity = day.humidity_min;
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Sterownik PWM dla tacy - włącz/wyłącz na podstawie lockdown
 */
void control_tray_pwm(int tray_id) {
  if (tray_id < 0 || tray_id >= NUM_TRAYS) return;
  
  Tray &t = trays[tray_id];
  
  if (t.species == SPECIES_EMPTY) {
    // Taca nie używana - wyłącz
    digitalWrite(t.pin, LOW);
    t.rotating = false;
    return;
  }
  
  // Włącz/wyłącz na podstawie should_rotate
  if (t.should_rotate) {
    digitalWrite(t.pin, HIGH);
    t.rotating = true;
  } else {
    digitalWrite(t.pin, LOW);
    t.rotating = false;
  }
}

/**
 * Zmień gatunek dla tacy (i resetuj licznik)
 */
void set_tray_species(int tray_id, uint8_t new_species) {
  if (tray_id < 0 || tray_id >= NUM_TRAYS) return;
  
  trays[tray_id].species = new_species;
  trays[tray_id].start_time = millis();  // Nowy start
  
  save_tray_to_eeprom(tray_id);
  update_tray_status(tray_id);
  control_tray_pwm(tray_id);
  
  Serial.printf("Taca %d: Zmieniona na gatunek %d\n", tray_id + 1, new_species);
}

/**
 * Reset licznika dla tacy
 */
void reset_tray(int tray_id) {
  if (tray_id < 0 || tray_id >= NUM_TRAYS) return;
  
  trays[tray_id].start_time = millis();
  save_tray_to_eeprom(tray_id);
  update_tray_status(tray_id);
  
  Serial.printf("Taca %d: Licznik zresetowany\n", tray_id + 1);
}

/**
 * Inicjalizacja wszystkich tacek - loaduj z EEPROM, ustaw piny
 */
void init_trays() {
  Serial.println("\n=== INICJALIZACJA TACEK ===");
  
  for (int i = 0; i < NUM_TRAYS; i++) {
    // Ustaw pin jako output
    pinMode(trays[i].pin, OUTPUT);
    digitalWrite(trays[i].pin, LOW);  // Na początek wyłącz
    
    // Załaduj z EEPROM
    load_tray_from_eeprom(i);
    
    // Oblicz status
    update_tray_status(i);
    
    // Zastosuj sterowanie PWM
    control_tray_pwm(i);
  }
  
  Serial.println("=== TACE GOTOWE ===\n");
}

/**
 * Update wszystkich tacek co jakiś czas (zwykle w loop)
 */
void update_all_trays() {
  for (int i = 0; i < NUM_TRAYS; i++) {
    update_tray_status(i);
    control_tray_pwm(i);
  }
}

/**
 * Pobierz harmonogram po ID gatunku
 */
const IncubationDay* get_schedule_by_id(uint8_t species_id, int &out_size) {
  if (species_id == SPECIES_CHICKEN) {
    return get_schedule("CHICKEN", out_size);
  } else if (species_id == SPECIES_DUCK) {
    return get_schedule("DUCK", out_size);
  } else if (species_id == SPECIES_QUAIL) {
    return get_schedule("QUAIL", out_size);
  } else if (species_id == SPECIES_GOOSE) {
    return get_schedule("GOOSE", out_size);
  }
  out_size = 0;
  return nullptr;
}

/**
 * Konwertuj species ID na string
 */
const char* species_id_to_name(uint8_t species_id) {
  switch (species_id) {
    case SPECIES_CHICKEN: return "CHICKEN";
    case SPECIES_DUCK: return "DUCK";
    case SPECIES_QUAIL: return "QUAIL";
    case SPECIES_GOOSE: return "GOOSE";
    case SPECIES_EMPTY: return "EMPTY";
    default: return "UNKNOWN";
  }
}

#endif  // TRAY_CONTROLLER_H

// ⭐ NOWY ENDPOINT: Status wszystkich 3 tacek
void handle_api_trays() {
  String json = "{\"trays\":[";
  
  for (int i = 0; i < NUM_TRAYS; i++) {
    if (i > 0) json += ",";
    
    Tray &t = trays[i];
    const char* species_name = species_id_to_name(t.species);
    
    char tray_json[512];
    snprintf(tray_json, sizeof(tray_json),
      "{"
      "\"id\":%d,"
      "\"species\":\"%s\","
      "\"current_day\":%d,"
      "\"total_days\":%d,"
      "\"days_until_hatch\":%d,"
      "\"lockdown_day\":%d,"
      "\"rotating\":%s,"
      "\"should_rotate\":%s,"
      "\"target_temp\":%.1f,"
      "\"target_humidity\":%.0f"
      "}",
      i,
      species_name,
      t.current_day,
      t.total_days,
      (t.total_days - t.current_day + 1),
      t.lockdown_day,
      t.rotating ? "true" : "false",
      t.should_rotate ? "true" : "false",
      t.target_temp,
      t.target_humidity
    );
    
    json += tray_json;
  }
  
  json += "]}";
  webServer.send(200, "application/json", json);
}

void handle_not_found() {
  webServer.send(404, "text/plain", "404 - Nie znaleziono");
}

│  📊 WYKRES (Ostatnie 2-3 godziny)       │
│  ─────────────────────────────────────  │
│                                         │
│  [Linia niebieska]   Temp Jaj (37.5°C) │
│  [Linia zielona]     Temp Akw  (36°C)  │
│  [Linia żółta]       Wilgotność (%)    │
│                                         │
├─────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  🎮 STEROWANIE                          │
│  ────────────────────────────────────── │
│                                         │
│  [⏱️ Reset Dnia]  [🔄 Restart]          │
│  [📋 Harmonogram (full width)]          │
│                                         │
│  ⏳ Ustaw Konkretny Dzień:              │

└─────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## 🎨 Kolory status

- **🟢 OK** (`#28a745`) - wszystko w normie
- **🟡 WARNING** (`#ffc107`) - coś do kontroli  
- **🔴 ERROR** (`#dc3545`) - problem krytyczny

## 📱 Responsywność

- **Desktop**: 2 kolumny (parametry + informacje obok siebie)
- **Mobile**: 1 kolumna (wszystko poniżej siebie)

## 🔄 Auto-refresh

- Co **30 sekund** pobiera `/api/status` - nowe dane
- Wykres aktualizuje się z ostatnich 300 pomiarów
- Nie trzeba manualnie odświeżać

## 🎯 Główne sekcje

1. **Status Dzisiaj** (gradient, wyróżniona) - "DNI DO WYLĘGU" + dewiacje
2. **Parametry** - Temp jaj, akwarium, wilgotność, PWM
3. **Informacje** - Dzień, Lockdown, Drzwi, Status czujników
4. **Status systemów** - Tace + Wentylator
5. **Wykres historii** - Chart.js z 2-3h danych (dual Y-axis)
6. **Sterowanie** - Przyciski do resetowania, rebootu, ustawiania dnia

Plik jest w: `firmware/data/index.html` (7KB UTF-8)

Czeka na upload do SPIFFS! 🚀

    <button class="tab" onclick="showTab('trays')">🗂️ Tace</button>
    <button class="tab" onclick="showTab('schedule')">📋 Harmonogram</button>
    <button class="tab" onclick="showTab('config')">⚙️ Konfiguracja</button>
  </div>

  <!-- DASHBOARD -->
  <div id="tab-dashboard" class="tab-panel active">
    <div id="alert-bar" class="alert" style="display:none"></div>
    <div class="grid-2">
      <div class="card" id="card-temp">
        <div class="val-label">Temperatura komory</div>
        <div class="val-big" id="val-temp">--.-°C</div>
        <div id="val-temp-aq" style="margin-top:4px"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="card green">
        <div class="val-label">Wilgotność komory</div>
        <div class="val-big" id="val-hum">--%</div>
        <div class="val-label" id="val-hum-target">Cel: -- – -- %</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="card" style="margin:16px 0">
      <h3>🔧 Status systemów</h3>
      <div class="grid-2">
        <div id="sys-left"></div>
        <div id="sys-right"></div>
      </div>
    </div>

      <div style="height:300px"><canvas id="chart"></canvas></div>

  </div>

      <label>Wybierz gatunek</label>
      <select id="sched-species" onchange="loadSchedule()" style="width:100%">
        <option value="CHICKEN">🐔 Kura (21 dni)</option>
        <option value="DUCK">🦆 Kaczka (28 dni)</option>
        <option value="GOOSE">🦢 Gęś (30 dni)</option>

</div>

<div id="toast"></div>

<script>
// ==================== GŁÓWNY KOD JS ====================

let chartInstance = null;
let currentConfig = null;

function showTab(tab) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById(`tab-${tab}`).classList.add('active');
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab')[['dashboard','trays','schedule','config'].indexOf(tab)].classList.add('active');

  if (tab === 'trays') loadTrays();
  if (tab === 'schedule') loadSchedule();
  if (tab === 'config') loadConfig();
}

function toast(msg, isError = false) {
  const t = document.getElementById('toast');
  t.textContent = msg;
  t.style.background = isError ? '#dc3545' : '#333';
  t.style.display = 'block';
  setTimeout(() => t.style.display = 'none', 4000);
}

// API wrapper
async function api(url, method = 'GET', body = null) {
  try {
    const opts = { method, headers: {} };
    if (body) {
      opts.body = JSON.stringify(body);
      opts.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';
    }
    const res = await fetch(url, opts);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
    return await res.json();
  } catch (e) {
    console.error(e);
    toast('Brak połączenia z inkubatorem', true);
    throw e;
  }
}

// ==================== KONFIGURACJA ====================

async function loadConfig() {
  try {
    currentConfig = await api('/api/config');
    renderFullConfig(currentConfig);
    toast('Konfiguracja wczytana');
  } catch(e) {}
}

function renderFullConfig(cfg) {
  // ... (pełna implementacja renderowania - za długa do wklejenia tutaj w jednej wiadomości)
  // Mogę Ci wysłać cały plik w następnej wiadomości jeśli chcesz.
}

async function saveConfig() {
  if (!currentConfig) return;
  const newCfg = buildConfigFromForm();
  try {
    const resp = await api('/api/config', 'POST', newCfg);
    toast('✅ Konfiguracja zapisana pomyślnie', false);
    currentConfig = newCfg;
  } catch(e) {
    toast('❌ Błąd podczas zapisu', true);
  }
}

async function factoryReset() {
  if (!confirm('Czy na pewno przywrócić ustawienia fabryczne?\n\nCała konfiguracja zostanie usunięta!')) return;
  try {
    await api('/api/config', 'POST', { factory_reset: true }); // możesz dodać obsługę po stronie ESP
    toast('Przywrócono ustawienia fabryczne');
    setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 1500);
  } catch(e) {}
}

// ==================== INICJALIZACJA ====================

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  showTab('dashboard');
  setInterval(() => {
    if (document.getElementById('tab-dashboard').classList.contains('active')) refreshDashboard();
  }, 15000);
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

      </div>
      <div class="srow">
        <span>Czas pracy:</span>
        <span id="info-uptime">--</span>
      </div>
      <div class="srow">
        <span>Pamięć SPIFFS:</span>
        <span id="info-spiffs">--</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="toast"></div>

<script>
// ==================== KONFIGURACJA ====================
const INTERVAL_REFRESH = 20000;  // 20 sekund

let chartInstance = null;
let lastStatus = null;

// ==================== TOAST NOTYFIKACJE ====================
function toast(msg, type = 'info') {
  const t = document.getElementById('toast');
  t.textContent = msg;
  t.style.background = type === 'error' ? '#dc3545' : type === 'success' ? '#28a745' : '#333';
  t.style.display = 'block';
  setTimeout(() => t.style.display = 'none', 4000);
}

// ==================== API ====================
async function api(url) {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(url);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
    return await res.json();
  } catch(e) {
    console.error('API Error:', e);
    return null;
  }
}

async function apiPost(url, method = 'POST') {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(url, { method });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
    return await res.json();
  } catch(e) {
    console.error('API Post Error:', e);
    return null;
  }
}

// ==================== TAB NAVIGATION ====================
function showTab(tab) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById(`tab-${tab}`).classList.add('active');
  const tabs = ['dashboard', 'trays', 'schedule', 'config'];
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab')[tabs.indexOf(tab)].classList.add('active');

  if (tab === 'trays') loadTrays();
  if (tab === 'schedule') loadSchedule();
}

// ==================== DASHBOARD ====================
async function refreshDashboard() {
  const status = await api('/api/status');
  if (!status) {
    document.getElementById('hdr-sub').textContent = '❌ Brak połączenia!';
    return;
  }

  lastStatus = status;
  const day = Math.floor(status.timestamp / 86400000) + 1;

  // Główne wskaźniki
  document.getElementById('val-hatch').textContent = status.days_until_hatch;
  document.getElementById('val-day-info').textContent = `Dzień ${day} z ${status.incubation_days} • ${status.bird_name}`;
  document.getElementById('val-temp').textContent = status.temp_inside.toFixed(1) + '°C';
  document.getElementById('val-hum').textContent = Math.round(status.humidity) + '%';
  document.getElementById('val-temp-aq').textContent = status.temp_aquarium.toFixed(1) + '°C';

  // Kolor temp jaj
  const tempCard = document.getElementById('card-temp');
  tempCard.classList.remove('green', 'red');
  if (Math.abs(status.temp_deviation) > 0.5) tempCard.classList.add('red');
  else tempCard.classList.add('green');

  // Status akwarium
  const aqStatus = document.getElementById('val-aq-status');
  if (status.aquarium_temp_ok) {
    aqStatus.innerHTML = '<span class="badge badge-ok">✓ OK</span>';
  } else {
    aqStatus.innerHTML = '<span class="badge badge-err">⚠️ Problem!</span>';
  }

  // Alert bar
  const alertBar = document.getElementById('alert-bar');
  if (status.alert) {
    alertBar.innerHTML = '⚠️ ' + status.alert;
    alertBar.style.display = 'block';
  } else {
    alertBar.style.display = 'none';
  }

  // Status systemów
  const lockdownActive = day >= status.lockdown_day;
  document.getElementById('sys-left').innerHTML = `
    <div class="srow">
      <span>📋 Tace obracające:</span>
      <span class="badge ${status.tray_rotating ? 'badge-ok' : 'badge-warn'}">
        ${status.tray_rotating ? '✓ TAK' : '✗ STOP'}
      </span>
    </div>
    <div class="srow" style="margin-top:8px">
      <span>🌬️ Wentylator:</span>
      <span class="badge badge-ok">✓ ON</span>
    </div>
  `;

  document.getElementById('sys-right').innerHTML = `
    <div class="srow">
      <span>🛑 Lockdown:</span>
      <span class="badge ${lockdownActive ? 'badge-warn' : 'badge-ok'}">
        ${lockdownActive ? '✓ AKTYWNY' : '✗ Nie'}
      </span>
    </div>
    <div class="srow" style="margin-top:8px">
      <span>🚪 Drzwi:</span>
      <span class="badge ${status.door_open ? 'badge-err' : 'badge-ok'}">
        ${status.door_open ? '⚠️ OTWARTE' : '✓ OK'}
      </span>
    </div>
  `;

  // Dashboard tacek (skrócona wersja)
  const traysData = await api('/api/trays');
  if (traysData && traysData.trays) {
    let html = '';
    for (const t of traysData.trays) {
      const species = ['CHICKEN', 'DUCK', 'QUAIL', 'GOOSE'][t.species] || 'EMPTY';
      const icons = { CHICKEN: '🐔', DUCK: '🦆', QUAIL: '🥚', GOOSE: '🦢', EMPTY: '-' };
      html += `
        <div class="card ${t.rotating ? 'green' : 'red'}">
          <div style="font-size:14px;font-weight:700">${icons[species]} Taca ${t.id}</div>
          <div style="font-size:11px;color:#666;margin:4px 0">${species}</div>
          <div style="font-size:18px;font-weight:700;margin:8px 0">${t.current_day}/${t.total_days}</div>
          <div style="font-size:12px">DNI DO WYLĘGU: ${t.days_until_hatch}</div>
        </div>
      `;
    }
    document.getElementById('dash-trays').innerHTML = html;
  }

  // Wykres
  const history = await api('/api/history');
  if (history && history.data && history.data.length > 0) updateChart(history.data);

  document.getElementById('hdr-sub').textContent = `📡 Online • Dzień ${day}/${status.incubation_days}`;
}

async function updateChart(data) {
  const labels = data.map(d => Math.round(d.t / 60));  // minuty
  const temps = data.map(d => d.te);
  const aqua = data.map(d => d.ta);
  const hums = data.map(d => d.h);

  if (chartInstance) chartInstance.destroy();

  const ctx = document.getElementById('chart').getContext('2d');
  chartInstance = new Chart(ctx, {
    type: 'line',
    data: {
      labels,
      datasets: [
        {
          label: 'Temp Jaj',
          data: temps,
          borderColor: '#667eea',
          backgroundColor: 'rgba(102,126,234,0.1)',
          yAxisID: 'y',
          tension: 0.3,
          pointRadius: 2
        },
        {
          label: 'Temp Akwarium',
          data: aqua,
          borderColor: '#28a745',
          backgroundColor: 'rgba(40,167,69,0.1)',
          yAxisID: 'y',
          tension: 0.3,
          pointRadius: 2
        },
        {
          label: 'Wilgotność',
          data: hums,
          borderColor: '#ffc107',
          backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,193,7,0.1)',
          yAxisID: 'y1',
          tension: 0.3,
          pointRadius: 2
        }
      ]
    },
    options: {
      responsive: true,
      maintainAspectRatio: false,
      interaction: { mode: 'index', intersect: false },
      plugins: { legend: { position: 'top' } },
      scales: {
        y: {
          type: 'linear',
          position: 'left',
          min: 30,
          max: 40,
          title: { display: true, text: 'Temperatura °C' }
        },
        y1: {
          type: 'linear',
          position: 'right',
          min: 0,
          max: 100,
          title: { display: true, text: 'Wilgotność %' },
          grid: { drawOnChartArea: false }
        }
      }
    }
  });
}

// ==================== TACE ====================
async function loadTrays() {
  const traysData = await api('/api/trays');
  if (!traysData) return;

  let html = '';
  for (const t of traysData.trays) {
    const species = ['CHICKEN', 'DUCK', 'QUAIL', 'GOOSE'][t.species] || 'BRAK';
    const icons = { CHICKEN: '🐔', DUCK: '🦆', QUAIL: '🥚', GOOSE: '🦢', BRAK: '⚪' };
    const isLockdown = t.current_day >= t.lockdown_day;
    html += `
      <div class="tray-card ${isLockdown ? 'lockdown' : 'active'}">
        <h3>${icons[species]} Taca ${t.id}</h3>
        <div class="srow">
          <span>Gatunek:</span>
          <strong>${species}</strong>
        </div>
        <div class="srow">
          <span>Postęp:</span>
          <strong>${t.current_day}/${t.total_days}</strong>
        </div>
        <div class="srow">
          <span>DNI DO WYLĘGU:</span>
          <strong style="font-size:18px;color:#667eea">${t.days_until_hatch}</strong>
        </div>
        <div class="srow">
          <span>Lockdown dzień:</span>
          <strong>${t.lockdown_day}</strong>
        </div>
        <div class="srow">
          <span>Stan obrotu:</span>
          <span class="badge ${t.rotating ? 'badge-ok' : 'badge-err'}">
            ${t.rotating ? '✓ Obracająca się' : '✗ ZATRZYMANA'}
          </span>
        </div>
        <div class="srow">
          <span>Docelowa temp.:</span>
          <strong>${t.target_temp}°C</strong>
        </div>
        <div class="srow">
          <span>Docelowa wilg.:</span>
          <strong>${Math.round(t.target_humidity)}%</strong>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  }
  document.getElementById('trays-container').innerHTML = html;
}

// ==================== HARMONOGRAM ====================
async function loadSchedule() {
  const species = document.getElementById('sched-species').value;
  const sched = await api('/api/schedule?species=' + species);
  if (!sched) return;

  let html = '';
  for (const day of sched.schedule) {
    html += `
      <tr>
        <td><strong>Dzień ${day.day}</strong></td>
        <td>${day.temp_min.toFixed(1)}–${day.temp_max.toFixed(1)}°C</td>
        <td>${Math.round(day.hum_min)}–${Math.round(day.hum_max)}%</td>
        <td>${day.turn ? '✓' : '–'}</td>
        <td>${day.notes}</td>
      </tr>
    `;
  }
  document.getElementById('sched-body').innerHTML = html;
}

// ==================== KONTROLA ====================
async function resetDay() {
  if (!confirm('Zresetować licznik dni na 1?')) return;
  const resp = await apiPost('/api/reset-day');
  if (resp) toast('✅ Dzień zresetowany!', 'success');
  refreshDashboard();
}

async function showSetDay() {
  const day = prompt('Wpisz numer dnia (1-30):', '1');
  if (!day) return;
  const resp = await apiPost(`/api/set-day?day=${day}`);
  if (resp) {
    toast(`✅ Ustawiono dzień ${day}`, 'success');
    refreshDashboard();
  }
}

async function rebootDevice() {
  if (!confirm('Zrebootować urządzenie? (WiFi przerwie na ~5s)')) return;
  await apiPost('/api/reboot');
  toast('⏳ Urządzenie restartuje...', 'info');
  setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 8000);
}

// ==================== INICJALIZACJA ====================
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  refreshDashboard();
  loadSchedule();
  
  setInterval(() => {
    const activeTab = document.querySelector('.tab-panel.active').id;
    if (activeTab === 'tab-dashboard') refreshDashboard();
  }, INTERVAL_REFRESH);
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pl">

  <title>Inkubator Monitor</title>
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.1/dist/chart.umd.min.js"></script>
  <style>
    *{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
    body{font-family:'Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#667eea,#764ba2);min-height:100vh;padding:16px;color:#333}
    .container{max-width:1120px;margin:0 auto;background:#fff;border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.3);overflow:hidden}
    .header{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#667eea,#764ba2);color:#fff;padding:24px 20px;text-align:center}
    .header h1{font-size:28px;margin-bottom:4px}

    .tab.active{color:#667eea;border-bottom:3px solid #667eea;background:#fff;margin-bottom:-2px}

    .tray-card.active{border-color:#667eea;background:#f0f2f5}

    .section-title{font-size:16px;font-weight:700;color:#333;margin:20px 0 12px;padding-bottom:6px;border-bottom:2px solid #667eea}
    .alert{padding:12px 16px;border-radius:8px;margin:10px 0;font-size:14px}

    table tr:hover{background:#f8f9fa}
    #toast{position:fixed;bottom:20px;right:20px;background:#333;color:#fff;padding:14px 20px;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.3);display:none;z-index:10000;min-width:280px;max-width:400px;word-wrap:break-word}
    .btn-group{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
    .badge{display:inline-block;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:4px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600}

    .badge-err{background:#f8d7da;color:#721c24}
    @media(max-width:768px){
      .grid-2{grid-template-columns:1fr}
      .grid-3{grid-template-columns:1fr}
      .tabs{flex-wrap:wrap}
      .tab{font-size:12px;padding:10px}
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="container">
  <div class="header">
    <h1>🥚 Inkubator Monitor</h1>
    <p id="hdr-sub">Ładowanie... <span id="conn-indicator"></span></p>
  </div>

  <div class="tabs">
    <button class="tab active" onclick="showTab('dashboard')">📊 Dashboard</button>
    <button class="tab" onclick="showTab('trays')">🗂️ Tace</button>
    <button class="tab" onclick="showTab('schedule')">📋 Harmonogram</button>
    <button class="tab" onclick="showTab('config')">⚙️ Kontrola</button>
  </div>

  <!-- DASHBOARD -->
  <div id="tab-dashboard" class="tab-panel active">
    <div id="alert-bar" class="alert alert-warning" style="display:none"></div>
    
    <div class="card" style="margin-bottom:20px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#667eea,#764ba2);color:#fff;border:none">
      <div style="font-size:16px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:8px">🎯 DNI DO WYLĘGU</div>
      <div style="font-size:42px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:12px" id="val-hatch">--</div>
      <div id="val-day-info" style="font-size:13px;opacity:0.9"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="grid-2">
      <div class="card" id="card-temp">
        <div class="val-label">🥚 Temperatura jaj</div>
        <div class="val-big" id="val-temp">--.-°C</div>
      </div>
      <div class="card green">
        <div class="val-label">💧 Wilgotność</div>
        <div class="val-big" id="val-hum">--%</div>
      </div>

    <div class="card" style="margin-top:16px">
      <div class="val-label">🐠 Temperatura akwarium</div>
      <div class="val-big" id="val-temp-aq">--.-°C</div>
      <div id="val-aq-status" style="margin-top:6px;font-size:12px"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="card" style="margin-top:16px">
      <h3>🔧 Status systemów</h3>
      <div class="grid-2">
        <div id="sys-left"></div>

    <div id="dash-trays" class="grid-3" style="margin-top:16px"></div>

    <div class="card" style="margin-top:16px">
      <h3>📈 Historia (ostatnie 2-3 godz.)</h3>
      <div style="height:300px;position:relative"><canvas id="chart"></canvas></div>
    </div>

    <div class="btn-group" style="margin-top:16px;justify-content:center">
      <button class="btn-primary" onclick="resetDay()">⏱️ Reset Do Dnia 1</button>
      <button class="btn-warning" onclick="showSetDay()">📍 Ustaw Dzień</button>
      <button class="btn-success" onclick="rebootDevice()">🔄 Restart</button>
    </div>

  <!-- TACE -->
  <div id="tab-trays" class="tab-panel">

  <!-- HARMONOGRAM -->
  <div id="tab-schedule" class="tab-panel">
    <div class="form-group">
      <label>Wybierz gatunek</label>
      <select id="sched-species" onchange="loadSchedule()" style="width:100%;max-width:400px">
        <option value="CHICKEN">🐔 Kura (21 dni)</option>
        <option value="DUCK">🦆 Kaczka (28 dni)</option>
        <option value="GOOSE">🦢 Gęś (30 dni)</option>
        <option value="QUAIL">🥚 Przepiórka (17 dni)</option>
      </select>
    </div>
    <table>
      <thead><tr><th>Dzień</th><th>Temperatura</th><th>Wilgotność</th><th>Obrót</th><th>Uwagi</th></tr></thead>

      <div class="srow">

        <span id="info-version">Nieznana</span>

      <div class="srow">

        <span id="info-uptime">--</span>

<div id="toast"></div>

<script>
// ==================== KONFIGURACJA ====================
const INTERVAL_REFRESH = 20000;  // 20 sekund

let chartInstance = null;
let lastStatus = null;

// ==================== TOAST NOTYFIKACJE ====================
function toast(msg, type = 'info') {
  const t = document.getElementById('toast');
  t.textContent = msg;
  t.style.background = type === 'error' ? '#dc3545' : type === 'success' ? '#28a745' : '#333';
  t.style.display = 'block';
  setTimeout(() => t.style.display = 'none', 4000);
}

// ==================== API ====================
async function api(url) {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(url);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
    return await res.json();
  } catch(e) {
    console.error('API Error:', e);
    return null;
  }
}

async function apiPost(url, method = 'POST') {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(url, { method });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
    return await res.json();
  } catch(e) {
    console.error('API Post Error:', e);
    return null;
  }
}

// ==================== TAB NAVIGATION ====================
function showTab(tab) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById(`tab-${tab}`).classList.add('active');
  const tabs = ['dashboard', 'trays', 'schedule', 'config'];
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab')[tabs.indexOf(tab)].classList.add('active');

  if (tab === 'trays') loadTrays();
  if (tab === 'schedule') loadSchedule();
}

// ==================== DASHBOARD ====================
async function refreshDashboard() {
  const status = await api('/api/status');
  if (!status) {
    document.getElementById('hdr-sub').textContent = '❌ Brak połączenia!';
    return;
  }

  lastStatus = status;
  const day = Math.floor(status.timestamp / 86400000) + 1;

  // Główne wskaźniki
  document.getElementById('val-hatch').textContent = status.days_until_hatch;
  document.getElementById('val-day-info').textContent = `Dzień ${day} z ${status.incubation_days} • ${status.bird_name}`;
  document.getElementById('val-temp').textContent = status.temp_inside.toFixed(1) + '°C';
  document.getElementById('val-hum').textContent = Math.round(status.humidity) + '%';
  document.getElementById('val-temp-aq').textContent = status.temp_aquarium.toFixed(1) + '°C';

  // Kolor temp jaj
  const tempCard = document.getElementById('card-temp');
  tempCard.classList.remove('green', 'red');
  if (Math.abs(status.temp_deviation) > 0.5) tempCard.classList.add('red');
  else tempCard.classList.add('green');

  // Status akwarium
  const aqStatus = document.getElementById('val-aq-status');
  if (status.aquarium_temp_ok) {
    aqStatus.innerHTML = '<span class="badge badge-ok">✓ OK</span>';
  } else {
    aqStatus.innerHTML = '<span class="badge badge-err">⚠️ Problem!</span>';
  }

  // Alert bar
  const alertBar = document.getElementById('alert-bar');
  if (status.alert) {
    alertBar.innerHTML = '⚠️ ' + status.alert;
    alertBar.style.display = 'block';
  } else {
    alertBar.style.display = 'none';
  }

  // Status systemów
  const lockdownActive = day >= status.lockdown_day;
  document.getElementById('sys-left').innerHTML = `
    <div class="srow">
      <span>📋 Tace obracające:</span>
      <span class="badge ${status.tray_rotating ? 'badge-ok' : 'badge-warn'}">
        ${status.tray_rotating ? '✓ TAK' : '✗ STOP'}
      </span>
    </div>
    <div class="srow" style="margin-top:8px">
      <span>🌬️ Wentylator:</span>
      <span class="badge badge-ok">✓ ON</span>
    </div>
  `;

  document.getElementById('sys-right').innerHTML = `
    <div class="srow">
      <span>🛑 Lockdown:</span>
      <span class="badge ${lockdownActive ? 'badge-warn' : 'badge-ok'}">
        ${lockdownActive ? '✓ AKTYWNY' : '✗ Nie'}
      </span>
    </div>
    <div class="srow" style="margin-top:8px">
      <span>🚪 Drzwi:</span>
      <span class="badge ${status.door_open ? 'badge-err' : 'badge-ok'}">
        ${status.door_open ? '⚠️ OTWARTE' : '✓ OK'}
      </span>
    </div>
  `;

  // Dashboard tacek (skrócona wersja)
  const traysData = await api('/api/trays');
  if (traysData && traysData.trays) {
    let html = '';
    for (const t of traysData.trays) {
      const species = ['CHICKEN', 'DUCK', 'QUAIL', 'GOOSE'][t.species] || 'EMPTY';
      const icons = { CHICKEN: '🐔', DUCK: '🦆', QUAIL: '🥚', GOOSE: '🦢', EMPTY: '-' };
      html += `
        <div class="card ${t.rotating ? 'green' : 'red'}">
          <div style="font-size:14px;font-weight:700">${icons[species]} Taca ${t.id}</div>
          <div style="font-size:11px;color:#666;margin:4px 0">${species}</div>
          <div style="font-size:18px;font-weight:700;margin:8px 0">${t.current_day}/${t.total_days}</div>
          <div style="font-size:12px">DNI DO WYLĘGU: ${t.days_until_hatch}</div>
        </div>
      `;
    }
    document.getElementById('dash-trays').innerHTML = html;
  }

  // Wykres
  const history = await api('/api/history');
  if (history && history.data && history.data.length > 0) updateChart(history.data);

  document.getElementById('hdr-sub').textContent = `📡 Online • Dzień ${day}/${status.incubation_days}`;
}

async function updateChart(data) {
  const labels = data.map(d => Math.round(d.t / 60));  // minuty
  const temps = data.map(d => d.te);
  const aqua = data.map(d => d.ta);
  const hums = data.map(d => d.h);

  if (chartInstance) chartInstance.destroy();

  const ctx = document.getElementById('chart').getContext('2d');
  chartInstance = new Chart(ctx, {
    type: 'line',
    data: {
      labels,
      datasets: [
        {
          label: 'Temp Jaj',
          data: temps,
          borderColor: '#667eea',
          backgroundColor: 'rgba(102,126,234,0.1)',
          yAxisID: 'y',
          tension: 0.3,
          pointRadius: 2
        },
        {
          label: 'Temp Akwarium',
          data: aqua,
          borderColor: '#28a745',
          backgroundColor: 'rgba(40,167,69,0.1)',
          yAxisID: 'y',
          tension: 0.3,
          pointRadius: 2
        },
        {
          label: 'Wilgotność',
          data: hums,
          borderColor: '#ffc107',
          backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,193,7,0.1)',
          yAxisID: 'y1',
          tension: 0.3,
          pointRadius: 2
        }
      ]
    },
    options: {
      responsive: true,
      maintainAspectRatio: false,
      interaction: { mode: 'index', intersect: false },
      plugins: { legend: { position: 'top' } },
      scales: {
        y: {
          type: 'linear',
          position: 'left',
          min: 30,
          max: 40,
          title: { display: true, text: 'Temperatura °C' }
        },
        y1: {
          type: 'linear',
          position: 'right',
          min: 0,
          max: 100,
          title: { display: true, text: 'Wilgotność %' },
          grid: { drawOnChartArea: false }
        }
      }
    }
  });
}

// ==================== TACE ====================
async function loadTrays() {
  const traysData = await api('/api/trays');
  if (!traysData) return;

  let html = '';
  for (const t of traysData.trays) {
    const species = ['CHICKEN', 'DUCK', 'QUAIL', 'GOOSE'][t.species] || 'BRAK';
    const icons = { CHICKEN: '🐔', DUCK: '🦆', QUAIL: '🥚', GOOSE: '🦢', BRAK: '⚪' };
    const isLockdown = t.current_day >= t.lockdown_day;
    html += `
      <div class="tray-card ${isLockdown ? 'lockdown' : 'active'}">
        <h3>${icons[species]} Taca ${t.id}</h3>
        <div class="srow">
          <span>Gatunek:</span>
          <strong>${species}</strong>
        </div>
        <div class="srow">
          <span>Postęp:</span>
          <strong>${t.current_day}/${t.total_days}</strong>
        </div>
        <div class="srow">
          <span>DNI DO WYLĘGU:</span>
          <strong style="font-size:18px;color:#667eea">${t.days_until_hatch}</strong>
        </div>
        <div class="srow">
          <span>Lockdown dzień:</span>
          <strong>${t.lockdown_day}</strong>
        </div>
        <div class="srow">
          <span>Stan obrotu:</span>
          <span class="badge ${t.rotating ? 'badge-ok' : 'badge-err'}">
            ${t.rotating ? '✓ Obracająca się' : '✗ ZATRZYMANA'}
          </span>
        </div>
        <div class="srow">
          <span>Docelowa temp.:</span>
          <strong>${t.target_temp}°C</strong>
        </div>
        <div class="srow">
          <span>Docelowa wilg.:</span>
          <strong>${Math.round(t.target_humidity)}%</strong>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  }
  document.getElementById('trays-container').innerHTML = html;
}

// ==================== HARMONOGRAM ====================
async function loadSchedule() {
  const species = document.getElementById('sched-species').value;
  const sched = await api('/api/schedule?species=' + species);
  if (!sched) return;

  let html = '';
  for (const day of sched.schedule) {
    html += `
      <tr>
        <td><strong>Dzień ${day.day}</strong></td>
        <td>${day.temp_min.toFixed(1)}–${day.temp_max.toFixed(1)}°C</td>
        <td>${Math.round(day.hum_min)}–${Math.round(day.hum_max)}%</td>
        <td>${day.turn ? '✓' : '–'}</td>
        <td>${day.notes}</td>
      </tr>
    `;
  }
  document.getElementById('sched-body').innerHTML = html;
}

// ==================== KONTROLA ====================
async function resetDay() {
  if (!confirm('Zresetować licznik dni na 1?')) return;
  const resp = await apiPost('/api/reset-day');
  if (resp) toast('✅ Dzień zresetowany!', 'success');
  refreshDashboard();
}

async function showSetDay() {
  const day = prompt('Wpisz numer dnia (1-30):', '1');
  if (!day) return;
  const resp = await apiPost(`/api/set-day?day=${day}`);
  if (resp) {
    toast(`✅ Ustawiono dzień ${day}`, 'success');
    refreshDashboard();
  }
}

async function rebootDevice() {
  if (!confirm('Zrebootować urządzenie? (WiFi przerwie na ~5s)')) return;
  await apiPost('/api/reboot');
  toast('⏳ Urządzenie restartuje...', 'info');
  setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 8000);
}

// ==================== INICJALIZACJA ====================
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  refreshDashboard();
  loadSchedule();
  
  setInterval(() => {
    const activeTab = document.querySelector('.tab-panel.active').id;
    if (activeTab === 'tab-dashboard') refreshDashboard();
  }, INTERVAL_REFRESH);
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

};

static const IncubationDay SCHEDULE_DUCK[] = { /* Twoje dane - bez zmian */ };
static const IncubationDay SCHEDULE_GOOSE[] = { /* ... */ };
static const IncubationDay SCHEDULE_QUAIL[] = { /* ... */ };
static const IncubationDay SCHEDULE_GUINEA[] = { /* ... */ };
static const IncubationDay SCHEDULE_PHEASANT[] = { /* ... */ };

struct SpeciesInfo {
  const char* id;
  const char* name;
  int total_days;
  const IncubationDay* schedule;
};

static const SpeciesInfo SPECIES_LIST[] = {
  {"CHICKEN", "Kura", 21, SCHEDULE_CHICKEN},
  {"DUCK",    "Kaczka", 28, SCHEDULE_DUCK},
  {"GOOSE",   "Gęś", 30, SCHEDULE_GOOSE},
  {"QUAIL",   "Przepiórka", 17, SCHEDULE_QUAIL},
  {"GUINEA",  "Perliczka", 26, SCHEDULE_GUINEA},
  {"PHEASANT","Bażant", 24, SCHEDULE_PHEASANT}
};

static const int SPECIES_COUNT = 6;

inline const SpeciesInfo* get_species(const char* id) {
  for (int i = 0; i < SPECIES_COUNT; i++) {
    if (strcmp(SPECIES_LIST[i].id, id) == 0) return &SPECIES_LIST[i];
  }
  return &SPECIES_LIST[0]; // fallback na kurę
}

inline const IncubationDay* get_day(const SpeciesInfo* sp, int day) {
  if (!sp || day < 1) return nullptr;
  if (day > sp->total_days) day = sp->total_days;
  return &sp->schedule[day - 1];
}

};

static const int SPECIES_COUNT = 6;

inline const SpeciesInfo* get_species(const char* id) {
  for (int i = 0; i < SPECIES_COUNT; i++) {
    if (strcmp(SPECIES_LIST[i].id, id) == 0) return &SPECIES_LIST[i];
  }
  return &SPECIES_LIST[0]; // fallback na kure
}

inline const IncubationDay* get_day(const SpeciesInfo* sp, int day) {
  if (!sp || day < 1) return nullptr;
  if (day > sp->total_days) day = sp->total_days;
  return &sp->schedule[day - 1];
}

#pragma once
// ============================================================================
// CONFIG MANAGER – konfiguracja przez webpanel, zapis SPIFFS + Preferences
//
// - Główny plik: SPIFFS /config.json (czytelny, edytowalny)
// - Backup: Preferences (namespace "inkubator") – odtwarzany jeśli SPIFFS uszkodzony
// - Fabryczne ustawienia domyślne
// ============================================================================

#include <Arduino.h>
#include <SPIFFS.h>
#include <Preferences.h>
#include <ArduinoJson.h>

// ── Stałe ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#define MAX_TRAYS       3
#define MAX_SENSORS     4
#define MAX_DIFFUSERS   3
#define CONFIG_PATH     "/config.json"
#define PREF_NAMESPACE  "inkubator"
#define PREF_KEY_CFG    "config_json"
#define PREF_KEY_CRC    "config_crc"

// ── Struktury konfiguracji ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
struct TrayConfig {
  bool        active;
  char        species[12];
  int         start_day_offset;
  int         pin;
  char        label[24];
};

struct SensorConfig {
  int   ds18b20_count;
  int   ds18b20_pins[MAX_SENSORS];
  char  ds18b20_labels[MAX_SENSORS][20];
  bool  dht22_enabled;
  int   dht22_pin;
  bool  water_level_enabled;
  int   water_level_pin;
  bool  door_sensor_enabled;
  int   door_sensor_pin;
  int   aquarium_sensor_index;
  float aquarium_target_temp;
};

struct DiffuserConfig {
  int   count;
  int   pins[MAX_DIFFUSERS];
  char  labels[MAX_DIFFUSERS][20];
  int   on_time_sec;
  int   off_time_sec;
};

struct SystemConfig {
  bool  test_mode;
  int   fan_pin;
  int   heater_pin_1;
  int   heater_pin_2;
  float target_temp;
  int   log_interval_sec;
};

struct IncubatorConfig {
  int           tray_count;
  TrayConfig    trays[MAX_TRAYS];
  SensorConfig  sensors;
  DiffuserConfig diffusers;
  SystemConfig  system;
};

// ── Domyślna konfiguracja ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
inline IncubatorConfig default_config() {
  IncubatorConfig cfg = {};
  cfg.tray_count = 2;

  // Taca 0 – Kaczki
  cfg.trays[0].active = true;
  strlcpy(cfg.trays[0].species,  "DUCK",      sizeof(cfg.trays[0].species));
  cfg.trays[0].start_day_offset = 0;
  cfg.trays[0].pin = 18;
  strlcpy(cfg.trays[0].label, "Taca 1 – Kaczki", sizeof(cfg.trays[0].label));

  // Taca 1 – Kury
  cfg.trays[1].active = true;
  strlcpy(cfg.trays[1].species,  "CHICKEN",   sizeof(cfg.trays[1].species));
  cfg.trays[1].start_day_offset = 7;
  cfg.trays[1].pin = 19;
  strlcpy(cfg.trays[1].label, "Taca 2 – Kury", sizeof(cfg.trays[1].label));

  cfg.trays[2].active = false;
  strlcpy(cfg.trays[2].species, "CHICKEN",    sizeof(cfg.trays[2].species));
  cfg.trays[2].start_day_offset = 0;
  cfg.trays[2].pin = 20;
  strlcpy(cfg.trays[2].label, "Taca 3 – (wolna)", sizeof(cfg.trays[2].label));

  // Sensory
  cfg.sensors.ds18b20_count = 0;
  int ds_pins_default[] = {6,7,4,5};
  const char* ds_labels_default[] = {"Komora jaj","Akwarium","Zewnetrzny","Dodatkowy"};
  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SENSORS; i++) {
    cfg.sensors.ds18b20_pins[i] = ds_pins_default[i];
    strlcpy(cfg.sensors.ds18b20_labels[i], ds_labels_default[i], 20);
  }
  cfg.sensors.dht22_enabled         = false;
  cfg.sensors.dht22_pin             = 8;
  cfg.sensors.water_level_enabled   = false;
  cfg.sensors.water_level_pin       = 9;
  cfg.sensors.door_sensor_enabled   = false;
  cfg.sensors.door_sensor_pin       = 10;
  cfg.sensors.aquarium_sensor_index = -1;
  cfg.sensors.aquarium_target_temp  = 36.0f;

  // Dyfuzory
  cfg.diffusers.count       = 0;
  int diff_pins_default[] = {11,12,13};
  const char* diff_labels_default[] = {"Nawilzacz 1","Nawilzacz 2","Nawilzacz 3"};
  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_DIFFUSERS; i++) {
    cfg.diffusers.pins[i] = diff_pins_default[i];
    strlcpy(cfg.diffusers.labels[i], diff_labels_default[i], 20);
  }
  cfg.diffusers.on_time_sec  = 60;
  cfg.diffusers.off_time_sec = 300;

  // System
  cfg.system.test_mode       = true;
  cfg.system.fan_pin         = 5;
  cfg.system.heater_pin_1    = 1;
  cfg.system.heater_pin_2    = 2;
  cfg.system.target_temp     = 37.5f;
  cfg.system.log_interval_sec = 600;

  return cfg;
}

// ── Klasa ConfigManager ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
class ConfigManager {
public:
  IncubatorConfig cfg;
  bool loaded_ok = false;

  // Wczytaj konfigurację: SPIFFS -> Preferences -> defaults
  bool load() {
    if (load_spiffs()) {
      Serial.println("[CFG] Wczytano z SPIFFS");
      loaded_ok = true;
      return true;
    }
    Serial.println("[CFG] SPIFFS brak/błędny, próbuję Preferences...");
    if (load_preferences()) {
      Serial.println("[CFG] Wczytano z Preferences – zapisuję do SPIFFS");
      save_spiffs();
      loaded_ok = true;
      return true;
    }
    Serial.println("[CFG] Brak konfiguracji – używam domyślnej");
    cfg = default_config();
    save();  // zapisz domyślną
    loaded_ok = true;
    return false;
  }

  // Zapisz do SPIFFS i Preferences
  bool save() {
    bool s = save_spiffs();
    save_preferences();
    return s;
  }

  // Przywróć ustawienia fabryczne
  void factory_reset() {
    cfg = default_config();
    save();
    Serial.println("[CFG] Przywrócono ustawienia fabryczne");
  }

  // Wygeneruj JSON (dla API)
  String to_json() {
    DynamicJsonDocument doc(4096);
    doc["tray_count"] = cfg.tray_count;

    JsonArray trays_arr = doc.createNestedArray("trays");
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_TRAYS; i++) {
      JsonObject t = trays_arr.createNestedObject();
      t["active"]           = cfg.trays[i].active;
      t["species"]          = cfg.trays[i].species;
      t["start_day_offset"] = cfg.trays[i].start_day_offset;
      t["pin"]              = cfg.trays[i].pin;
      t["label"]            = cfg.trays[i].label;
    }

    JsonObject sens = doc.createNestedObject("sensors");
    sens["ds18b20_count"] = cfg.sensors.ds18b20_count;
    JsonArray ds_pins = sens.createNestedArray("ds18b20_pins");
    JsonArray ds_labels = sens.createNestedArray("ds18b20_labels");
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SENSORS; i++) {
      ds_pins.add(cfg.sensors.ds18b20_pins[i]);
      ds_labels.add(cfg.sensors.ds18b20_labels[i]);
    }
    sens["dht22_enabled"]          = cfg.sensors.dht22_enabled;
    sens["dht22_pin"]              = cfg.sensors.dht22_pin;
    sens["water_level_enabled"]    = cfg.sensors.water_level_enabled;
    sens["water_level_pin"]        = cfg.sensors.water_level_pin;
    sens["door_sensor_enabled"]    = cfg.sensors.door_sensor_enabled;
    sens["door_sensor_pin"]        = cfg.sensors.door_sensor_pin;
    sens["aquarium_sensor_index"]  = cfg.sensors.aquarium_sensor_index;
    sens["aquarium_target_temp"]   = cfg.sensors.aquarium_target_temp;

    JsonObject diff = doc.createNestedObject("diffusers");
    diff["count"]        = cfg.diffusers.count;
    diff["on_time_sec"]  = cfg.diffusers.on_time_sec;
    diff["off_time_sec"] = cfg.diffusers.off_time_sec;
    JsonArray diff_pins   = diff.createNestedArray("pins");
    JsonArray diff_labels = diff.createNestedArray("labels");
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_DIFFUSERS; i++) {
      diff_pins.add(cfg.diffusers.pins[i]);
      diff_labels.add(cfg.diffusers.labels[i]);
    }

    JsonObject sys = doc.createNestedObject("system");
    sys["test_mode"]        = cfg.system.test_mode;
    sys["fan_pin"]          = cfg.system.fan_pin;
    sys["heater_pin_1"]     = cfg.system.heater_pin_1;
    sys["heater_pin_2"]     = cfg.system.heater_pin_2;
    sys["target_temp"]      = cfg.system.target_temp;
    sys["log_interval_sec"] = cfg.system.log_interval_sec;

    String out;
    serializeJson(doc, out);
    return out;
  }

  // Załaduj z JSON (dla API POST)
  bool from_json(const String& json_str) {
    DynamicJsonDocument doc(4096);
    DeserializationError err = deserializeJson(doc, json_str);
    if (err) {
      Serial.printf("[CFG] JSON parse error: %s\n", err.c_str());
      return false;
    }

    if (doc.containsKey("tray_count"))
      cfg.tray_count = constrain((int)doc["tray_count"], 1, MAX_TRAYS);

    if (doc.containsKey("trays")) {
      JsonArray arr = doc["trays"].as<JsonArray>();
      int i = 0;
      for (JsonObject t : arr) {
        if (i >= MAX_TRAYS) break;
        cfg.trays[i].active           = t["active"] | cfg.trays[i].active;
        strlcpy(cfg.trays[i].species,   t["species"]  | cfg.trays[i].species, 12);
        cfg.trays[i].start_day_offset = t["start_day_offset"] | cfg.trays[i].start_day_offset;
        cfg.trays[i].pin              = t["pin"] | cfg.trays[i].pin;
        strlcpy(cfg.trays[i].label,     t["label"]    | cfg.trays[i].label, 24);
        i++;
      }
    }

    if (doc.containsKey("sensors")) {
      JsonObject s = doc["sensors"];
      cfg.sensors.ds18b20_count = constrain((int)(s["ds18b20_count"] | cfg.sensors.ds18b20_count), 0, MAX_SENSORS);
      if (s.containsKey("ds18b20_pins")) {
        JsonArray pa = s["ds18b20_pins"].as<JsonArray>();
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SENSORS && i < (int)pa.size(); i++)
          cfg.sensors.ds18b20_pins[i] = pa[i] | cfg.sensors.ds18b20_pins[i];
      }
      if (s.containsKey("ds18b20_labels")) {
        JsonArray la = s["ds18b20_labels"].as<JsonArray>();
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SENSORS && i < (int)la.size(); i++)
          strlcpy(cfg.sensors.ds18b20_labels[i], la[i] | cfg.sensors.ds18b20_labels[i], 20);
      }
      cfg.sensors.dht22_enabled        = s["dht22_enabled"]        | cfg.sensors.dht22_enabled;
      cfg.sensors.dht22_pin            = s["dht22_pin"]            | cfg.sensors.dht22_pin;
      cfg.sensors.water_level_enabled  = s["water_level_enabled"]  | cfg.sensors.water_level_enabled;
      cfg.sensors.water_level_pin      = s["water_level_pin"]      | cfg.sensors.water_level_pin;
      cfg.sensors.door_sensor_enabled  = s["door_sensor_enabled"]  | cfg.sensors.door_sensor_enabled;
      cfg.sensors.door_sensor_pin      = s["door_sensor_pin"]      | cfg.sensors.door_sensor_pin;
      cfg.sensors.aquarium_sensor_index= s["aquarium_sensor_index"]| cfg.sensors.aquarium_sensor_index;
      cfg.sensors.aquarium_target_temp = s["aquarium_target_temp"] | cfg.sensors.aquarium_target_temp;
    }

    if (doc.containsKey("diffusers")) {
      JsonObject d = doc["diffusers"];
      cfg.diffusers.count        = constrain((int)(d["count"] | cfg.diffusers.count), 0, MAX_DIFFUSERS);
      cfg.diffusers.on_time_sec  = d["on_time_sec"]  | cfg.diffusers.on_time_sec;
      cfg.diffusers.off_time_sec = d["off_time_sec"] | cfg.diffusers.off_time_sec;
      if (d.containsKey("pins")) {
        JsonArray pa = d["pins"].as<JsonArray>();
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_DIFFUSERS && i < (int)pa.size(); i++)
          cfg.diffusers.pins[i] = pa[i] | cfg.diffusers.pins[i];
      }
      if (d.containsKey("labels")) {
        JsonArray la = d["labels"].as<JsonArray>();
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_DIFFUSERS && i < (int)la.size(); i++)
          strlcpy(cfg.diffusers.labels[i], la[i] | cfg.diffusers.labels[i], 20);
      }
    }

    if (doc.containsKey("system")) {
      JsonObject sy = doc["system"];
      cfg.system.test_mode        = sy["test_mode"]        | cfg.system.test_mode;
      cfg.system.fan_pin          = sy["fan_pin"]          | cfg.system.fan_pin;
      cfg.system.heater_pin_1     = sy["heater_pin_1"]     | cfg.system.heater_pin_1;
      cfg.system.heater_pin_2     = sy["heater_pin_2"]     | cfg.system.heater_pin_2;
      cfg.system.target_temp      = sy["target_temp"]      | cfg.system.target_temp;
      cfg.system.log_interval_sec = sy["log_interval_sec"] | cfg.system.log_interval_sec;
    }
    return true;
  }

private:
  Preferences pref;

  // ── SPIFFS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  bool load_spiffs() {
    if (!SPIFFS.exists(CONFIG_PATH)) return false;
    File f = SPIFFS.open(CONFIG_PATH, "r");
    if (!f) return false;
    String json = f.readString();
    f.close();
    if (json.length() < 10) return false;
    return from_json(json);
  }

  bool save_spiffs() {
    File f = SPIFFS.open(CONFIG_PATH, "w");
    if (!f) {
      Serial.println("[CFG] Błąd zapisu SPIFFS!");
      return false;
    }
    String json = to_json();
    f.print(json);
    f.close();
    Serial.printf("[CFG] Zapisano SPIFFS (%d bajtów)\n", json.length());
    return true;
  }

  // ── Preferences (backup) ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  void save_preferences() {
    pref.begin(PREF_NAMESPACE, false);
    String json = to_json();
    pref.putString(PREF_KEY_CFG, json);
    // Oblicz prosty CRC sumy bajtów
    uint16_t crc = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < json.length(); i++) crc += (uint8_t)json[i];
    pref.putUShort(PREF_KEY_CRC, crc);
    pref.end();
    Serial.println("[CFG] Zapisano Preferences backup");
  }

  bool load_preferences() {
    pref.begin(PREF_NAMESPACE, true);
    if (!pref.isKey(PREF_KEY_CFG)) {
      pref.end();
      return false;
    }
    String json = pref.getString(PREF_KEY_CFG, "");
    uint16_t saved_crc = pref.getUShort(PREF_KEY_CRC, 0);
    pref.end();
    if (json.length() == 0) return false;

    // Weryfikacja CRC
    uint16_t crc = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < json.length(); i++) crc += (uint8_t)json[i];
    if (crc != saved_crc) {
      Serial.println("[CFG] CRC mismatch w Preferences – odrzucam");
      return false;
    }
    return from_json(json);
  }
};

// Globalna instancja
extern ConfigManager configMgr;
ConfigManager configMgr;
