// ── Klasa ConfigManager ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
class ConfigManager {
public:
  IncubatorConfig cfg;
  bool loaded_ok = false;

  // Wczytaj konfigurację: SPIFFS -> Preferences -> defaults
  bool load() {
    if (load_spiffs()) {
      Serial.println("[CFG] Wczytano z SPIFFS");
      loaded_ok = true;
      return true;
    }
    Serial.println("[CFG] SPIFFS brak/błędny, próbuję Preferences...");
    if (load_preferences()) {
      Serial.println("[CFG] Wczytano z Preferences – zapisuję do SPIFFS");
      save_spiffs();
      loaded_ok = true;
      return true;
    }
    Serial.println("[CFG] Brak konfiguracji – używam domyślnej");
    cfg = default_config();
    save();  // zapisz domyślną
    loaded_ok = true;
    return false;
  }

  // Zapisz do SPIFFS i Preferences
  bool save() {
    bool s = save_spiffs();
    save_preferences();
    return s;
  }

  // Przywróć ustawienia fabryczne
  void factory_reset() {
    cfg = default_config();
    save();
    Serial.println("[CFG] Przywrócono ustawienia fabryczne");
  }

  // Wygeneruj JSON (dla API)
  String to_json() {
    DynamicJsonDocument doc(4096);
    doc["config_version"] = cfg.config_version;
    doc["tray_count"] = cfg.tray_count;

    JsonArray trays_arr = doc.createNestedArray("trays");
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_TRAYS; i++) {
      JsonObject t = trays_arr.createNestedObject();
      t["active"]           = cfg.trays[i].active;
      t["species"]          = cfg.trays[i].species;
      t["start_day_offset"] = cfg.trays[i].start_day_offset;
      t["pin"]              = cfg.trays[i].pin;
      t["label"]            = cfg.trays[i].label;
    }

    JsonObject sens = doc.createNestedObject("sensors");
    sens["ds18b20_count"] = cfg.sensors.ds18b20_count;
    JsonArray ds_pins = sens.createNestedArray("ds18b20_pins");
    JsonArray ds_labels = sens.createNestedArray("ds18b20_labels");
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SENSORS; i++) {
      ds_pins.add(cfg.sensors.ds18b20_pins[i]);
      ds_labels.add(cfg.sensors.ds18b20_labels[i]);
    }
    sens["dht22_enabled"]          = cfg.sensors.dht22_enabled;
    sens["dht22_pin"]              = cfg.sensors.dht22_pin;
    sens["water_level_enabled"]    = cfg.sensors.water_level_enabled;
    sens["water_level_pin"]        = cfg.sensors.water_level_pin;
    sens["door_sensor_enabled"]    = cfg.sensors.door_sensor_enabled;
    sens["door_sensor_pin"]        = cfg.sensors.door_sensor_pin;
    sens["aquarium_sensor_index"]  = cfg.sensors.aquarium_sensor_index;
    sens["aquarium_target_temp"]   = cfg.sensors.aquarium_target_temp;

    JsonObject diff = doc.createNestedObject("diffusers");
    diff["count"]        = cfg.diffusers.count;
    diff["on_time_sec"]  = cfg.diffusers.on_time_sec;
    diff["off_time_sec"] = cfg.diffusers.off_time_sec;
    JsonArray diff_pins   = diff.createNestedArray("pins");
    JsonArray diff_labels = diff.createNestedArray("labels");
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_DIFFUSERS; i++) {
      diff_pins.add(cfg.diffusers.pins[i]);
      diff_labels.add(cfg.diffusers.labels[i]);
    }

    JsonObject sys = doc.createNestedObject("system");
    sys["test_mode"]        = cfg.system.test_mode;
    sys["fan_pin"]          = cfg.system.fan_pin;
    sys["heater_pin_1"]     = cfg.system.heater_pin_1;
    sys["heater_pin_2"]     = cfg.system.heater_pin_2;
    sys["target_temp"]      = cfg.system.target_temp;
    sys["log_interval_sec"] = cfg.system.log_interval_sec;

    String out;
    serializeJson(doc, out);
    return out;
  }

  // Załaduj z JSON (dla API POST)
  bool from_json(const String& json_str) {
    DynamicJsonDocument doc(4096);
    DeserializationError err = deserializeJson(doc, json_str);
    if (err) {
      Serial.printf("[CFG] JSON parse error: %s\n", err.c_str());
      return false;
    }

    // Weryfikacja wersji
    if (doc.containsKey("config_version")) {
      int ver = doc["config_version"];
      if (ver != CONFIG_VERSION) {
        Serial.printf("[CFG] Ostrzeżenie: config_version mismatch (wczytano: %d, oczekiwane: %d)\n", ver, CONFIG_VERSION);
      }
      cfg.config_version = ver;
    }

    if (doc.containsKey("tray_count"))
      cfg.tray_count = constrain((int)doc["tray_count"], 1, MAX_TRAYS);

    if (doc.containsKey("trays")) {
      JsonArray arr = doc["trays"].as<JsonArray>();
      int i = 0;
      for (JsonObject t : arr) {
        if (i >= MAX_TRAYS) break;
        cfg.trays[i].active           = t["active"] | cfg.trays[i].active;
        strlcpy(cfg.trays[i].species,   t["species"]  | cfg.trays[i].species, 12);
        cfg.trays[i].start_day_offset = t["start_day_offset"] | cfg.trays[i].start_day_offset;
        cfg.trays[i].pin              = t["pin"] | cfg.trays[i].pin;
        strlcpy(cfg.trays[i].label,     t["label"]    | cfg.trays[i].label, 24);
        i++;
      }
    }

    if (doc.containsKey("sensors")) {
      JsonObject s = doc["sensors"];
      cfg.sensors.ds18b20_count = constrain((int)(s["ds18b20_count"] | cfg.sensors.ds18b20_count), 0, MAX_SENSORS);
      if (s.containsKey("ds18b20_pins")) {
        JsonArray pa = s["ds18b20_pins"].as<JsonArray>();
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SENSORS && i < (int)pa.size(); i++)
          cfg.sensors.ds18b20_pins[i] = pa[i] | cfg.sensors.ds18b20_pins[i];
      }
      if (s.containsKey("ds18b20_labels")) {
        JsonArray la = s["ds18b20_labels"].as<JsonArray>();
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SENSORS && i < (int)la.size(); i++)
          strlcpy(cfg.sensors.ds18b20_labels[i], la[i] | cfg.sensors.ds18b20_labels[i], 20);
      }
      cfg.sensors.dht22_enabled        = s["dht22_enabled"]        | cfg.sensors.dht22_enabled;
      cfg.sensors.dht22_pin            = s["dht22_pin"]            | cfg.sensors.dht22_pin;
      cfg.sensors.water_level_enabled  = s["water_level_enabled"]  | cfg.sensors.water_level_enabled;
      cfg.sensors.water_level_pin      = s["water_level_pin"]      | cfg.sensors.water_level_pin;
      cfg.sensors.door_sensor_enabled  = s["door_sensor_enabled"]  | cfg.sensors.door_sensor_enabled;
      cfg.sensors.door_sensor_pin      = s["door_sensor_pin"]      | cfg.sensors.door_sensor_pin;
      cfg.sensors.aquarium_sensor_index= s["aquarium_sensor_index"]| cfg.sensors.aquarium_sensor_index;
      cfg.sensors.aquarium_target_temp = s["aquarium_target_temp"] | cfg.sensors.aquarium_target_temp;
    }

    if (doc.containsKey("diffusers")) {
      JsonObject d = doc["diffusers"];
      cfg.diffusers.count        = constrain((int)(d["count"] | cfg.diffusers.count), 0, MAX_DIFFUSERS);
      cfg.diffusers.on_time_sec  = d["on_time_sec"]  | cfg.diffusers.on_time_sec;
      cfg.diffusers.off_time_sec = d["off_time_sec"] | cfg.diffusers.off_time_sec;
      if (d.containsKey("pins")) {
        JsonArray pa = d["pins"].as<JsonArray>();
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_DIFFUSERS && i < (int)pa.size(); i++)
          cfg.diffusers.pins[i] = pa[i] | cfg.diffusers.pins[i];
      }
      if (d.containsKey("labels")) {
        JsonArray la = d["labels"].as<JsonArray>();
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_DIFFUSERS && i < (int)la.size(); i++)
          strlcpy(cfg.diffusers.labels[i], la[i] | cfg.diffusers.labels[i], 20);
      }
    }

    if (doc.containsKey("system")) {
      JsonObject sy = doc["system"];
      cfg.system.test_mode        = sy["test_mode"]        | cfg.system.test_mode;
      cfg.system.fan_pin          = sy["fan_pin"]          | cfg.system.fan_pin;
      cfg.system.heater_pin_1     = sy["heater_pin_1"]     | cfg.system.heater_pin_1;
      cfg.system.heater_pin_2     = sy["heater_pin_2"]     | cfg.system.heater_pin_2;
      cfg.system.target_temp      = sy["target_temp"]      | cfg.system.target_temp;
      cfg.system.log_interval_sec = sy["log_interval_sec"] | cfg.system.log_interval_sec;
    }
    return true;
  }

private:
  Preferences pref;

  // ── SPIFFS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  bool load_spiffs() {
    if (!SPIFFS.exists(CONFIG_PATH)) return false;
    File f = SPIFFS.open(CONFIG_PATH, "r");
    if (!f) return false;
    String json = f.readString();
    f.close();
    if (json.length() < 10) return false;
    return from_json(json);
  }

  bool save_spiffs() {
    File f = SPIFFS.open(CONFIG_PATH, "w");
    if (!f) {
      Serial.println("[CFG] Blad zapisu SPIFFS!");
      return false;
    }
    String json = to_json();
    f.print(json);
    f.close();
    Serial.printf("[CFG] Zapisano SPIFFS (%d bajtow)\n", json.length());
    return true;
  }

  // ── Preferences (backup) ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  void save_preferences() {
    pref.begin(PREF_NAMESPACE, false);
    String json = to_json();
    pref.putString(PREF_KEY_CFG, json);
    pref.putInt(PREF_KEY_VERSION, CONFIG_VERSION);
    // Oblicz prosty CRC sumy bajtów
    uint16_t crc = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < json.length(); i++) crc += (uint8_t)json[i];
    pref.putUShort(PREF_KEY_CRC, crc);
    pref.end();
    Serial.println("[CFG] Zapisano Preferences backup");
  }

  bool load_preferences() {
    pref.begin(PREF_NAMESPACE, true);
    if (!pref.isKey(PREF_KEY_CFG)) {
      pref.end();
      return false;
    }
    String json = pref.getString(PREF_KEY_CFG, "");
    int saved_ver = pref.getInt(PREF_KEY_VERSION, 0);
    uint16_t saved_crc = pref.getUShort(PREF_KEY_CRC, 0);
    pref.end();
    if (json.length() == 0) return false;

    // Weryfikacja CRC
    uint16_t crc = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < json.length(); i++) crc += (uint8_t)json[i];
    if (crc != saved_crc) {
      Serial.println("[CFG] CRC mismatch w Preferences – odrzucam");
      return false;
    }

    // Weryfikacja wersji
    if (saved_ver != CONFIG_VERSION) {
      Serial.printf("[CFG] Preferences version mismatch (%d vs %d) – zamieniamy\n", saved_ver, CONFIG_VERSION);
      return false;
    }

    return from_json(json);
  }
};

void save_start_time(unsigned long long t) {
  EEPROM.begin(EEPROM_SIZE);
  EEPROM.put(EEPROM_START_ADDR, t);
  EEPROM.commit();
  EEPROM.end();
}

unsigned long long load_start_time() {
  EEPROM.begin(EEPROM_SIZE);
  unsigned long long t = 0;
  EEPROM.get(EEPROM_START_ADDR, t);
  EEPROM.end();
  return (t == 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFULL) ? 0 : t;
}

// ============================================================================
// Czujniki
// ============================================================================
OneWire* ds_wire[MAX_SENSORS] = {};
DallasTemperature ds_sensor[MAX_SENSORS] = {};
DHT* dht_sensor = nullptr;

void sensors_deinit() {
  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SENSORS; i++) {
    if (ds_wire[i]) {
      delete ds_wire[i];
      ds_wire[i] = nullptr;
    }
  }
  if (dht_sensor) {
    delete dht_sensor;
    dht_sensor = nullptr;
  }
}

void sensors_init() {
  sensors_deinit();
  SensorConfig& sc = configMgr.cfg.sensors;

  for (int i = 0; i < sc.ds18b20_count && i < MAX_SENSORS; i++) {
    ds_wire[i] = new OneWire(sc.ds18b20_pins[i]);
    ds_sensor[i] = DallasTemperature(ds_wire[i]);
    ds_sensor[i].begin();
    Serial.printf("[SENSOR] DS18B20 #%d na GPIO%d (%s)\n", i, sc.ds18b20_pins[i], sc.ds18b20_labels[i]);
  }

  if (sc.dht22_enabled) {
    dht_sensor = new DHT(sc.dht22_pin, DHT22);
    dht_sensor->begin();
    Serial.printf("[SENSOR] DHT22 na GPIO%d\n", sc.dht22_pin);
  }

  if (sc.water_level_enabled) pinMode(sc.water_level_pin, INPUT);
  if (sc.door_sensor_enabled) pinMode(sc.door_sensor_pin, INPUT_PULLUP);
}

// ============================================================================
// Odczyt czujników (poprawione elapsed_ms)
// ============================================================================
void sensors_read(SensorData& data) {
  SensorConfig& sc = configMgr.cfg.sensors;
  unsigned long long now = millis();

  // Bezpieczne obliczenie elapsed_ms
  if (now >= system_start_ms) {
    data.elapsed_ms = now - system_start_ms;
  } else {
    // rollover millis()
    data.elapsed_ms = (0xFFFFFFFFULL - system_start_ms) + now + 1;
  }

  data.is_dummy = (sc.ds18b20_count == 0 && !sc.dht22_enabled);

  if (data.is_dummy) {
    float progress = min(1.0f, (float)data.elapsed_ms / 3600000.0f);
    data.temp[0] = 25.0f + progress * 12.5f;
    data.temp[1] = 25.0f + progress * 11.0f;
    data.humidity = 40.0f + progress * 20.0f;
    data.water_level = 2048;
    data.door_open = false;
    return;
  }

  // DS18B20
  for (int i = 0; i < sc.ds18b20_count && i < MAX_SENSORS; i++) {
    ds_sensor[i].requestTemperatures();
    float t = ds_sensor[i].getTempCByIndex(0);
    data.temp[i] = (t == DEVICE_DISCONNECTED_C) ? -99.0f : t;
  }
  for (int i = sc.ds18b20_count; i < MAX_SENSORS; i++) data.temp[i] = -99.0f;

  // DHT22 z retry
  if (sc.dht22_enabled && dht_sensor) {
    float h = dht_sensor->readHumidity();
    for (int retry = 0; retry < 3 && isnan(h); retry++) {
      delay(120);
      h = dht_sensor->readHumidity();
    }
    data.humidity = isnan(h) ? -1.0f : h;
  } else {
    data.humidity = -1.0f;
  }

  data.water_level = sc.water_level_enabled ? analogRead(sc.water_level_pin) : -1;
  data.door_open = sc.door_sensor_enabled ? (digitalRead(sc.door_sensor_pin) == LOW) : false;
  data.heater_pwm_pct = (int)heater_pwm_pct;
}

// ============================================================================
// Sterowanie grzałkami
// ============================================================================
#define HEATER_RAMP_MS 3600000ULL
#define HEATER_HYST 0.5f

void heaters_control(const SensorData& data) {
  float temp_chamber = data.temp[0];
  float target = configMgr.cfg.system.target_temp;

  if (data.elapsed_ms < HEATER_RAMP_MS) {
    heater_pwm_pct = (float)data.elapsed_ms / HEATER_RAMP_MS * 50.0f;
  } else {
    if (temp_chamber < target - HEATER_HYST)
      heater_pwm_pct = min(50.0f, heater_pwm_pct + 1.0f);
    else if (temp_chamber > target + HEATER_HYST)
      heater_pwm_pct = max(0.0f, heater_pwm_pct - 1.0f);
  }

  int pwm = (int)(heater_pwm_pct * 2.55f);
  ledcWrite(0, pwm);
  if (configMgr.cfg.system.heater_pin_2 >= 0) ledcWrite(1, pwm);
}

// ============================================================================
// Dyfuzory
// ============================================================================
void diffusers_control(const SensorData& data) {
  DiffuserConfig& dc = configMgr.cfg.diffusers;
  if (dc.count == 0) return;

  float hum_min, hum_max;
  tray_get_chamber_humidity(hum_min, hum_max);
  float target = (hum_min + hum_max) / 2.0f;

  unsigned long elapsed = millis() - diffuser_change_ms;

  if (data.humidity >= 0) {
    if (data.humidity < target - 5.0f) {
      if (!diffuser_on) { diffuser_on = true; diffuser_change_ms = millis(); }
    } else if (data.humidity > target + 10.0f) {
      if (diffuser_on) { diffuser_on = false; diffuser_change_ms = millis(); }
    } else {
      unsigned long on_ms = (unsigned long)dc.on_time_sec * 1000;
      unsigned long off_ms = (unsigned long)dc.off_time_sec * 1000;

      if (diffuser_on && elapsed > on_ms) { diffuser_on = false; diffuser_change_ms = millis(); }
      if (!diffuser_on && elapsed > off_ms) { diffuser_on = true; diffuser_change_ms = millis(); }
    }
  }

  for (int i = 0; i < dc.count && i < MAX_DIFFUSERS; i++) {
    if (dc.pins[i] >= 0) digitalWrite(dc.pins[i], diffuser_on ? HIGH : LOW);
  }
}

// ============================================================================
// CSV Log
// ============================================================================
void csv_write(const SensorData& data) {
  File f = SPIFFS.open("/inkubator_log.csv", "a");
  if (!f) return;
  char buf[256];
  snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%llu,%.2f,%.2f,%.2f,%d,%d,%d\n",
           data.elapsed_ms / 1000,
           data.temp[0], data.temp[1],
           data.humidity,
           data.water_level,
           data.door_open ? 1 : 0,
           (int)heater_pwm_pct);
  f.print(buf);
  f.close();
}

void csv_create_header() {
  File f = SPIFFS.open("/inkubator_log.csv", "w");
  if (f) {
    f.println("time_sec,temp_chamber,temp_secondary,humidity,water_level,door,heater_pct");
    f.close();
  }
}

// ============================================================================
// WiFi
// ============================================================================
void wifi_keepalive() {
  static unsigned long last = 0;
  if (millis() - last < 30000) return;
  last = millis();

  if (WiFi.status() != WL_CONNECTED) {
    if (wifi_connected) {
      Serial.println("[WiFi] Rozłączono - reconnect...");
      wifi_connected = false;
    }
    WiFi.reconnect();
  } else if (!wifi_connected) {
    wifi_connected = true;
    Serial.printf("[WiFi] Połączono! IP: %s\n", WiFi.localIP().toString().c_str());
    webserver_setup();
  }
}

// ============================================================================
// WEB SERVER + API (pozostaje bez większych zmian)
// ============================================================================
void webserver_setup();   // deklaracja (definicja na dole lub w innym pliku)

// ============================================================================
// SETUP
// ============================================================================
void setup() {
  Serial.begin(115200);
  delay(1000);
  Serial.println("\n=== INKUBATOR ESP32-S3 v2.0 ===");

  if (!SPIFFS.begin(true)) {
    Serial.println("CRITICAL: SPIFFS mount failed!");
    while(1) delay(1000);
  }

  configMgr.load();

  unsigned long long saved = load_start_time();
  system_start_ms = (saved > 0) ? saved : millis();
  if (saved == 0) save_start_time(system_start_ms);

  sensors_init();
  tray_init(system_start_ms);

  // PWM Grzałki
  ledcSetup(0, 5000, 8);
  ledcAttachPin(configMgr.cfg.system.heater_pin_1, 0);
  if (configMgr.cfg.system.heater_pin_2 >= 0) {
    ledcSetup(1, 5000, 8);
    ledcAttachPin(configMgr.cfg.system.heater_pin_2, 1);
  }

  // Wentylator
  if (configMgr.cfg.system.fan_pin >= 0) {
    pinMode(configMgr.cfg.system.fan_pin, OUTPUT);
    digitalWrite(configMgr.cfg.system.fan_pin, HIGH);
  }

  // Dyfuzory
  for (int i = 0; i < configMgr.cfg.diffusers.count; i++) {
    int p = configMgr.cfg.diffusers.pins[i];
    if (p >= 0) {
      pinMode(p, OUTPUT);
      digitalWrite(p, LOW);
    }
  }

  if (!SPIFFS.exists("/inkubator_log.csv")) csv_create_header();

  WiFi.mode(WIFI_STA);
  WiFi.begin(WIFI_SSID, WIFI_PASSWORD);

  Serial.print("[WiFi] Łączenie");
  for (int i = 0; i < 25 && WiFi.status() != WL_CONNECTED; i++) {
    delay(400);
    Serial.print(".");
  }

  wifi_connected = (WiFi.status() == WL_CONNECTED);
  if (wifi_connected) {
    Serial.printf("\n[WiFi] OK → http://%s\n", WiFi.localIP().toString().c_str());
    webserver_setup();
  } else {
    Serial.println("\n[WiFi] Brak połączenia - tryb offline");
  }

  Serial.println("[SETUP] Inkubator gotowy!\n");
}

// ============================================================================
// LOOP
// ============================================================================
void loop() {
  unsigned long long now = millis();
  bool test_mode = configMgr.cfg.system.test_mode;

  wifi_keepalive();
  if (wifi_connected) webServer.handleClient();

  static unsigned long last_sensor_t = 0;
  unsigned long sensor_interval = test_mode ? 8000 : 25000;
  if (now - last_sensor_t > sensor_interval) {
    last_sensor_t = now;
    sensors_read(last_sensor);
    heaters_control(last_sensor);
    diffusers_control(last_sensor);
  }

  static unsigned long last_tray_t = 0;
  if (now - last_tray_t > 25000) {
    last_tray_t = now;
    tray_update_all(now);
  }

  static unsigned long last_hist_t = 0;
  if (now - last_hist_t > (test_mode ? 45000 : 240000)) {
    last_hist_t = now;
    history[history_idx] = {
      last_sensor.elapsed_ms / 60000,
      last_sensor.temp[0],
      last_sensor.temp[1],
      last_sensor.humidity,
      (int)heater_pwm_pct
    };
    history_idx = (history_idx + 1) % HISTORY_SIZE;
  }

  static unsigned long last_log_t = 0;
  if (now - last_log_t > (unsigned long)configMgr.cfg.system.log_interval_sec * 1000) {
    last_log_t = now;
    csv_write(last_sensor);
  }

  // Zapis start time co 10 minut
  static unsigned long last_eeprom = 0;
  if (now - last_eeprom > 600000) {
    last_eeprom = now;
    save_start_time(system_start_ms);
  }

  delay(30);
}

// ============================================================================
// WEB SERVER + API (definicja poniżej)
// ============================================================================
void webserver_setup();   // forward declaration

// ============================================================================
// Definicje API endpoints (Web Server)
// ============================================================================
void handle_api_status() {
  DynamicJsonDocument doc(2048);
  doc["uptime_ms"] = millis();
  doc["elapsed_since_start_ms"] = last_sensor.elapsed_ms;
  doc["system_start_time_ms"] = system_start_ms;

  JsonArray temps = doc.createNestedArray("temperatures");
  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SENSORS; i++) {
    temps.add(last_sensor.temp[i]);
  }
  doc["humidity"] = last_sensor.humidity;
  doc["water_level"] = last_sensor.water_level;
  doc["door_open"] = last_sensor.door_open;
  doc["heater_pwm_pct"] = (int)heater_pwm_pct;
  doc["diffuser_on"] = diffuser_on;

  JsonArray trays_arr = doc.createNestedArray("trays");
  for (int i = 0; i < configMgr.cfg.tray_count; i++) {
    const Tray* t = tray_get(i);
    if (t) {
      JsonObject to = trays_arr.createNestedObject();
      to["id"] = t->id;
      to["species"] = t->species;
      to["day"] = t->current_day;
      to["target_temp"] = t->target_temp;
      to["target_humidity"] = t->target_humidity;
      to["rotating"] = t->rotating;
    }
  }

  String json;
  serializeJson(doc, json);
  webServer.send(200, "application/json", json);
}

void handle_api_config() {
  String json = configMgr.to_json();
  webServer.send(200, "application/json", json);
}

void handle_api_config_update() {
  if (webServer.hasArg("plain")) {
    String body = webServer.arg("plain");
    if (configMgr.from_json(body)) {
      configMgr.save();
      sensors_init();
      handle_api_status();
      return;
    }
  }
  webServer.send(400, "text/plain", "Config update failed");
}

void handle_api_history() {
  DynamicJsonDocument doc(4096);
  JsonArray arr = doc.createNestedArray("history");
  for (int i = 0; i < HISTORY_SIZE; i++) {
    int idx = (history_idx + i) % HISTORY_SIZE;
    if (history[idx].timestamp_min > 0) {
      JsonObject h = arr.createNestedObject();
      h["timestamp_min"] = history[idx].timestamp_min;
      h["temp_chamber"] = history[idx].temp_chamber;
      h["temp_secondary"] = history[idx].temp_secondary;
      h["humidity"] = history[idx].humidity;
      h["heater_pct"] = history[idx].heater_pct;
    }
  }
  String json;
  serializeJson(doc, json);
  webServer.send(200, "application/json", json);
}

void handle_api_reset_day() {
  int tray_id = 0;
  if (webServer.hasArg("tray")) tray_id = webServer.arg("tray").toInt();
  tray_reset_day(tray_id);
  webServer.send(200, "text/plain", "Day reset");
}

void handle_api_set_day() {
  int tray_id = 0, day = 1;
  if (webServer.hasArg("tray")) tray_id = webServer.arg("tray").toInt();
  if (webServer.hasArg("day")) day = webServer.arg("day").toInt();
  tray_set_day(tray_id, day);
  webServer.send(200, "text/plain", "Day updated");
}

void handle_api_reboot() {
  webServer.send(200, "text/plain", "Rebooting...");
  delay(1000);
  ESP.restart();
}

void handle_root() {
  if (!SPIFFS.exists("/index.html")) {
    webServer.send(404, "text/plain", "index.html not found");
    return;
  }
  File f = SPIFFS.open("/index.html", "r");
  webServer.streamFile(f, "text/html");
  f.close();
}

void handle_not_found() {
  webServer.send(404, "text/plain", "Not Found");
}

void webserver_setup() {
  webServer.on("/", handle_root);
  webServer.on("/api/status", HTTP_GET, handle_api_status);
  webServer.on("/api/config", HTTP_GET, handle_api_config);
  webServer.on("/api/config", HTTP_POST, handle_api_config_update);
  webServer.on("/api/history", HTTP_GET, handle_api_history);
  webServer.on("/api/reset-day", HTTP_GET, handle_api_reset_day);
  webServer.on("/api/set-day", HTTP_GET, handle_api_set_day);
  webServer.on("/api/reboot", HTTP_GET, handle_api_reboot);
  webServer.onNotFound(handle_not_found);
  webServer.begin();
  Serial.println("[WebServer] Uruchomiony na porcie 80");
}

// ============================================================================
// SETUP
// ============================================================================
void setup() {
  Serial.begin(115200);
  delay(1000);
  Serial.println("\n=== INKUBATOR ESP32-S3 v2.0 ===");

  if (!SPIFFS.begin(true)) {
    Serial.println("CRITICAL: SPIFFS mount failed!");
    while(1) delay(1000);
  }

  configMgr.load();

  unsigned long long saved = load_start_time();
  system_start_ms = (saved > 0) ? saved : millis();
  if (saved == 0) save_start_time(system_start_ms);

  sensors_init();
  tray_init(system_start_ms);

  // PWM Grzałki (kanały LEDC)
  ledcSetup(0, 5000, 8);
  ledcAttachPin(configMgr.cfg.system.heater_pin_1, 0);
  if (configMgr.cfg.system.heater_pin_2 >= 0) {
    ledcSetup(1, 5000, 8);
    ledcAttachPin(configMgr.cfg.system.heater_pin_2, 1);
  }
  Serial.printf("[LEDC] Heater PWM: pin1=%d, pin2=%d\n", 
                configMgr.cfg.system.heater_pin_1, 
                configMgr.cfg.system.heater_pin_2);

  // Wentylator
  if (configMgr.cfg.system.fan_pin >= 0) {
    pinMode(configMgr.cfg.system.fan_pin, OUTPUT);
    digitalWrite(configMgr.cfg.system.fan_pin, HIGH);
    Serial.printf("[FAN] Pin %d\n", configMgr.cfg.system.fan_pin);
  }

  // Dyfuzory
  for (int i = 0; i < configMgr.cfg.diffusers.count; i++) {
    int p = configMgr.cfg.diffusers.pins[i];
    if (p >= 0) {
      pinMode(p, OUTPUT);
      digitalWrite(p, LOW);
      Serial.printf("[DIFFUSER] %d: GPIO%d\n", i, p);
    }
  }

  if (!SPIFFS.exists("/inkubator_log.csv")) csv_create_header();

  WiFi.mode(WIFI_STA);
  WiFi.begin(WIFI_SSID, WIFI_PASSWORD);

  Serial.print("[WiFi] Laczenie");
  for (int i = 0; i < 25 && WiFi.status() != WL_CONNECTED; i++) {
    delay(400);
    Serial.print(".");
  }

  wifi_connected = (WiFi.status() == WL_CONNECTED);
  if (wifi_connected) {
    Serial.printf("\n[WiFi] OK → http://%s\n", WiFi.localIP().toString().c_str());
    webserver_setup();
  } else {
    Serial.println("\n[WiFi] Brak polaczenia - tryb offline");
  }

  Serial.println("[SETUP] Inkubator gotowy!\n");
}

// ============================================================================
// LOOP
// ============================================================================
void loop() {
  unsigned long long now = millis();
  bool test_mode = configMgr.cfg.system.test_mode;

  wifi_keepalive();
  if (wifi_connected) webServer.handleClient();

  // Odczyt czujników i sterowanie grzałkami
  static unsigned long last_sensor_t = 0;
  unsigned long sensor_interval = test_mode ? 8000 : 25000;
  if (now - last_sensor_t > sensor_interval) {
    last_sensor_t = now;
    sensors_read(last_sensor);
    heaters_control(last_sensor);
    diffusers_control(last_sensor);
  }

  // Aktualizacja tac
  static unsigned long last_tray_t = 0;
  if (now - last_tray_t > 25000) {
    last_tray_t = now;
    tray_update_all(now);
  }

  // Historia (dla wykresu)
  static unsigned long last_hist_t = 0;
  if (now - last_hist_t > (test_mode ? 45000 : 240000)) {
    last_hist_t = now;
    history[history_idx] = {
      (int)(last_sensor.elapsed_ms / 60000),
      last_sensor.temp[0],
      last_sensor.temp[1],
      last_sensor.humidity,
      (int)heater_pwm_pct
    };
    history_idx = (history_idx + 1) % HISTORY_SIZE;
  }

  // CSV logging
  static unsigned long last_log_t = 0;
  if (now - last_log_t > (unsigned long)configMgr.cfg.system.log_interval_sec * 1000) {
    last_log_t = now;
    csv_write(last_sensor);
  }

  // Zapis start time co 10 minut
  static unsigned long last_eeprom = 0;
  if (now - last_eeprom > 600000) {
    last_eeprom = now;
    save_start_time(system_start_ms);
  }

  delay(30);
}

#pragma once
#include <Arduino.h>
#include <SPIFFS.h>
#include <Preferences.h>
#include <ArduinoJson.h>

// ============================================================================
// CONFIG MANAGER – wersja ulepszona
// ============================================================================

#define MAX_TRAYS       3
#define MAX_SENSORS     4
#define MAX_DIFFUSERS   3
#define CONFIG_PATH     "/config.json"
#define PREF_NAMESPACE  "inkubator"
#define PREF_KEY_CFG    "config_json"
#define PREF_KEY_CRC    "config_crc"

#define CONFIG_VERSION  102   // Zwiększ przy zmianie struktury!

// ── Struktury konfiguracji ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
struct TrayConfig {
  bool active;
  char species[12];
  int start_day_offset;
  int pin;
  char label[24];
};

struct SensorConfig {
  int ds18b20_count;
  int ds18b20_pins[MAX_SENSORS];
  char ds18b20_labels[MAX_SENSORS][20];
  bool dht22_enabled;
  int dht22_pin;
  bool water_level_enabled;
  int water_level_pin;
  bool door_sensor_enabled;
  int door_sensor_pin;
  int aquarium_sensor_index;
  float aquarium_target_temp;
};

struct DiffuserConfig {
  int count;
  int pins[MAX_DIFFUSERS];
  char labels[MAX_DIFFUSERS][20];
  int on_time_sec;
  int off_time_sec;
};

struct SystemConfig {
  bool test_mode;
  int fan_pin;
  int heater_pin_1;
  int heater_pin_2;
  float target_temp;
  int log_interval_sec;
};

struct IncubatorConfig {
  int config_version = CONFIG_VERSION;
  int tray_count;
  TrayConfig trays[MAX_TRAYS];
  SensorConfig sensors;
  DiffuserConfig diffusers;
  SystemConfig system;
};

// ── Domyślna konfiguracja (naprawione konflikty pinów) ─────────────────────
inline IncubatorConfig default_config() {
  IncubatorConfig cfg = {};

  cfg.config_version = CONFIG_VERSION;
  cfg.tray_count = 2;

  // Taca 0 - Kaczki
  cfg.trays[0].active = true;
  strlcpy(cfg.trays[0].species, "DUCK", sizeof(cfg.trays[0].species));
  cfg.trays[0].start_day_offset = 0;
  cfg.trays[0].pin = 18;
  strlcpy(cfg.trays[0].label, "Taca 1 – Kaczki", sizeof(cfg.trays[0].label));

  // Taca 1 - Kury
  cfg.trays[1].active = true;
  strlcpy(cfg.trays[1].species, "CHICKEN", sizeof(cfg.trays[1].species));
  cfg.trays[1].start_day_offset = 7;
  cfg.trays[1].pin = 19;
  strlcpy(cfg.trays[1].label, "Taca 2 – Kury", sizeof(cfg.trays[1].label));

  // Taca 2 - rezerwa
  cfg.trays[2].active = false;
  strlcpy(cfg.trays[2].species, "CHICKEN", sizeof(cfg.trays[2].species));
  cfg.trays[2].start_day_offset = 0;
  cfg.trays[2].pin = 20;
  strlcpy(cfg.trays[2].label, "Taca 3 – (wolna)", sizeof(cfg.trays[2].label));

  // Sensory
  cfg.sensors.ds18b20_count = 2;
  int ds_pins_default[] = {6, 7, 4, 5};
  const char* ds_labels_default[] = {"Komora jaj", "Akwarium", "Zewnętrzny", "Dodatkowy"};
  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SENSORS; i++) {
    cfg.sensors.ds18b20_pins[i] = ds_pins_default[i];
    strlcpy(cfg.sensors.ds18b20_labels[i], ds_labels_default[i], 20);
  }

  cfg.sensors.dht22_enabled = true;
  cfg.sensors.dht22_pin = 8;
  cfg.sensors.water_level_enabled = false;
  cfg.sensors.water_level_pin = 9;
  cfg.sensors.door_sensor_enabled = false;
  cfg.sensors.door_sensor_pin = 10;
  cfg.sensors.aquarium_sensor_index = 1;           // DS #1 = Akwarium
  cfg.sensors.aquarium_target_temp = 36.0f;

  // Dyfuzory
  cfg.diffusers.count = 1;
  int diff_pins_default[] = {21, 22, 23};
  const char* diff_labels_default[] = {"Nawilżacz 1", "Nawilżacz 2", "Nawilżacz 3"};
  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_DIFFUSERS; i++) {
    cfg.diffusers.pins[i] = diff_pins_default[i];
    strlcpy(cfg.diffusers.labels[i], diff_labels_default[i], 20);
  }
  cfg.diffusers.on_time_sec = 60;
  cfg.diffusers.off_time_sec = 300;

  // System
  cfg.system.test_mode = true;
  cfg.system.fan_pin = 5;
  cfg.system.heater_pin_1 = 1;
  cfg.system.heater_pin_2 = 2;
  cfg.system.target_temp = 37.5f;
  cfg.system.log_interval_sec = 600;

  return cfg;
}

// ── Główna klasa ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
class ConfigManager {
public:
  IncubatorConfig cfg;
  bool loaded_ok = false;

  bool load() {
    if (load_spiffs()) {
      Serial.println("[CFG] Wczytano z SPIFFS");
      loaded_ok = true;
      return true;
    }

    Serial.println("[CFG] Brak poprawnego pliku w SPIFFS, próbuję Preferences...");
    if (load_preferences()) {
      Serial.println("[CFG] Wczytano z Preferences – zapisuję do SPIFFS");
      save_spiffs();
      loaded_ok = true;
      return true;
    }

    Serial.println("[CFG] Używam konfiguracji domyślnej");
    cfg = default_config();
    save();
    loaded_ok = true;
    return false;
  }

  bool save() {
    bool ok = save_spiffs();
    save_preferences();
    return ok;
  }

  void factory_reset() {
    cfg = default_config();
    save();
    Serial.println("[CFG] Przywrócono ustawienia fabryczne");
  }

  String to_json();
  bool from_json(const String& json_str);

private:
  Preferences pref;

  bool load_spiffs();
  bool save_spiffs();
  void save_preferences();
  bool load_preferences();
};

// ── Globalna instancja ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
extern ConfigManager configMgr;
ConfigManager configMgr;

#pragma once
#include <Arduino.h>
#include "incubation_schedule.h"
#include "config_manager.h"

// ============================================================================
// TRAY CONTROLLER – poprawiona wersja
// ============================================================================

#define MAX_TRAYS 3

// ── Stan jednej tacy ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
struct TrayState {
  int index;
  bool active;
  const SpeciesInfo* species_info;
  unsigned long long start_millis;     // 64-bit czas startu
  int current_day;                     // 0 = jeszcze nie wystartowała
  int days_remaining;
  bool in_lockdown;
  bool should_rotate;
  float target_humidity_min;
  float target_humidity_max;
  float target_temp;
  int pin;
  bool pin_active;
  const IncubationDay* today;
};

// ── Zmienne globalne ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
TrayState tray_states[MAX_TRAYS];
unsigned long long global_start_millis = 0;

// ── Inicjalizacja tac ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
void tray_init(unsigned long long base_start_millis) {
  global_start_millis = base_start_millis;

  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_TRAYS; i++) {
    TrayConfig& cfg_t = configMgr.cfg.trays[i];
    TrayState& st = tray_states[i];

    st.index = i;
    st.active = cfg_t.active && (i < configMgr.cfg.tray_count);
    st.pin = cfg_t.pin;
    st.species_info = get_species(cfg_t.species);

    // Obliczenie czasu startu z offsetu
    unsigned long long offset_ms = (unsigned long long)cfg_t.start_day_offset * 86400000ULL;
    st.start_millis = base_start_millis + offset_ms;

    if (st.pin >= 0) {
      pinMode(st.pin, OUTPUT);
      digitalWrite(st.pin, LOW);
    }

    Serial.printf("[TRAY %d] %s | %s | offset: %d dni | pin: %d | %s\n",
      i,
      cfg_t.label,
      st.species_info ? st.species_info->name : "???",
      cfg_t.start_day_offset,
      st.pin,
      st.active ? "AKTYWNA" : "NIEAKTYWNA");
  }
}

// ── Aktualizacja stanu jednej tacy (bezpieczna wersja) ─────────────────────
void tray_update_state(TrayState& st, unsigned long long now_millis) {
  if (!st.active || !st.species_info) {
    st.pin_active = false;
    if (st.pin >= 0) digitalWrite(st.pin, LOW);
    st.current_day = 0;
    st.in_lockdown = false;
    st.should_rotate = false;
    return;
  }

  const SpeciesInfo* sp = st.species_info;

  // Bezpieczne obliczenie upływu czasu
  long long elapsed_ms = (now_millis >= st.start_millis) ?
                         (now_millis - st.start_millis) :
                         0;   // jeszcze nie wystartowała

  if (elapsed_ms < 0) elapsed_ms = 0;

  st.current_day = (int)(elapsed_ms / 86400000LL) + 1;

  if (st.current_day > sp->total_days) {
    st.current_day = sp->total_days;
  }

  st.days_remaining = (st.current_day >= sp->total_days) ? 0 : (sp->total_days - st.current_day + 1);
  st.today = get_day(sp, st.current_day);

  if (!st.today) return;

  st.in_lockdown = st.today->lockdown;
  st.should_rotate = st.today->turn && !st.today->lockdown;

  st.target_humidity_min = st.today->humidity_min;
  st.target_humidity_max = st.today->humidity_max;
  st.target_temp = (st.today->temp_min + st.today->temp_max) / 2.0f;

  // Sterowanie pinem (obrót)
  st.pin_active = st.should_rotate;
  if (st.pin >= 0) {
    digitalWrite(st.pin, st.pin_active ? HIGH : LOW);
  }
}

// ── Aktualizacja wszystkich tac ────────────────────────────────────────────
void tray_update_all(unsigned long long now_millis) {
  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_TRAYS; i++) {
    tray_update_state(tray_states[i], now_millis);
  }
}

// ── Zmiana gatunku tacy ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
void tray_set_species(int tray_idx, const char* species_id) {
  if (tray_idx < 0 || tray_idx >= MAX_TRAYS) return;

  strlcpy(configMgr.cfg.trays[tray_idx].species, species_id, 12);
  tray_states[tray_idx].species_info = get_species(species_id);
  configMgr.save();
}

// ── Ustawienie konkretnego dnia tacy ───────────────────────────────────────
bool tray_set_day(int tray_idx, int day, unsigned long long now_millis) {
  if (tray_idx < 0 || tray_idx >= MAX_TRAYS) return false;
  if (day < 1) day = 1;

  const SpeciesInfo* sp = tray_states[tray_idx].species_info;
  if (!sp) return false;
  if (day > sp->total_days) day = sp->total_days;

  unsigned long long delta_ms = (unsigned long long)(day - 1) * 86400000ULL;

  if (delta_ms > now_millis) {
    Serial.println("[TRAY] Błąd: Nie można ustawić dnia z ujemnym czasem");
    return false;
  }

  unsigned long long new_start = now_millis - delta_ms;
  tray_states[tray_idx].start_millis = new_start;

  // Obliczenie offsetu względem globalnego startu
  long long offset_ms = (long long)new_start - (long long)global_start_millis;
  configMgr.cfg.trays[tray_idx].start_day_offset = (int)(offset_ms / 86400000LL);

  configMgr.save();
  tray_update_state(tray_states[tray_idx], now_millis);

  return true;
}

// ── Aktywacja / dezaktywacja tacy ──────────────────────────────────────────
void tray_set_active(int tray_idx, bool active) {
  if (tray_idx < 0 || tray_idx >= MAX_TRAYS) return;

  configMgr.cfg.trays[tray_idx].active = active;
  tray_states[tray_idx].active = active;

  if (!active && tray_states[tray_idx].pin >= 0) {
    digitalWrite(tray_states[tray_idx].pin, LOW);
  }

  configMgr.save();
}

// ── Obliczenie docelowej wilgotności komory ────────────────────────────────
void tray_get_chamber_humidity(float& out_min, float& out_max) {
  out_min = 50.0f;
  out_max = 65.0f;

  bool any_lockdown = false;
  bool any_active = false;

  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_TRAYS; i++) {
    TrayState& st = tray_states[i];
    if (!st.active || !st.today) continue;

    any_active = true;
    if (st.in_lockdown) {
      any_lockdown = true;
      out_min = max(out_min, st.target_humidity_min);
      out_max = max(out_max, st.target_humidity_max);
    }
  }

  if (!any_lockdown && any_active) {
    float hi_min = 40.0f, lo_max = 80.0f;
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_TRAYS; i++) {
      TrayState& st = tray_states[i];
      if (!st.active || !st.today) continue;
      hi_min = max(hi_min, st.target_humidity_min);
      lo_max = min(lo_max, st.target_humidity_max);
    }
    if (hi_min <= lo_max) {
      out_min = hi_min;
      out_max = lo_max;
    } else {
      float avg = (hi_min + lo_max) / 2.0f;
      out_min = avg - 2.0f;
      out_max = avg + 2.0f;
    }
  }
}

// ── JSON status tac (dla webowego interfejsu) ──────────────────────────────
String tray_status_json(unsigned long long now_millis) {
  tray_update_all(now_millis);

  DynamicJsonDocument doc(8192);
  JsonArray traysArr = doc.createNestedArray("trays");

  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_TRAYS; i++) {
    TrayState& st = tray_states[i];
    JsonObject t = traysArr.createNestedObject();

    long long ms_to_start = (long long)st.start_millis - (long long)now_millis;
    int hours_to_start = (ms_to_start > 0) ? (int)(ms_to_start / 3600000LL) : 0;

    t["index"] = i;
    t["active"] = st.active;
    t["label"] = configMgr.cfg.trays[i].label;
    t["species_id"] = st.species_info ? st.species_info->id : "?";
    t["species_name"] = st.species_info ? st.species_info->name : "?";
    t["total_days"] = st.species_info ? st.species_info->total_days : 0;
    t["current_day"] = st.current_day;
    t["days_remaining"] = st.days_remaining;
    t["hours_to_start"] = hours_to_start;
    t["in_lockdown"] = st.in_lockdown;
    t["should_rotate"] = st.should_rotate;
    t["pin"] = st.pin;
    t["pin_active"] = st.pin_active;
    t["hum_min"] = st.target_humidity_min;
    t["hum_max"] = st.target_humidity_max;
    t["target_temp"] = st.target_temp;
    t["notes"] = (st.today && st.today->notes[0]) ? st.today->notes : "";
    t["start_day_offset"] = configMgr.cfg.trays[i].start_day_offset;
  }

  float ch_min, ch_max;
  tray_get_chamber_humidity(ch_min, ch_max);
  JsonObject chamber = doc.createNestedObject("chamber");
  chamber["humidity_min"] = ch_min;
  chamber["humidity_max"] = ch_max;

  String output;
  serializeJson(doc, output);
  return output;
}

      padding: 10px 12px;
      border: 1px solid #ccc;
      border-radius: 8px;
      font-size: 14.5px;
    }

    .toggle-group {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 12px 0;
    }
    .toggle {
      width: 50px; height: 26px;
      appearance: none;
      background: #ccc;
      border-radius: 13px;
      cursor: pointer;
      position: relative;
    }
    .toggle:checked { background: var(--primary); }
    .toggle::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      width: 22px; height: 22px;
      background: white;
      border-radius: 50%;
      top: 2px; left: 2px;
      transition: 0.3s;
    }
    .toggle:checked::after { left: 26px; }

    #toast {
      position: fixed;
      bottom: 25px;
      right: 25px;
      background: #333;
      color: white;
      padding: 15px 22px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
      display: none;
      z-index: 10000;
      min-width: 300px;
    }
    .alert { padding: 14px 18px; border-radius: 10px; margin: 12px 0; font-size: 14.5px; }
    .alert-success { background:#d4edda; color:#155724; }
    .alert-danger  { background:#f8d7da; color:#721c24; }
    .alert-warning { background:#fff3cd; color:#856404; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="container">
  <div class="header">
    <h1>🥚 Inkubator Monitor</h1>
    <p id="hdr-sub">Ładowanie systemu...</p>
  </div>

  <div class="tabs">
    <button class="tab active" onclick="showTab('dashboard')">📊 Dashboard</button>
    <button class="tab" onclick="showTab('trays')">🗂️ Tace</button>
    <button class="tab" onclick="showTab('schedule')">📋 Harmonogram</button>
    <button class="tab" onclick="showTab('config')">⚙️ Konfiguracja</button>
  </div>

  <!-- DASHBOARD -->
  <div id="tab-dashboard" class="tab-panel active">
    <div id="alert-bar" class="alert" style="display:none"></div>
    
    <div class="grid-2">
      <div class="card" id="card-temp">
        <div class="val-label">Temperatura komory</div>
        <div class="val-big" id="val-temp">--.-°C</div>
        <div id="val-temp-aq" style="margin-top:8px;font-size:15px;"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="card green">
        <div class="val-label">Wilgotność komory</div>
        <div class="val-big" id="val-hum">--%</div>
        <div class="val-label" id="val-hum-target">Cel: -- – -- %</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="card" style="margin:20px 0">
      <h3>🔧 Status systemów</h3>
      <div id="sys-status" style="font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.7;"></div>
    </div>

    <div id="dash-trays" class="grid-3"></div>

    <div class="card">
      <h3>📈 Historia pomiarów</h3>
      <canvas id="chart" style="height: 320px; margin-top:10px;"></canvas>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- TACE -->
  <div id="tab-trays" class="tab-panel">
    <div id="trays-container"></div>
  </div>

  <!-- HARMONOGRAM -->
  <div id="tab-schedule" class="tab-panel">
    <div class="form-group">
      <label>Wybierz gatunek</label>
      <select id="sched-species" onchange="loadSchedule()" style="width:100%;padding:12px;">
        <option value="CHICKEN">🐔 Kura (21 dni)</option>
        <option value="DUCK">🦆 Kaczka (28 dni)</option>
        <option value="GOOSE">🦢 Gęś (30 dni)</option>
        <option value="QUAIL">🥚 Przepiórka (17 dni)</option>
        <option value="GUINEA">🐦 Perliczka (26 dni)</option>
        <option value="PHEASANT">🦚 Bażant (24 dni)</option>
      </select>
    </div>
    <div id="sched-info" class="alert"></div>
    <div style="overflow-x:auto;">
      <table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:14px;">
        <thead><tr style="background:#667eea;color:white;">
          <th style="padding:10px;text-align:left;">Dzień</th>
          <th style="padding:10px;">Temperatura</th>
          <th style="padding:10px;">Wilgotność</th>
          <th>Obrót</th>
          <th>Lockdown</th>
          <th>Uwagi</th>
        </tr></thead>
        <tbody id="sched-body"></tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- KONFIGURACJA -->
  <div id="tab-config" class="tab-panel">
    <button onclick="factoryReset()" class="btn-danger" style="float:right;margin-bottom:10px;">⚠️ Factory Reset</button>
    <h2>Konfiguracja urządzenia</h2>
    <div id="cfg-alert" class="alert" style="display:none"></div>
    <div id="config-form"></div>

    <div style="margin-top:30px;text-align:center;">
      <button class="btn-primary" onclick="saveConfig()" style="width:100%;max-width:400px;padding:16px;font-size:17px;">
        💾 Zapisz konfigurację
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="toast"></div>

<script>
// ==================== GŁÓWNY KOD JS ====================
let currentChart = null;
let currentConfig = null;

function showTab(tab) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
  
  document.getElementById(`tab-${tab}`).classList.add('active');
  const tabs = ['dashboard','trays','schedule','config'];
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab')[tabs.indexOf(tab)].classList.add('active');

  if (tab === 'trays') loadTrays();
  if (tab === 'schedule') loadSchedule();
  if (tab === 'config') loadConfig();
}

function toast(msg, error = false) {
  const t = document.getElementById('toast');
  t.textContent = msg;
  t.style.background = error ? '#dc3545' : '#333';
  t.style.display = 'block';
  setTimeout(() => t.style.display = 'none', 4500);
}

async function api(url, method = 'GET', body = null) {
  try {
    const opts = { method, headers: {} };
    if (body) {
      opts.body = JSON.stringify(body);
      opts.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';
    }
    const res = await fetch(url, opts);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
    return await res.json();
  } catch (e) {
    toast("Brak połączenia z inkubatorem!", true);
    throw e;
  }
}

// ==================== DASHBOARD ====================
async function refreshDashboard() {
  try {
    const [status, trays] = await Promise.all([api('/api/status'), api('/api/trays')]);
    renderDashboard(status, trays);
  } catch(e) {}
}

function renderDashboard(s, traysData) {
  // Temperatura
  document.getElementById('val-temp').textContent = (s.temp_chamber || 0).toFixed(1) + '°C';
  const tempCard = document.getElementById('card-temp');
  tempCard.className = s.test_mode ? 'card' : (Math.abs(s.temp_chamber - s.target_temp) < 0.6 ? 'card green' : 'card red');

  // Wilgotność
  document.getElementById('val-hum').textContent = Math.round(s.humidity) + '%';
  document.getElementById('val-hum-target').textContent = `Cel: ${s.humidity_target_min}–${s.humidity_target_max}%`;

  // Akwarium
  document.getElementById('val-temp-aq').innerHTML = 
    s.aquarium_ok !== undefined ? `Akwarium: ${(s.temp_aquarium||0).toFixed(1)}°C ${s.aquarium_ok ? '✓' : '⚠️'}` : '';

  // Status
  let html = `
    <div>Grzałka: <strong>${s.heater_pwm}%</strong></div>
    <div>Dyfuzor: <strong>${s.diffuser_on ? 'ON 💧' : 'OFF'}</strong></div>
    <div>Drzwi: <strong>${s.door_open ? 'OTWARTE ⚠️' : 'Zamknięte ✓'}</strong></div>
    <div>Tryb: <strong>${s.test_mode ? 'TESTOWY (Dummy)' : 'Normalny'}</strong></div>
  `;
  document.getElementById('sys-status').innerHTML = html;

  // Alert
  const alertEl = document.getElementById('alert-bar');
  if (s.alert && s.alert.length > 3) {
    alertEl.style.display = 'block';
    alertEl.textContent = s.alert;
    alertEl.className = 'alert alert-danger';
  } else {
    alertEl.style.display = 'none';
  }

  renderDashTrays(traysData);
}

// ==================== TACE ====================
async function loadTrays() {
  try {
    const data = await api('/api/trays');
    renderTrays(data);
  } catch(e) {}
}

function renderTrays(data) {
  // Implementacja renderowania tac (podobna jak wcześniej)
  const container = document.getElementById('trays-container');
  container.innerHTML = data.trays.map(t => `
    <div class="card ${t.in_lockdown ? 'red' : 'green'}">
      <h3>${t.label} ${t.in_lockdown ? '🛑 LOCKDOWN' : ''}</h3>
      <p><strong>${t.species_name}</strong> — Dzień ${t.current_day}/${t.total_days}</p>
      <p>Wilgotność: ${t.hum_min}–${t.hum_max}%</p>
    </div>
  `).join('');
}

// ==================== KONFIGURACJA (pełna) ====================
async function loadConfig() {
  try {
    currentConfig = await api('/api/config');
    renderFullConfigForm(currentConfig);
  } catch(e) { toast("Nie udało się wczytać konfiguracji", true); }
}

function renderFullConfigForm(cfg) {
  // Tutaj w pełnej wersji byłby bardzo rozbudowany formularz.
  // Dla czytelności zostawiam placeholder – mogę rozwinąć dalej jeśli potrzebujesz.
  document.getElementById('config-form').innerHTML = `
    <p><strong>Konfiguracja załadowana pomyślnie.</strong></p>
    <p>Wersja: ${cfg.config_version || 'brak'}</p>
    <p>Liczba tac: ${cfg.tray_count}</p>
    <p>DS18B20: ${cfg.sensors?.ds18b20_count} szt.</p>
  `;
}

async function saveConfig() {
  if (!currentConfig) return toast("Brak konfiguracji do zapisania", true);
  try {
    const response = await api('/api/config', 'POST', currentConfig);
    toast("✅ Konfiguracja zapisana pomyślnie!", false);
  } catch(e) {}
}

async function factoryReset() {
  if (!confirm("Czy na pewno przywrócić ustawienia fabryczne?\n\nStracisz całą konfigurację!")) return;
  try {
    await api('/api/config', 'POST', { factory_reset: true });
    toast("Przywrócono ustawienia fabryczne. Restartuję stronę...");
    setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 2000);
  } catch(e) {}
}

// ==================== INICJALIZACJA ====================
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  showTab('dashboard');
  setInterval(refreshDashboard, 18000);
  refreshDashboard();
});
</script>
</body>
</html>  ale sprawdz czy czegos nie pousuwałem

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pl">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Inkubator Monitor</title>
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.1/dist/chart.umd.min.js"></script>
  <style>
    :root { --primary: #667eea; --accent: #764ba2; }
    * { margin:0; padding:0; box-sizing:border-box; }
    body {
      font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea, #764ba2);
      min-height: 100vh;
      padding: 15px;
      color: #333;
    }
    .container {
      max-width: 1180px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      background: #fff;
      border-radius: 20px;
      box-shadow: 0 20px 70px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .header {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--accent));
      color: white;
      padding: 25px 20px;
      text-align: center;
    }
    .header h1 { font-size: 29px; margin-bottom: 6px; }
    .header p { font-size: 14px; opacity: 0.9; }
    .tabs {
      display: flex;
      background: #f0f2f5;
      border-bottom: 2px solid #ddd;
    }
    .tab {
      flex: 1;
      padding: 15px;
      text-align: center;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: #555;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      border: none;
      background: none;
    }
    .tab.active {
      background: white;
      color: var(--primary);
      border-bottom: 4px solid var(--primary);
      margin-bottom: -2px;
    }
    .tab-panel { display: none; padding: 20px; }
    .tab-panel.active { display: block; }

    .grid-2 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr)); gap: 16px; }
    .grid-3 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr)); gap: 16px; }

    .card {
      background: #f8f9fa;
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 18px;
      border-left: 6px solid var(--primary);
    }
    .card.green { border-left-color: #28a745; }
    .card.red { border-left-color: #dc3545; }
    .card.blue { border-left-color: #17a2b8; }
    .card.accent { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--accent)); color: white; border: none; }
    .card h3 { margin-bottom: 12px; color: #333; }
    .card.accent h3 { color: white; }

    .val-big { font-size: 34px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; margin: 8px 0; }
    .val-label { font-size: 12px; color: #666; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.6px; margin-bottom: 4px; }

    button {
      padding: 10px 16px;
      border: none;
      border-radius: 8px;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.25s;
    }
    button:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.2); }

    .btn-primary { background: var(--primary); color: white; }
    .btn-danger { background: #dc3545; color: white; }
    .btn-success { background: #28a745; color: white; }
    .btn-warning { background: #ffc107; color: #333; }
    .btn-secondary { background: #6c757d; color: white; }
    .btn-group { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin: 12px 0; }

    .form-group { margin-bottom: 16px; }
    .form-group label {
      display: block;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: #444;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }
    .form-group input, .form-group select {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 10px 12px;
      border: 1px solid #ccc;
      border-radius: 8px;
      font-size: 14px;
    }
    .form-group input:focus, .form-group select:focus {
      outline: none;
      border-color: var(--primary);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(102,126,234,0.15);
    }

    .alert { padding: 14px 18px; border-radius: 10px; margin: 12px 0; font-size: 14px; }
    .alert-success { background:#d4edda; color:#155724; border: 1px solid #c3e6cb; }
    .alert-danger { background:#f8d7da; color:#721c24; border: 1px solid #f5c6cb; }
    .alert-warning { background:#fff3cd; color:#856404; border: 1px solid #ffeaa7; }

    table {
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      font-size: 14px;
      margin-top: 12px;
    }
    table th {
      background: var(--primary);
      color: white;
      padding: 10px;
      text-align: left;
    }
    table td {
      padding: 10px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #eee;
    }
    table tr:hover { background: #f8f9fa; }

    #toast {
      position: fixed;
      bottom: 25px;
      right: 25px;
      background: #333;
      color: white;
      padding: 15px 22px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
      display: none;
      z-index: 10000;
      min-width: 300px;
    }

    .srow {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 10px 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #eee;
    }
    .srow:last-child { border-bottom: none; }

    .badge {
      display: inline-block;
      padding: 4px 8px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
    }
    .badge-ok { background: #d4edda; color: #155724; }
    .badge-warn { background: #fff3cd; color: #856404; }
    .badge-err { background: #f8d7da; color: #721c24; }

    @media(max-width: 768px) {
      .grid-2, .grid-3 { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .tabs { flex-wrap: wrap; }
      .tab { font-size: 12px; padding: 10px; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="container">
  <div class="header">
    <h1>🥚 Inkubator Monitor</h1>
    <p id="hdr-sub">Ładowanie systemu... <span id="conn-indicator"></span></p>
  </div>

  <div class="tabs">
    <button class="tab active" onclick="showTab('dashboard')">📊 Dashboard</button>
    <button class="tab" onclick="showTab('trays')">🗂️ Tace</button>
    <button class="tab" onclick="showTab('schedule')">📋 Harmonogram</button>
    <button class="tab" onclick="showTab('control')">⚙️ Kontrola</button>
  </div>

  <!-- DASHBOARD -->
  <div id="tab-dashboard" class="tab-panel active">
    <div id="alert-bar" class="alert" style="display:none"></div>
    
    <div class="card accent">
      <div class="val-label">🎯 DNI DO WYLĘGU</div>
      <div class="val-big" id="val-hatch-days">--</div>
      <div id="val-day-info" style="font-size: 14px; margin-top: 8px;"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="grid-2" style="margin-top: 16px;">
      <div class="card" id="card-temp">
        <div class="val-label">🥚 Temperatura jaj</div>
        <div class="val-big" id="val-temp">--.-°C</div>
      </div>
      <div class="card green">
        <div class="val-label">💧 Wilgotność</div>
        <div class="val-big" id="val-hum">--%</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="card blue" style="margin-top: 16px;">
      <div class="val-label">🐠 Temperatura akwarium</div>
      <div class="val-big" id="val-temp-aq">--.-°C</div>
      <div id="val-aq-status" style="margin-top: 8px; font-size: 13px;"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="card" style="margin-top: 16px;">
      <h3>🔧 Status systemów</h3>
      <div class="srow">
        <span>Grzałka PWM:</span>
        <span id="sys-heater"><strong>--%</strong></span>
      </div>
      <div class="srow">
        <span>Dyfuzor:</span>
        <span id="sys-diffuser"><strong>OFF</strong></span>
      </div>
      <div class="srow">
        <span>Drzwi:</span>
        <span id="sys-door"><strong>--</strong></span>
      </div>
      <div class="srow">
        <span>Tryb:</span>
        <span id="sys-mode"><strong>--</strong></span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div id="dash-trays" class="grid-3" style="margin-top: 16px;"></div>

    <div class="card" style="margin-top: 16px;">
      <h3>📈 Historia (ostatnie 2-3 godz.)</h3>
      <div style="height: 320px; position: relative;">
        <canvas id="chart"></canvas>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="btn-group" style="margin-top: 20px; justify-content: center;">
      <button class="btn-primary" onclick="resetDay()">⏱️ Reset Dnia (→ 1)</button>
      <button class="btn-warning" onclick="showSetDay()">📍 Ustaw Dzień</button>
      <button class="btn-success" onclick="rebootDevice()">🔄 Restart</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- TACE -->
  <div id="tab-trays" class="tab-panel">
    <div id="trays-container"></div>
  </div>

  <!-- HARMONOGRAM -->
  <div id="tab-schedule" class="tab-panel">
    <div class="form-group">
      <label>Wybierz gatunek</label>
      <select id="sched-species" onchange="loadSchedule()">
        <option value="CHICKEN">🐔 Kura (21 dni)</option>
        <option value="DUCK">🦆 Kaczka (28 dni)</option>
        <option value="GOOSE">🦢 Gęś (30 dni)</option>
        <option value="QUAIL">🥚 Przepiórka (17 dni)</option>
        <option value="GUINEA">🐦 Perliczka (26 dni)</option>
        <option value="PHEASANT">🦚 Bażant (24 dni)</option>
      </select>
    </div>
    <table>
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th>Dzień</th>
          <th>Temperatura</th>
          <th>Wilgotność</th>
          <th>Obrót</th>
          <th>Lockdown</th>
          <th>Uwagi</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody id="sched-body"></tbody>
    </table>
  </div>

  <!-- KONTROLA -->
  <div id="tab-control" class="tab-panel">
    <div id="cfg-alert" class="alert" style="display:none"></div>

    <h3>🎮 Szybkie Akcje</h3>
    <div class="btn-group">
      <button class="btn-danger" onclick="resetDay()">⏱️ Reset Dnia</button>
      <button class="btn-warning" onclick="showSetDay()">📍 Ustaw Dzień</button>
      <button class="btn-success" onclick="rebootDevice()">🔄 Restart ESP32</button>
    </div>

    <h3 style="margin-top: 20px;">ℹ️ Informacje systemowe</h3>
    <div class="card">
      <div class="srow">
        <span>Status czujników:</span>
        <span id="info-sensors" class="badge badge-ok">--</span>
      </div>
      <div class="srow">
        <span>Uptime:</span>
        <span id="info-uptime">--</span>
      </div>
      <div class="srow">
        <span>Konfiguracja:</span>
        <span id="info-config">v--</span>
      </div>
      <div class="srow">
        <span>WiFi:</span>
        <span id="info-wifi">--</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="toast"></div>

<script>
// ==================== GLOBALNE ZMIENNE ====================
let currentChart = null;
let statusData = null;
let scheduleCache = {};

// ==================== UTILITY ====================
function showTab(tab) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
  
  document.getElementById(`tab-${tab}`).classList.add('active');
  const tabs = ['dashboard', 'trays', 'schedule', 'control'];
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab')[tabs.indexOf(tab)].classList.add('active');

  if (tab === 'trays') loadTrays();
  if (tab === 'schedule') loadSchedule();
  if (tab === 'control') loadControl();
}

function toast(msg, error = false) {
  const t = document.getElementById('toast');
  t.textContent = msg;
  t.style.background = error ? '#dc3545' : '#28a745';
  t.style.display = 'block';
  setTimeout(() => t.style.display = 'none', 4000);
}

async function apiCall(url, method = 'GET', body = null) {
  try {
    const opts = { method, headers: {} };
    if (body) {
      opts.body = JSON.stringify(body);
      opts.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';
    }
    const res = await fetch(url, opts);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
    return await res.json();
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('API Error:', e);
    throw e;
  }
}

// ==================== DASHBOARD ====================
async function refreshDashboard() {
  try {
    statusData = await apiCall('/api/status');
    renderDashboard(statusData);
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Dashboard error:', e);
    document.getElementById('conn-indicator').textContent = '❌ Offline';
  }
}

function renderDashboard(data) {
  // Dni do wylęgu
  const daysRemaining = data.days_remaining !== undefined ? data.days_remaining : '?';
  document.getElementById('val-hatch-days').textContent = daysRemaining;
  document.getElementById('val-day-info').textContent = data.current_day ? `Dzień ${data.current_day} inkubacji` : '';

  // Temperatura
  const tempVal = data.temp_chamber !== undefined ? data.temp_chamber.toFixed(1) : '--.-';
  document.getElementById('val-temp').textContent = tempVal + '°C';
  const tempCard = document.getElementById('card-temp');
  const tempOk = data.target_temp && Math.abs(data.temp_chamber - data.target_temp) < 0.6;
  tempCard.className = tempOk ? 'card green' : 'card red';

  // Wilgotność
  const humVal = data.humidity !== undefined ? Math.round(data.humidity) : '--';
  document.getElementById('val-hum').textContent = humVal + '%';

  // Akwarium
  const aqTemp = data.temp_aquarium !== undefined ? data.temp_aquarium.toFixed(1) : '--.-';
  document.getElementById('val-temp-aq').textContent = aqTemp + '°C';
  const aqStatus = data.aquarium_ok ? '✓ OK' : '⚠️ Ostrzeżenie';
  document.getElementById('val-aq-status').textContent = aqStatus;

  // Status systemów
  document.getElementById('sys-heater').innerHTML = `<strong>${data.heater_pwm || 0}%</strong>`;
  document.getElementById('sys-diffuser').innerHTML = `<strong>${data.diffuser_on ? '💧 ON' : 'OFF'}</strong>`;
  document.getElementById('sys-door').innerHTML = `<strong class="${data.door_open ? 'badge-err' : 'badge-ok'}">${data.door_open ? '⚠️ OTWARTE' : '✓ Zamknięte'}</strong>`;
  document.getElementById('sys-mode').innerHTML = `<strong>${data.test_mode ? '🧪 TEST' : '✓ Normalny'}</strong>`;

  // Alert
  const alertBar = document.getElementById('alert-bar');
  if (data.alert && data.alert.length > 3) {
    alertBar.style.display = 'block';
    alertBar.textContent = data.alert;
    alertBar.className = 'alert alert-danger';
  } else {
    alertBar.style.display = 'none';
  }

  // Mini karty tac
  renderDashTrays(data);

  // Wykres
  updateChart(data);

  document.getElementById('conn-indicator').textContent = '✅ Online';
}

function renderDashTrays(data) {
  const container = document.getElementById('dash-trays');
  if (!data.trays || data.trays.length === 0) {
    container.innerHTML = '<p>Brak tac</p>';
    return;
  }

  container.innerHTML = data.trays.map(t => `
    <div class="card ${t.in_lockdown ? 'red' : 'green'}">
      <div class="val-label">${t.label || `Taca ${t.index}`}</div>
      <div style="font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; margin: 6px 0;">${t.species_name || '?'}</div>
      <div style="font-size: 13px;">Dzień: <strong>${t.current_day || 0}/${t.total_days || 0}</strong></div>
      <div style="font-size: 13px;">Wilg: ${t.hum_min || 0}–${t.hum_max || 0}%</div>
      ${t.in_lockdown ? '<div style="margin-top: 8px; color: #721c24; font-weight: 600;">🛑 LOCKDOWN</div>' : ''}
    </div>
  `).join('');
}

// ==================== CHART ====================
function updateChart(data) {
  if (!data.history || data.history.length === 0) return;

  const ctx = document.getElementById('chart');
  if (!ctx) return;

  const labels = data.history.map(h => {
    const min = h.timestamp_min || 0;
    const hours = Math.floor(min / 60);
    const mins = min % 60;
    return `${hours}:${String(mins).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  });

  const tempData = data.history.map(h => h.temp_chamber || 0);
  const aqTempData = data.history.map(h => h.temp_aquarium || 0);
  const humData = data.history.map(h => h.humidity || 0);

  if (currentChart) currentChart.destroy();

  currentChart = new Chart(ctx, {
    type: 'line',
    data: {
      labels,
      datasets: [
        {
          label: 'Temperatura jaj (°C)',
          data: tempData,
          borderColor: '#667eea',
          backgroundColor: 'rgba(102, 126, 234, 0.1)',
          yAxisID: 'y',
          tension: 0.3,
          borderWidth: 2,
        },
        {
          label: 'Temperatura akwarium (°C)',
          data: aqTempData,
          borderColor: '#17a2b8',
          backgroundColor: 'rgba(23, 162, 184, 0.1)',
          yAxisID: 'y',
          tension: 0.3,
          borderWidth: 2,
        },
        {
          label: 'Wilgotność (%)',
          data: humData,
          borderColor: '#28a745',
          backgroundColor: 'rgba(40, 167, 69, 0.1)',
          yAxisID: 'y1',
          tension: 0.3,
          borderWidth: 2,
        }
      ]
    },
    options: {
      responsive: true,
      maintainAspectRatio: false,
      interaction: { mode: 'index', intersect: false },
      scales: {
        y: {
          type: 'linear',
          position: 'left',
          title: { display: true, text: 'Temperatura (°C)' },
          min: 30,
          max: 40,
        },
        y1: {
          type: 'linear',
          position: 'right',
          title: { display: true, text: 'Wilgotność (%)' },
          min: 0,
          max: 100,
          grid: { drawOnChartArea: false }
        }
      }
    }
  });
}

// ==================== TACE ====================
async function loadTrays() {
  try {
    const data = await apiCall('/api/trays');
    renderTrays(data);
  } catch (e) {
    document.getElementById('trays-container').innerHTML = '<div class="alert alert-danger">Nie udało się załadować tac</div>';
  }
}

function renderTrays(data) {
  if (!data.trays) {
    document.getElementById('trays-container').innerHTML = '<p>Brak danych</p>';
    return;
  }

  const html = data.trays.map((t, i) => `
    <div class="card ${t.in_lockdown ? 'red' : 'green'}">
      <h3>${t.label || `Taca ${i}`} ${t.in_lockdown ? '🛑' : ''}</h3>
      <div class="srow">
        <span>Gatunek:</span>
        <span><strong>${t.species_name || '?'}</strong></span>
      </div>
      <div class="srow">
        <span>Postęp:</span>
        <span><strong>Dzień ${t.current_day}/${t.total_days}</strong></span>
      </div>
      <div class="srow">
        <span>Lockdown:</span>
        <span><strong class="${t.in_lockdown ? 'badge-err' : 'badge-ok'}">${t.in_lockdown ? '🛑 TAK' : '✗ Nie'}</strong></span>
      </div>
      <div class="srow">
        <span>Obrót:</span>
        <span><strong>${t.should_rotate ? '↻ TAK' : '✓ STOP'}</strong></span>
      </div>
      <div class="srow">
        <span>Temperatura (cel):</span>
        <span><strong>${(t.target_temp || 0).toFixed(1)}°C</strong></span>
      </div>
      <div class="srow">
        <span>Wilgotność (cel):</span>
        <span><strong>${t.hum_min || 0}–${t.hum_max || 0}%</strong></span>
      </div>
      ${t.notes ? `<div style="margin-top: 10px; font-style: italic; color: #666;">📝 ${t.notes}</div>` : ''}
    </div>
  `).join('');

  document.getElementById('trays-container').innerHTML = html;
}

// ==================== HARMONOGRAM ====================
async function loadSchedule() {
  const species = document.getElementById('sched-species').value;
  if (!species) return;

  try {
    if (!scheduleCache[species]) {
      const data = await apiCall(`/api/schedule?species=${species}`);
      scheduleCache[species] = data;
    }
    renderSchedule(scheduleCache[species]);
  } catch (e) {
    document.getElementById('sched-body').innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" style="text-align: center; color: red;">Błąd wczytywania</td></tr>';
  }
}

function renderSchedule(data) {
  if (!data || !data.schedule) {
    document.getElementById('sched-body').innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6">Brak danych</td></tr>';
    return;
  }

  const rows = data.schedule.map(day => `
    <tr>
      <td>${day.day}</td>
      <td>${day.temp_min}–${day.temp_max}°C</td>
      <td>${day.humidity_min}–${day.humidity_max}%</td>
      <td>${day.turn ? '✓ Tak' : '✗ Nie'}</td>
      <td>${day.lockdown ? '✓ TAK' : '✗ Nie'}</td>
      <td>${day.notes || ''}</td>
    </tr>
  `).join('');

  document.getElementById('sched-body').innerHTML = rows;
}

// ==================== KONTROLA ====================
async function loadControl() {
  try {
    const data = await apiCall('/api/status');
    document.getElementById('info-sensors').textContent = data.test_mode ? '🧪 TEST DANE' : '✓ Czujniki OK';
    document.getElementById('info-uptime').textContent = formatUptime(data.uptime_ms || 0);
    document.getElementById('info-config').textContent = `v${data.config_version || '?'}`;
    document.getElementById('info-wifi').textContent = data.wifi_connected ? '✓ Połączony' : '❌ Brak';
  } catch (e) {}
}

function formatUptime(ms) {
  const s = Math.floor(ms / 1000);
  const m = Math.floor(s / 60) % 60;
  const h = Math.floor(s / 3600) % 24;
  const d = Math.floor(s / 86400);
  return `${d}d ${h}h ${m}m`;
}

// ==================== AKCJE ====================
function showSetDay() {
  const day = prompt('Ustaw dzień inkubacji (1-30):', '1');
  if (day && !isNaN(day)) {
    setDay(parseInt(day));
  }
}

async function resetDay() {
  if (!confirm('Reset licznika na dzień 1? Historia zostanie zachowana.')) return;
  try {
    await apiCall('/api/reset-day', 'GET');
    toast('✅ Dzień zresetowany!');
    setTimeout(() => refreshDashboard(), 500);
  } catch (e) {
    toast('❌ Błąd resetu', true);
  }
}

async function setDay(day) {
  if (day < 1 || day > 30) {
    toast('❌ Dzień musi być między 1 a 30', true);
    return;
  }
  try {
    await apiCall(`/api/set-day?day=${day}`, 'GET');
    toast(`✅ Dzień ustawiony na ${day}`);
    setTimeout(() => refreshDashboard(), 500);
  } catch (e) {
    toast('❌ Błąd ustawiania dnia', true);
  }
}

async function rebootDevice() {
  if (!confirm('Zrestartować urządzenie?\n\nStrona przeładuje się za ~10 sekund.')) return;
  try {
    await apiCall('/api/reboot', 'GET');
    toast('🔄 Restartuję...');
    setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 10000);
  } catch (e) {
    toast('❌ Błąd restartu', true);
  }
}

// ==================== INICJALIZACJA ====================
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  showTab('dashboard');
  refreshDashboard();
  setInterval(refreshDashboard, 20000);  // Refresh co 20 sekund
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
