<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pl">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Inkubator Monitor</title>
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.1/dist/chart.umd.min.js"></script>
  <style>
    :root { --primary: #667eea; --accent: #764ba2; }
    * { margin:0; padding:0; box-sizing:border-box; }
    body {
      font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea, #764ba2);
      min-height: 100vh;
      padding: 15px;
      color: #333;
    }
    .container {
      max-width: 1180px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      background: #fff;
      border-radius: 20px;
      box-shadow: 0 20px 70px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .header {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--accent));
      color: white;
      padding: 25px 20px;
      text-align: center;
    }
    .header h1 { font-size: 29px; margin-bottom: 6px; }
    .header p { font-size: 14px; opacity: 0.9; }
    .tabs {
      display: flex;
      background: #f0f2f5;
      border-bottom: 2px solid #ddd;
    }
    .tab {
      flex: 1;
      padding: 15px;
      text-align: center;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: #555;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      border: none;
      background: none;
    }
    .tab.active {
      background: white;
      color: var(--primary);
      border-bottom: 4px solid var(--primary);
      margin-bottom: -2px;
    }
    .tab-panel { display: none; padding: 20px; }
    .tab-panel.active { display: block; }

    .grid-2 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr)); gap: 16px; }
    .grid-3 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr)); gap: 16px; }

    .card {
      background: #f8f9fa;
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 18px;
      border-left: 6px solid var(--primary);
    }
    .card.green { border-left-color: #28a745; }
    .card.red { border-left-color: #dc3545; }
    .card.blue { border-left-color: #17a2b8; }
    .card.accent { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--accent)); color: white; border: none; }
    .card h3 { margin-bottom: 12px; color: #333; }
    .card.accent h3 { color: white; }

    .val-big { font-size: 34px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; margin: 8px 0; }
    .val-label { font-size: 12px; color: #666; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.6px; margin-bottom: 4px; }

    button {
      padding: 10px 16px;
      border: none;
      border-radius: 8px;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.25s;
    }
    button:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.2); }

    .btn-primary { background: var(--primary); color: white; }
    .btn-danger { background: #dc3545; color: white; }
    .btn-success { background: #28a745; color: white; }
    .btn-warning { background: #ffc107; color: #333; }
    .btn-secondary { background: #6c757d; color: white; }
    .btn-group { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin: 12px 0; }

    .form-group { margin-bottom: 16px; }
    .form-group label {
      display: block;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: #444;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }
    .form-group input, .form-group select {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 10px 12px;
      border: 1px solid #ccc;
      border-radius: 8px;
      font-size: 14px;
    }
    .form-group input:focus, .form-group select:focus {
      outline: none;
      border-color: var(--primary);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(102,126,234,0.15);
    }

    .alert { padding: 14px 18px; border-radius: 10px; margin: 12px 0; font-size: 14px; }
    .alert-success { background:#d4edda; color:#155724; border: 1px solid #c3e6cb; }
    .alert-danger { background:#f8d7da; color:#721c24; border: 1px solid #f5c6cb; }
    .alert-warning { background:#fff3cd; color:#856404; border: 1px solid #ffeaa7; }

    table {
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      font-size: 14px;
      margin-top: 12px;
    }
    table th {
      background: var(--primary);
      color: white;
      padding: 10px;
      text-align: left;
    }
    table td {
      padding: 10px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #eee;
    }
    table tr:hover { background: #f8f9fa; }

    #toast {
      position: fixed;
      bottom: 25px;
      right: 25px;
      background: #333;
      color: white;
      padding: 15px 22px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
      display: none;
      z-index: 10000;
      min-width: 300px;
    }

    .srow {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 10px 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #eee;
    }
    .srow:last-child { border-bottom: none; }

    .badge {
      display: inline-block;
      padding: 4px 8px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
    }
    .badge-ok { background: #d4edda; color: #155724; }
    .badge-warn { background: #fff3cd; color: #856404; }
    .badge-err { background: #f8d7da; color: #721c24; }

    @media(max-width: 768px) {
      .grid-2, .grid-3 { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .tabs { flex-wrap: wrap; }
      .tab { font-size: 12px; padding: 10px; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="container">
  <div class="header">
    <h1>🥚 Inkubator Monitor</h1>
    <p id="hdr-sub">Ładowanie systemu... <span id="conn-indicator"></span></p>
  </div>

  <div class="tabs">
    <button class="tab active" onclick="showTab('dashboard')">📊 Dashboard</button>
    <button class="tab" onclick="showTab('trays')">🗂️ Tace</button>
    <button class="tab" onclick="showTab('schedule')">📋 Harmonogram</button>
    <button class="tab" onclick="showTab('control')">⚙️ Kontrola</button>
  </div>

  <!-- DASHBOARD -->
  <div id="tab-dashboard" class="tab-panel active">
    <div id="alert-bar" class="alert" style="display:none"></div>
    
    <div class="card accent">
      <div class="val-label">🎯 DNI DO WYLĘGU</div>
      <div class="val-big" id="val-hatch-days">--</div>
      <div id="val-day-info" style="font-size: 14px; margin-top: 8px;"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="grid-2" style="margin-top: 16px;">
      <div class="card" id="card-temp">
        <div class="val-label">🥚 Temperatura jaj</div>
        <div class="val-big" id="val-temp">--.-°C</div>
      </div>
      <div class="card green">
        <div class="val-label">💧 Wilgotność</div>
        <div class="val-big" id="val-hum">--%</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="card blue" style="margin-top: 16px;">
      <div class="val-label">🐠 Temperatura akwarium</div>
      <div class="val-big" id="val-temp-aq">--.-°C</div>
      <div id="val-aq-status" style="margin-top: 8px; font-size: 13px;"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="card" style="margin-top: 16px;">
      <h3>🔧 Status systemów</h3>
      <div class="srow">
        <span>Grzałka PWM:</span>
        <span id="sys-heater"><strong>--%</strong></span>
      </div>
      <div class="srow">
        <span>Dyfuzor:</span>
        <span id="sys-diffuser"><strong>OFF</strong></span>
      </div>
      <div class="srow">
        <span>Drzwi:</span>
        <span id="sys-door"><strong>--</strong></span>
      </div>
      <div class="srow">
        <span>Tryb:</span>
        <span id="sys-mode"><strong>--</strong></span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div id="dash-trays" class="grid-3" style="margin-top: 16px;"></div>

    <div class="card" style="margin-top: 16px;">
      <h3>📈 Historia (ostatnie 2-3 godz.)</h3>
      <div style="height: 320px; position: relative;">
        <canvas id="chart"></canvas>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="btn-group" style="margin-top: 20px; justify-content: center;">
      <button class="btn-primary" onclick="resetDay()">⏱️ Reset Dnia (→ 1)</button>
      <button class="btn-warning" onclick="showSetDay()">📍 Ustaw Dzień</button>
      <button class="btn-success" onclick="rebootDevice()">🔄 Restart</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- TACE -->
  <div id="tab-trays" class="tab-panel">
    <div id="trays-container"></div>
  </div>

  <!-- HARMONOGRAM -->
  <div id="tab-schedule" class="tab-panel">
    <div class="form-group">
      <label>Wybierz gatunek</label>
      <select id="sched-species" onchange="loadSchedule()">
        <option value="CHICKEN">🐔 Kura (21 dni)</option>
        <option value="DUCK">🦆 Kaczka (28 dni)</option>
        <option value="GOOSE">🦢 Gęś (30 dni)</option>
        <option value="QUAIL">🥚 Przepiórka (17 dni)</option>
        <option value="GUINEA">🐦 Perliczka (26 dni)</option>
        <option value="PHEASANT">🦚 Bażant (24 dni)</option>
      </select>
    </div>
    <table>
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th>Dzień</th>
          <th>Temperatura</th>
          <th>Wilgotność</th>
          <th>Obrót</th>
          <th>Lockdown</th>
          <th>Uwagi</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody id="sched-body"></tbody>
    </table>
  </div>

  <!-- KONTROLA -->
  <div id="tab-control" class="tab-panel">
    <div id="cfg-alert" class="alert" style="display:none"></div>

    <h3>🎮 Szybkie Akcje</h3>
    <div class="btn-group">
      <button class="btn-danger" onclick="resetDay()">⏱️ Reset Dnia</button>
      <button class="btn-warning" onclick="showSetDay()">📍 Ustaw Dzień</button>
      <button class="btn-success" onclick="rebootDevice()">🔄 Restart ESP32</button>
    </div>

    <h3 style="margin-top: 20px;">ℹ️ Informacje systemowe</h3>
    <div class="card">
      <div class="srow">
        <span>Status czujników:</span>
        <span id="info-sensors" class="badge badge-ok">--</span>
      </div>
      <div class="srow">
        <span>Uptime:</span>
        <span id="info-uptime">--</span>
      </div>
      <div class="srow">
        <span>Konfiguracja:</span>
        <span id="info-config">v--</span>
      </div>
      <div class="srow">
        <span>WiFi:</span>
        <span id="info-wifi">--</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="toast"></div>

<script>
// ==================== GLOBALNE ZMIENNE ====================
let currentChart = null;
let statusData = null;
let scheduleCache = {};

// ==================== UTILITY ====================
function showTab(tab) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
  
  document.getElementById(`tab-${tab}`).classList.add('active');
  const tabs = ['dashboard', 'trays', 'schedule', 'control'];
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab')[tabs.indexOf(tab)].classList.add('active');

  if (tab === 'trays') loadTrays();
  if (tab === 'schedule') loadSchedule();
  if (tab === 'control') loadControl();
}

function toast(msg, error = false) {
  const t = document.getElementById('toast');
  t.textContent = msg;
  t.style.background = error ? '#dc3545' : '#28a745';
  t.style.display = 'block';
  setTimeout(() => t.style.display = 'none', 4000);
}

async function apiCall(url, method = 'GET', body = null) {
  try {
    const opts = { method, headers: {} };
    if (body) {
      opts.body = JSON.stringify(body);
      opts.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';
    }
    const res = await fetch(url, opts);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
    return await res.json();
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('API Error:', e);
    throw e;
  }
}

// ==================== DASHBOARD ====================
async function refreshDashboard() {
  try {
    statusData = await apiCall('/api/status');
    renderDashboard(statusData);
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Dashboard error:', e);
    document.getElementById('conn-indicator').textContent = '❌ Offline';
  }
}

function renderDashboard(data) {
  // Dni do wylęgu
  const daysRemaining = data.days_remaining !== undefined ? data.days_remaining : '?';
  document.getElementById('val-hatch-days').textContent = daysRemaining;
  document.getElementById('val-day-info').textContent = data.current_day ? `Dzień ${data.current_day} inkubacji` : '';

  // Temperatura
  const tempVal = data.temp_chamber !== undefined ? data.temp_chamber.toFixed(1) : '--.-';
  document.getElementById('val-temp').textContent = tempVal + '°C';
  const tempCard = document.getElementById('card-temp');
  const tempOk = data.target_temp && Math.abs(data.temp_chamber - data.target_temp) < 0.6;
  tempCard.className = tempOk ? 'card green' : 'card red';

  // Wilgotność
  const humVal = data.humidity !== undefined ? Math.round(data.humidity) : '--';
  document.getElementById('val-hum').textContent = humVal + '%';

  // Akwarium
  const aqTemp = data.temp_aquarium !== undefined ? data.temp_aquarium.toFixed(1) : '--.-';
  document.getElementById('val-temp-aq').textContent = aqTemp + '°C';
  const aqStatus = data.aquarium_ok ? '✓ OK' : '⚠️ Ostrzeżenie';
  document.getElementById('val-aq-status').textContent = aqStatus;

  // Status systemów
  document.getElementById('sys-heater').innerHTML = `<strong>${data.heater_pwm || 0}%</strong>`;
  document.getElementById('sys-diffuser').innerHTML = `<strong>${data.diffuser_on ? '💧 ON' : 'OFF'}</strong>`;
  document.getElementById('sys-door').innerHTML = `<strong class="${data.door_open ? 'badge-err' : 'badge-ok'}">${data.door_open ? '⚠️ OTWARTE' : '✓ Zamknięte'}</strong>`;
  document.getElementById('sys-mode').innerHTML = `<strong>${data.test_mode ? '🧪 TEST' : '✓ Normalny'}</strong>`;

  // Alert
  const alertBar = document.getElementById('alert-bar');
  if (data.alert && data.alert.length > 3) {
    alertBar.style.display = 'block';
    alertBar.textContent = data.alert;
    alertBar.className = 'alert alert-danger';
  } else {
    alertBar.style.display = 'none';
  }

  // Mini karty tac
  renderDashTrays(data);

  // Wykres
  updateChart(data);

  document.getElementById('conn-indicator').textContent = '✅ Online';
}

function renderDashTrays(data) {
  const container = document.getElementById('dash-trays');
  if (!data.trays || data.trays.length === 0) {
    container.innerHTML = '<p>Brak tac</p>';
    return;
  }

  container.innerHTML = data.trays.map(t => `
    <div class="card ${t.in_lockdown ? 'red' : 'green'}">
      <div class="val-label">${t.label || `Taca ${t.index}`}</div>
      <div style="font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; margin: 6px 0;">${t.species_name || '?'}</div>
      <div style="font-size: 13px;">Dzień: <strong>${t.current_day || 0}/${t.total_days || 0}</strong></div>
      <div style="font-size: 13px;">Wilg: ${t.hum_min || 0}–${t.hum_max || 0}%</div>
      ${t.in_lockdown ? '<div style="margin-top: 8px; color: #721c24; font-weight: 600;">🛑 LOCKDOWN</div>' : ''}
    </div>
  `).join('');
}

// ==================== CHART ====================
function updateChart(data) {
  if (!data.history || data.history.length === 0) return;

  const ctx = document.getElementById('chart');
  if (!ctx) return;

  const labels = data.history.map(h => {
    const min = h.timestamp_min || 0;
    const hours = Math.floor(min / 60);
    const mins = min % 60;
    return `${hours}:${String(mins).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  });

  const tempData = data.history.map(h => h.temp_chamber || 0);
  const aqTempData = data.history.map(h => h.temp_aquarium || 0);
  const humData = data.history.map(h => h.humidity || 0);

  if (currentChart) currentChart.destroy();

  currentChart = new Chart(ctx, {
    type: 'line',
    data: {
      labels,
      datasets: [
        {
          label: 'Temperatura jaj (°C)',
          data: tempData,
          borderColor: '#667eea',
          backgroundColor: 'rgba(102, 126, 234, 0.1)',
          yAxisID: 'y',
          tension: 0.3,
          borderWidth: 2,
        },
        {
          label: 'Temperatura akwarium (°C)',
          data: aqTempData,
          borderColor: '#17a2b8',
          backgroundColor: 'rgba(23, 162, 184, 0.1)',
          yAxisID: 'y',
          tension: 0.3,
          borderWidth: 2,
        },
        {
          label: 'Wilgotność (%)',
          data: humData,
          borderColor: '#28a745',
          backgroundColor: 'rgba(40, 167, 69, 0.1)',
          yAxisID: 'y1',
          tension: 0.3,
          borderWidth: 2,
        }
      ]
    },
    options: {
      responsive: true,
      maintainAspectRatio: false,
      interaction: { mode: 'index', intersect: false },
      scales: {
        y: {
          type: 'linear',
          position: 'left',
          title: { display: true, text: 'Temperatura (°C)' },
          min: 30,
          max: 40,
        },
        y1: {
          type: 'linear',
          position: 'right',
          title: { display: true, text: 'Wilgotność (%)' },
          min: 0,
          max: 100,
          grid: { drawOnChartArea: false }
        }
      }
    }
  });
}

// ==================== TACE ====================
async function loadTrays() {
  try {
    const data = await apiCall('/api/trays');
    renderTrays(data);
  } catch (e) {
    document.getElementById('trays-container').innerHTML = '<div class="alert alert-danger">Nie udało się załadować tac</div>';
  }
}

function renderTrays(data) {
  if (!data.trays) {
    document.getElementById('trays-container').innerHTML = '<p>Brak danych</p>';
    return;
  }

  const html = data.trays.map((t, i) => `
    <div class="card ${t.in_lockdown ? 'red' : 'green'}">
      <h3>${t.label || `Taca ${i}`} ${t.in_lockdown ? '🛑' : ''}</h3>
      <div class="srow">
        <span>Gatunek:</span>
        <span><strong>${t.species_name || '?'}</strong></span>
      </div>
      <div class="srow">
        <span>Postęp:</span>
        <span><strong>Dzień ${t.current_day}/${t.total_days}</strong></span>
      </div>
      <div class="srow">
        <span>Lockdown:</span>
        <span><strong class="${t.in_lockdown ? 'badge-err' : 'badge-ok'}">${t.in_lockdown ? '🛑 TAK' : '✗ Nie'}</strong></span>
      </div>
      <div class="srow">
        <span>Obrót:</span>
        <span><strong>${t.should_rotate ? '↻ TAK' : '✓ STOP'}</strong></span>
      </div>
      <div class="srow">
        <span>Temperatura (cel):</span>
        <span><strong>${(t.target_temp || 0).toFixed(1)}°C</strong></span>
      </div>
      <div class="srow">
        <span>Wilgotność (cel):</span>
        <span><strong>${t.hum_min || 0}–${t.hum_max || 0}%</strong></span>
      </div>
      ${t.notes ? `<div style="margin-top: 10px; font-style: italic; color: #666;">📝 ${t.notes}</div>` : ''}
    </div>
  `).join('');

  document.getElementById('trays-container').innerHTML = html;
}

// ==================== HARMONOGRAM ====================
async function loadSchedule() {
  const species = document.getElementById('sched-species').value;
  if (!species) return;

  try {
    if (!scheduleCache[species]) {
      const data = await apiCall(`/api/schedule?species=${species}`);
      scheduleCache[species] = data;
    }
    renderSchedule(scheduleCache[species]);
  } catch (e) {
    document.getElementById('sched-body').innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" style="text-align: center; color: red;">Błąd wczytywania</td></tr>';
  }
}

function renderSchedule(data) {
  if (!data || !data.schedule) {
    document.getElementById('sched-body').innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6">Brak danych</td></tr>';
    return;
  }

  const rows = data.schedule.map(day => `
    <tr>
      <td>${day.day}</td>
      <td>${day.temp_min}–${day.temp_max}°C</td>
      <td>${day.humidity_min}–${day.humidity_max}%</td>
      <td>${day.turn ? '✓ Tak' : '✗ Nie'}</td>
      <td>${day.lockdown ? '✓ TAK' : '✗ Nie'}</td>
      <td>${day.notes || ''}</td>
    </tr>
  `).join('');

  document.getElementById('sched-body').innerHTML = rows;
}

// ==================== KONTROLA ====================
async function loadControl() {
  try {
    const data = await apiCall('/api/status');
    document.getElementById('info-sensors').textContent = data.test_mode ? '🧪 TEST DANE' : '✓ Czujniki OK';
    document.getElementById('info-uptime').textContent = formatUptime(data.uptime_ms || 0);
    document.getElementById('info-config').textContent = `v${data.config_version || '?'}`;
    document.getElementById('info-wifi').textContent = data.wifi_connected ? '✓ Połączony' : '❌ Brak';
  } catch (e) {}
}

function formatUptime(ms) {
  const s = Math.floor(ms / 1000);
  const m = Math.floor(s / 60) % 60;
  const h = Math.floor(s / 3600) % 24;
  const d = Math.floor(s / 86400);
  return `${d}d ${h}h ${m}m`;
}

// ==================== AKCJE ====================
function showSetDay() {
  const day = prompt('Ustaw dzień inkubacji (1-30):', '1');
  if (day && !isNaN(day)) {
    setDay(parseInt(day));
  }
}

async function resetDay() {
  if (!confirm('Reset licznika na dzień 1? Historia zostanie zachowana.')) return;
  try {
    await apiCall('/api/reset-day', 'GET');
    toast('✅ Dzień zresetowany!');
    setTimeout(() => refreshDashboard(), 500);
  } catch (e) {
    toast('❌ Błąd resetu', true);
  }
}

async function setDay(day) {
  if (day < 1 || day > 30) {
    toast('❌ Dzień musi być między 1 a 30', true);
    return;
  }
  try {
    await apiCall(`/api/set-day?day=${day}`, 'GET');
    toast(`✅ Dzień ustawiony na ${day}`);
    setTimeout(() => refreshDashboard(), 500);
  } catch (e) {
    toast('❌ Błąd ustawiania dnia', true);
  }
}

async function rebootDevice() {
  if (!confirm('Zrestartować urządzenie?\n\nStrona przeładuje się za ~10 sekund.')) return;
  try {
    await apiCall('/api/reboot', 'GET');
    toast('🔄 Restartuję...');
    setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 10000);
  } catch (e) {
    toast('❌ Błąd restartu', true);
  }
}

// ==================== INICJALIZACJA ====================

#include <Arduino.h>
#include <DHT.h>
#include <OneWire.h>
#include <DallasTemperature.h>
#include <FS.h>
#include <SPIFFS.h>
#include <EEPROM.h>
#include <WiFi.h>
#include <WebServer.h>
#include <ArduinoJson.h>

#include "incubation_schedule.h"
#include "config_manager.h"
#include "tray_controller.h"

// ============================================================================
// WiFi
// ============================================================================
#define WIFI_SSID "INKUBATOR"
#define WIFI_PASSWORD "5465INKUBATOR5465"

WebServer webServer(80);

// ============================================================================
// Struktury i zmienne globalne
// ============================================================================
struct SensorData {
  float temp[MAX_SENSORS];
  float humidity;
  int water_level;
  bool door_open;
  int heater_pwm_pct;
  unsigned long long elapsed_ms;
  bool is_dummy;
};

#define HISTORY_SIZE 300
struct HistoryPoint {
  unsigned long long t_min;
  float temp0;
  float temp1;
  float humidity;
  int heater_pct;
};

HistoryPoint history[HISTORY_SIZE];
int history_idx = 0;

unsigned long long system_start_ms = 0;
SensorData last_sensor = {};
float heater_pwm_pct = 0.0f;
bool wifi_connected = false;

bool diffuser_on = false;
unsigned long diffuser_change_ms = 0;

// ============================================================================
// EEPROM – start time
// ============================================================================
#define EEPROM_START_ADDR 200
#define EEPROM_SIZE 512

void save_start_time(unsigned long long t) {
  EEPROM.begin(EEPROM_SIZE);
  EEPROM.put(EEPROM_START_ADDR, t);
  EEPROM.commit();
  EEPROM.end();
}

unsigned long long load_start_time() {
  EEPROM.begin(EEPROM_SIZE);
  unsigned long long t = 0;
  EEPROM.get(EEPROM_START_ADDR, t);
  EEPROM.end();
  return (t == 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFULL) ? 0 : t;
}

// ============================================================================
// Czujniki
// ============================================================================
OneWire* ds_wire[MAX_SENSORS] = {};
DallasTemperature ds_sensor[MAX_SENSORS] = {};
DHT* dht_sensor = nullptr;

void sensors_deinit() {
  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SENSORS; i++) {
    if (ds_wire[i]) {
      delete ds_wire[i];
      ds_wire[i] = nullptr;
    }
  }
  if (dht_sensor) {
    delete dht_sensor;
    dht_sensor = nullptr;
  }
}

void sensors_init() {
  sensors_deinit();
  SensorConfig& sc = configMgr.cfg.sensors;

  for (int i = 0; i < sc.ds18b20_count && i < MAX_SENSORS; i++) {
    ds_wire[i] = new OneWire(sc.ds18b20_pins[i]);
    ds_sensor[i] = DallasTemperature(ds_wire[i]);
    ds_sensor[i].begin();
    Serial.printf("[SENSOR] DS18B20 #%d na GPIO%d (%s)\n", i, sc.ds18b20_pins[i], sc.ds18b20_labels[i]);
  }

  if (sc.dht22_enabled) {
    dht_sensor = new DHT(sc.dht22_pin, DHT22);
    dht_sensor->begin();
    Serial.printf("[SENSOR] DHT22 na GPIO%d\n", sc.dht22_pin);
  }

  if (sc.water_level_enabled) pinMode(sc.water_level_pin, INPUT);
  if (sc.door_sensor_enabled) pinMode(sc.door_sensor_pin, INPUT_PULLUP);
}

// ============================================================================
// Odczyt czujników
// ============================================================================
void sensors_read(SensorData& data) {
  SensorConfig& sc = configMgr.cfg.sensors;
  unsigned long long now = millis();

  // Bezpieczne elapsed_ms (ochrona przed rollover)
  data.elapsed_ms = (now >= system_start_ms) ? 
                    (now - system_start_ms) : 
                    (0xFFFFFFFFULL - system_start_ms + now + 1);

  data.is_dummy = (sc.ds18b20_count == 0 && !sc.dht22_enabled);

  if (data.is_dummy) {
    float progress = min(1.0f, data.elapsed_ms / 3600000.0f);
    data.temp[0] = 25.0f + progress * 12.5f;
    data.temp[1] = 25.0f + progress * 11.0f;
    data.humidity = 40.0f + progress * 20.0f;
    data.water_level = 2048;
    data.door_open = false;
    return;
  }

  // DS18B20
  for (int i = 0; i < sc.ds18b20_count && i < MAX_SENSORS; i++) {
    ds_sensor[i].requestTemperatures();
    float t = ds_sensor[i].getTempCByIndex(0);
    data.temp[i] = (t == DEVICE_DISCONNECTED_C) ? -99.0f : t;
  }
  for (int i = sc.ds18b20_count; i < MAX_SENSORS; i++) data.temp[i] = -99.0f;

  // DHT22
  if (sc.dht22_enabled && dht_sensor) {
    float h = dht_sensor->readHumidity();
    for (int r = 0; r < 3 && isnan(h); r++) {
      delay(120);
      h = dht_sensor->readHumidity();
    }
    data.humidity = isnan(h) ? -1.0f : h;
  } else {
    data.humidity = -1.0f;
  }

  data.water_level = sc.water_level_enabled ? analogRead(sc.water_level_pin) : -1;
  data.door_open = sc.door_sensor_enabled ? (digitalRead(sc.door_sensor_pin) == LOW) : false;
  data.heater_pwm_pct = (int)heater_pwm_pct;
}

// ============================================================================
// Sterowanie grzałkami
// ============================================================================
#define HEATER_RAMP_MS 3600000ULL
#define HEATER_HYST    0.5f

void heaters_control(const SensorData& data) {
  float temp = data.temp[0];
  float target = configMgr.cfg.system.target_temp;

  if (data.elapsed_ms < HEATER_RAMP_MS) {
    heater_pwm_pct = (float)data.elapsed_ms / HEATER_RAMP_MS * 50.0f;
  } else {
    if (temp < target - HEATER_HYST)
      heater_pwm_pct = min(50.0f, heater_pwm_pct + 1.0f);
    else if (temp > target + HEATER_HYST)
      heater_pwm_pct = max(0.0f, heater_pwm_pct - 1.0f);
  }

  int pwm = (int)(heater_pwm_pct * 2.55f);
  ledcWrite(0, pwm);
  if (configMgr.cfg.system.heater_pin_2 >= 0) ledcWrite(1, pwm);
}

// ============================================================================
// Sterowanie dyfuzorami
// ============================================================================
void diffusers_control(const SensorData& data) {
  DiffuserConfig& dc = configMgr.cfg.diffusers;
  if (dc.count == 0) return;

  float hum_min, hum_max;
  tray_get_chamber_humidity(hum_min, hum_max);
  float target = (hum_min + hum_max) / 2.0f;

  unsigned long elapsed = millis() - diffuser_change_ms;

  if (data.humidity >= 0) {
    if (data.humidity < target - 5.0f) {
      if (!diffuser_on) { diffuser_on = true; diffuser_change_ms = millis(); }
    }
    else if (data.humidity > target + 10.0f) {
      if (diffuser_on) { diffuser_on = false; diffuser_change_ms = millis(); }
    }
    else {
      if (diffuser_on && elapsed > (unsigned long)dc.on_time_sec * 1000) {
        diffuser_on = false; diffuser_change_ms = millis();
      }
      if (!diffuser_on && elapsed > (unsigned long)dc.off_time_sec * 1000) {
        diffuser_on = true; diffuser_change_ms = millis();
      }
    }
  }

  for (int i = 0; i < dc.count; i++) {
    if (dc.pins[i] >= 0)
      digitalWrite(dc.pins[i], diffuser_on ? HIGH : LOW);
  }
}

// ============================================================================
// Logowanie CSV
// ============================================================================
void csv_create_header() {
  File f = SPIFFS.open("/inkubator_log.csv", "w");
  if (f) {
    f.println("time_sec,temp_chamber,temp_secondary,humidity,water_level,door,heater_pct");
    f.close();
  }
}

void csv_write(const SensorData& data) {
  File f = SPIFFS.open("/inkubator_log.csv", "a");
  if (!f) return;
  char buf[256];
  snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%llu,%.2f,%.2f,%.2f,%d,%d,%d\n",
           data.elapsed_ms / 1000,
           data.temp[0], data.temp[1], data.humidity,
           data.water_level, data.door_open ? 1 : 0,
           (int)heater_pwm_pct);
  f.print(buf);
  f.close();
}

// ============================================================================
// WiFi Keepalive
// ============================================================================
void wifi_keepalive() {
  static unsigned long last_check = 0;
  if (millis() - last_check < 30000) return;
  last_check = millis();

  if (WiFi.status() != WL_CONNECTED) {
    if (wifi_connected) {
      Serial.println("[WiFi] Rozłączono – reconnect...");
      wifi_connected = false;
    }
    WiFi.reconnect();
  } else if (!wifi_connected) {
    wifi_connected = true;
    Serial.printf("[WiFi] Połączono! IP: %s\n", WiFi.localIP().toString().c_str());
    webserver_setup();
  }
}

// ============================================================================
// WEB SERVER + API
// ============================================================================
void api_root() {
  if (SPIFFS.exists("/index.html")) {
    File f = SPIFFS.open("/index.html", "r");
    webServer.streamFile(f, "text/html");
    f.close();
  } else {
    webServer.send(404, "text/plain", "Brak pliku index.html");
  }
}

// ... (pozostałe api_ funkcje jak w oryginale - api_status, api_trays, api_config itd.)

void webserver_setup() {
  webServer.on("/", HTTP_GET, api_root);
  webServer.on("/api/status", HTTP_GET, []() { 
    // implementacja api_status() - możesz wkleić z oryginalnego kodu
    // lub zostawić jako placeholder na razie
  });
  // Dodaj pozostałe endpointy według potrzeb

  webServer.onNotFound([]() { webServer.send(404, "text/plain", "404 Not Found"); });
  webServer.begin();
  Serial.println("[WEB] Serwer uruchomiony na porcie 80");
}

// ============================================================================
// SETUP
// ============================================================================
void setup() {
  Serial.begin(115200);
  delay(1000);
  Serial.println("\n=== INKUBATOR ESP32-S3 v2.1 (POPRAWIONY) ===");

  if (!SPIFFS.begin(true)) {
    Serial.println("CRITICAL ERROR: SPIFFS mount failed!");
    while (1) delay(1000);
  }

  configMgr.load();

  unsigned long long saved = load_start_time();
  system_start_ms = (saved > 0) ? saved : millis();
  if (saved == 0) save_start_time(system_start_ms);

  sensors_init();
  tray_init(system_start_ms);

  // PWM - Grzałki
  ledcSetup(0, 5000, 8);
  ledcAttachPin(configMgr.cfg.system.heater_pin_1, 0);
  if (configMgr.cfg.system.heater_pin_2 >= 0) {
    ledcSetup(1, 5000, 8);
    ledcAttachPin(configMgr.cfg.system.heater_pin_2, 1);
  }

  // Wentylator
  if (configMgr.cfg.system.fan_pin >= 0) {
    pinMode(configMgr.cfg.system.fan_pin, OUTPUT);
    digitalWrite(configMgr.cfg.system.fan_pin, HIGH);
  }

  // Dyfuzory
  for (int i = 0; i < configMgr.cfg.diffusers.count; i++) {
    int p = configMgr.cfg.diffusers.pins[i];
    if (p >= 0) {
      pinMode(p, OUTPUT);
      digitalWrite(p, LOW);
    }
  }

  if (!SPIFFS.exists("/inkubator_log.csv")) csv_create_header();

  WiFi.mode(WIFI_STA);
  WiFi.begin(WIFI_SSID, WIFI_PASSWORD);

  Serial.print("[WiFi] Łączenie");
  for (int i = 0; i < 25; i++) {
    if (WiFi.status() == WL_CONNECTED) break;
    delay(400);
    Serial.print(".");
  }

  wifi_connected = (WiFi.status() == WL_CONNECTED);
  if (wifi_connected) {
    Serial.printf("\n[WiFi] OK → http://%s\n", WiFi.localIP().toString().c_str());
    webserver_setup();
  } else {
    Serial.println("\n[WiFi] Brak połączenia – tryb offline");
  }

  Serial.println("[SETUP] Inkubator gotowy!\n");
}

// ============================================================================
// LOOP
// ============================================================================
void loop() {
  unsigned long long now = millis();
  bool test_mode = configMgr.cfg.system.test_mode;

  wifi_keepalive();
  if (wifi_connected) webServer.handleClient();

  static unsigned long last_sensor = 0;
  if (now - last_sensor > (test_mode ? 8000 : 25000)) {
    last_sensor = now;
    sensors_read(last_sensor);
    heaters_control(last_sensor);
    diffusers_control(last_sensor);
  }

  static unsigned long last_tray = 0;
  if (now - last_tray > 25000) {
    last_tray = now;
    tray_update_all(now);
  }

  static unsigned long last_log = 0;
  if (now - last_log > (unsigned long)configMgr.cfg.system.log_interval_sec * 1000) {
    last_log = now;
    csv_write(last_sensor);
  }

  static unsigned long last_save = 0;
  if (now - last_save > 600000) {  // co 10 minut
    last_save = now;
    save_start_time(system_start_ms);
  }

  delay(30);
}

C++// config_manager.cpp
#include "config_manager.h"
#include <Arduino.h>
#include <SPIFFS.h>
#include <Preferences.h>
#include <ArduinoJson.h>

// ============================================================================
// Implementacja metod ConfigManager
// ============================================================================

bool ConfigManager::load_spiffs() {
  if (!SPIFFS.exists(CONFIG_PATH)) return false;

  File f = SPIFFS.open(CONFIG_PATH, "r");
  if (!f) return false;

  String json = f.readString();
  f.close();

  if (json.length() < 50) return false;

  return from_json(json);
}

bool ConfigManager::save_spiffs() {
  File f = SPIFFS.open(CONFIG_PATH, "w");
  if (!f) {
    Serial.println("[CFG] Błąd zapisu SPIFFS!");
    return false;
  }

  String json = to_json();
  f.print(json);
  f.close();

  Serial.printf("[CFG] Zapisano do SPIFFS (%d bajtów)\n", json.length());
  return true;
}

void ConfigManager::save_preferences() {
  pref.begin(PREF_NAMESPACE, false);
  String json = to_json();

  pref.putString(PREF_KEY_CFG, json);

  // Prosty CRC do weryfikacji
  uint16_t crc = 0;
  for (size_t i = 0; i < json.length(); i++) {
    crc += (uint8_t)json[i];
  }
  pref.putUShort(PREF_KEY_CRC, crc);

  pref.end();
  Serial.println("[CFG] Backup zapisany w Preferences");
}

bool ConfigManager::load_preferences() {
  pref.begin(PREF_NAMESPACE, true);

  if (!pref.isKey(PREF_KEY_CFG)) {
    pref.end();
    return false;
  }

  String json = pref.getString(PREF_KEY_CFG, "");
  uint16_t saved_crc = pref.getUShort(PREF_KEY_CRC, 0);
  pref.end();

  if (json.length() == 0) return false;

  // Weryfikacja CRC
  uint16_t crc = 0;
  for (size_t i = 0; i < json.length(); i++) {
    crc += (uint8_t)json[i];
  }

  if (crc != saved_crc) {
    Serial.println("[CFG] CRC mismatch w Preferences – odrzucam backup");
    return false;
  }

  return from_json(json);
}

// ============================================================================
// JSON Serialization / Deserialization
// ============================================================================

String ConfigManager::to_json() {
  DynamicJsonDocument doc(8192);

  doc["config_version"] = cfg.config_version;
  doc["tray_count"] = cfg.tray_count;

  JsonArray trays = doc.createNestedArray("trays");

    t["pin"] = cfg.trays[i].pin;
    t["label"] = cfg.trays[i].label;

    ds_labels.add(cfg.sensors.ds18b20_labels[i]);

  sensors["water_level_pin"] = cfg.sensors.water_level_pin;

  sensors["door_sensor_pin"] = cfg.sensors.door_sensor_pin;
  sensors["aquarium_sensor_index"] = cfg.sensors.aquarium_sensor_index;
  sensors["aquarium_target_temp"] = cfg.sensors.aquarium_target_temp;

  // Diffusers
  JsonObject diffusers = doc.createNestedObject("diffusers");
  diffusers["count"] = cfg.diffusers.count;
  diffusers["on_time_sec"] = cfg.diffusers.on_time_sec;
  diffusers["off_time_sec"] = cfg.diffusers.off_time_sec;
  JsonArray d_pins = diffusers.createNestedArray("pins");
  JsonArray d_labels = diffusers.createNestedArray("labels");
  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_DIFFUSERS; i++) {
    d_pins.add(cfg.diffusers.pins[i]);
    d_labels.add(cfg.diffusers.labels[i]);
  }

  // System
  JsonObject system = doc.createNestedObject("system");

  system["fan_pin"] = cfg.system.fan_pin;
  system["heater_pin_1"] = cfg.system.heater_pin_1;

  String output;
  serializeJson(doc, output);
  return output;
}

bool ConfigManager::from_json(const String& json_str) {
  DynamicJsonDocument doc(8192);
  DeserializationError err = deserializeJson(doc, json_str);

  if (err) {
    Serial.printf("[CFG] JSON parse error: %s\n", err.c_str());
    return false;
  }

  // Wersja konfiguracji
  if (doc.containsKey("config_version")) {
    cfg.config_version = doc["config_version"];
  }

    cfg.tray_count = constrain(doc["tray_count"].as<int>(), 1, MAX_TRAYS);

    JsonArray arr = doc["trays"].as<JsonArray>();
    int i = 0;

      if (i >= MAX_TRAYS) break;

// config_manager.cpp
#include "config_manager.h"
#include <Arduino.h>
#include <SPIFFS.h>

#include <ArduinoJson.h>

// ============================================================================

// ============================================================================

bool ConfigManager::load_spiffs() {
  if (!SPIFFS.exists(CONFIG_PATH)) return false;

  File f = SPIFFS.open(CONFIG_PATH, "r");
  if (!f) return false;

  String json = f.readString();
  f.close();

  if (json.length() < 50) return false;

  return from_json(json);
}

bool ConfigManager::save_spiffs() {
  File f = SPIFFS.open(CONFIG_PATH, "w");
  if (!f) {
    Serial.println("[CFG] Błąd zapisu SPIFFS!");
    return false;
  }

  String json = to_json();
  f.print(json);
  f.close();

  Serial.printf("[CFG] Zapisano do SPIFFS (%d bajtów)\n", json.length());
  return true;
}

void ConfigManager::save_preferences() {
  pref.begin(PREF_NAMESPACE, false);
  String json = to_json();

  pref.putString(PREF_KEY_CFG, json);

  // Prosty CRC do weryfikacji
  uint16_t crc = 0;
  for (size_t i = 0; i < json.length(); i++) {
    crc += (uint8_t)json[i];
  }
  pref.putUShort(PREF_KEY_CRC, crc);

  pref.end();
  Serial.println("[CFG] Backup zapisany w Preferences");
}

bool ConfigManager::load_preferences() {
  pref.begin(PREF_NAMESPACE, true);

  if (!pref.isKey(PREF_KEY_CFG)) {
    pref.end();
    return false;
  }

  String json = pref.getString(PREF_KEY_CFG, "");
  uint16_t saved_crc = pref.getUShort(PREF_KEY_CRC, 0);
  pref.end();

  if (json.length() == 0) return false;

  // Weryfikacja CRC
  uint16_t crc = 0;
  for (size_t i = 0; i < json.length(); i++) {
    crc += (uint8_t)json[i];
  }

  if (crc != saved_crc) {
    Serial.println("[CFG] CRC mismatch w Preferences – odrzucam backup");
    return false;
  }

  return from_json(json);
}

// ============================================================================
// API HANDLERS
// ============================================================================

void api_root() {
  if (SPIFFS.exists("/index.html")) {
    File f = SPIFFS.open("/index.html", "r");
    webServer.streamFile(f, "text/html");
    f.close();
  } else {
    webServer.send(404, "text/plain", "Brak pliku index.html w SPIFFS");
  }
}

void api_status() {
  tray_update_all(millis());

  float hum_min, hum_max;
  tray_get_chamber_humidity(hum_min, hum_max);

  float temp_chamber = last_sensor.temp[0];
  int aq_idx = configMgr.cfg.sensors.aquarium_sensor_index;
  float temp_aq = (aq_idx >= 0 && aq_idx < MAX_SENSORS) ? last_sensor.temp[aq_idx] : last_sensor.temp[1];

  bool aq_ok = (aq_idx >= 0) ? 
    (temp_aq >= 0 && fabs(temp_aq - configMgr.cfg.sensors.aquarium_target_temp) < 1.0f) : true;

  bool temp_ok = !last_sensor.is_dummy && fabs(temp_chamber - configMgr.cfg.system.target_temp) <= 0.6f;
  bool hum_ok = (last_sensor.humidity >= 0) && 
                (last_sensor.humidity >= hum_min - 5) && 
                (last_sensor.humidity <= hum_max + 5);

  String alert = "";
  if (last_sensor.is_dummy) alert += "TRYB TESTOWY – brak czujników. ";
  if (!temp_ok && !last_sensor.is_dummy) alert += "Temperatura poza normą! ";
  if (!hum_ok && last_sensor.humidity >= 0) alert += "Wilgotność poza normą! ";
  if (!aq_ok && aq_idx >= 0) alert += "Akwarium poza normą! ";
  if (last_sensor.door_open) alert += "DRZWI OTWARTE! ";

  DynamicJsonDocument doc(1536);
  doc["status"] = (temp_ok && hum_ok && aq_ok) ? "OK" : "WARNING";
  doc["alert"] = alert;
  doc["temp_chamber"] = temp_chamber;
  doc["temp_aquarium"] = temp_aq;
  doc["aquarium_ok"] = aq_ok;
  doc["humidity"] = last_sensor.humidity;
  doc["humidity_target_min"] = hum_min;
  doc["humidity_target_max"] = hum_max;
  doc["target_temp"] = configMgr.cfg.system.target_temp;
  doc["heater_pwm"] = (int)heater_pwm_pct;
  doc["water_level"] = last_sensor.water_level;
  doc["door_open"] = last_sensor.door_open;
  doc["diffuser_on"] = diffuser_on;
  doc["test_mode"] = configMgr.cfg.system.test_mode;
  doc["elapsed_ms"] = (unsigned long)(last_sensor.elapsed_ms / 1000); // sekundy dla JS
  doc["uptime_hours"] = (float)last_sensor.elapsed_ms / 3600000.0f;

  String output;
  serializeJson(doc, output);
  webServer.send(200, "application/json", output);
}

void api_trays() {
  String json = tray_status_json(millis());
  webServer.send(200, "application/json", json);
}

void api_tray_set_day() {
  if (!webServer.hasArg("tray") || !webServer.hasArg("day")) {
    webServer.send(400, "application/json", "{\"error\":\"Brak parametrów tray/day\"}");
    return;
  }
  int tray = webServer.arg("tray").toInt();
  int day = webServer.arg("day").toInt();

  if (tray < 0 || tray >= MAX_TRAYS || day < 1 || day > 30) {
    webServer.send(400, "application/json", "{\"error\":\"Nieprawidłowe wartości\"}");
    return;
  }

  if (tray_set_day(tray, day, millis())) {
    webServer.send(200, "application/json", "{\"ok\":true}");
  } else {
    webServer.send(400, "application/json", "{\"error\":\"Nie można ustawić dnia\"}");
  }
}

void api_tray_set_species() {
  if (!webServer.hasArg("tray") || !webServer.hasArg("species")) {
    webServer.send(400, "application/json", "{\"error\":\"Brak parametrów\"}");
    return;
  }
  int tray = webServer.arg("tray").toInt();
  String species = webServer.arg("species");

  tray_set_species(tray, species.c_str());
  webServer.send(200, "application/json", "{\"ok\":true}");
}

void api_tray_set_active() {
  if (!webServer.hasArg("tray") || !webServer.hasArg("active")) {
    webServer.send(400, "application/json", "{\"error\":\"Brak parametrów\"}");
    return;
  }
  int tray = webServer.arg("tray").toInt();
  bool active = (webServer.arg("active") == "true");

  tray_set_active(tray, active);
  webServer.send(200, "application/json", "{\"ok\":true}");
}

void api_config_get() {
  String json = configMgr.to_json();
  webServer.send(200, "application/json", json);
}

void api_config_set() {
  if (!webServer.hasArg("plain")) {
    webServer.send(400, "application/json", "{\"error\":\"Brak body\"}");
    return;
  }

  String body = webServer.arg("plain");

  // Obsługa factory reset
  if (body.indexOf("factory_reset") != -1) {
    configMgr.factory_reset();
    sensors_init();
    tray_init(system_start_ms);
    webServer.send(200, "application/json", "{\"ok\":true,\"message\":\"Factory reset wykonany\"}");
    return;
  }

  if (configMgr.from_json(body)) {
    configMgr.save();
    sensors_init();           // reinicjalizacja czujników
    tray_init(system_start_ms);
    webServer.send(200, "application/json", "{\"ok\":true,\"message\":\"Konfiguracja zapisana\"}");
  } else {
    webServer.send(400, "application/json", "{\"error\":\"Nieprawidłowy JSON\"}");
  }
}

void api_species() {
  DynamicJsonDocument doc(4096);
  JsonArray arr = doc.to<JsonArray>();

  for (int i = 0; i < SPECIES_COUNT; i++) {
    JsonObject obj = arr.createNestedObject();
    obj["id"] = SPECIES_LIST[i].id;
    obj["name"] = SPECIES_LIST[i].name;
    obj["days"] = SPECIES_LIST[i].total_days;
  }

  String output;
  serializeJson(arr, output);
  webServer.send(200, "application/json", output);
}

void api_schedule() {
  String sp_id = webServer.hasArg("species") ? webServer.arg("species") : "CHICKEN";
  const SpeciesInfo* sp = get_species(sp_id.c_str());

  if (!sp) {
    webServer.send(404, "application/json", "{\"error\":\"Nieznany gatunek\"}");
    return;
  }

  DynamicJsonDocument doc(8192);
  doc["species"] = sp->id;
  doc["name"] = sp->name;
  doc["total_days"] = sp->total_days;

  JsonArray sched = doc.createNestedArray("schedule");
  for (int i = 0; i < sp->total_days; i++) {
    const IncubationDay& d = sp->schedule[i];
    JsonObject dayObj = sched.createNestedObject();
    dayObj["day"] = d.day;
    dayObj["temp_min"] = d.temp_min;
    dayObj["temp_max"] = d.temp_max;
    dayObj["hum_min"] = d.humidity_min;
    dayObj["hum_max"] = d.humidity_max;
    dayObj["turn"] = d.turn;
    dayObj["lockdown"] = d.lockdown;
    dayObj["notes"] = d.notes;
  }

  String output;
  serializeJson(doc, output);
  webServer.send(200, "application/json", output);
}

void api_history() {
  DynamicJsonDocument doc(8192);
  JsonArray dataArr = doc.createNestedArray("data");

  for (int i = 0; i < HISTORY_SIZE; i++) {
    int idx = (history_idx + i) % HISTORY_SIZE;
    if (history[idx].t_min == 0) continue;

    JsonObject p = dataArr.createNestedObject();
    p["t"] = (unsigned long)history[idx].t_min;
    p["t0"] = history[idx].temp0;
    p["t1"] = history[idx].temp1;
    p["h"] = history[idx].humidity;
    p["p"] = history[idx].heater_pct;
  }

  String output;
  serializeJson(doc, output);
  webServer.send(200, "application/json", output);
}

void api_log() {
  if (SPIFFS.exists("/inkubator_log.csv")) {
    File f = SPIFFS.open("/inkubator_log.csv", "r");
    webServer.sendHeader("Content-Disposition", "attachment; filename=inkubator_log.csv");
    webServer.streamFile(f, "text/csv");
    f.close();
  } else {
    webServer.send(404, "text/plain", "Brak pliku logu");
  }
}

void api_reset() {
  if (webServer.method() != HTTP_POST) {
    webServer.send(405, "text/plain", "Method Not Allowed");
    return;
  }

  system_start_ms = millis();
  save_start_time(system_start_ms);
  tray_init(system_start_ms);
  memset(history, 0, sizeof(history));
  history_idx = 0;
  csv_create_header();

  webServer.send(200, "application/json", "{\"ok\":true}");
}

void api_reboot() {
  if (webServer.method() != HTTP_POST) {
    webServer.send(405, "text/plain", "Method Not Allowed");
    return;
  }

  webServer.send(200, "application/json", "{\"ok\":true}");
  delay(800);
  ESP.restart();
}

// ============================================================================
// WEB SERVER SETUP
// ============================================================================
void webserver_setup() {
  webServer.on("/", HTTP_GET, api_root);
  webServer.on("/api/status", HTTP_GET, api_status);
  webServer.on("/api/trays", HTTP_GET, api_trays);
  
  webServer.on("/api/tray/set-day", HTTP_POST, api_tray_set_day);
  webServer.on("/api/tray/set-species", HTTP_POST, api_tray_set_species);
  webServer.on("/api/tray/set-active", HTTP_POST, api_tray_set_active);
  
  webServer.on("/api/config", HTTP_GET, api_config_get);
  webServer.on("/api/config", HTTP_POST, api_config_set);
  
  webServer.on("/api/species", HTTP_GET, api_species);
  webServer.on("/api/schedule", HTTP_GET, api_schedule);
  webServer.on("/api/history", HTTP_GET, api_history);
  webServer.on("/api/log", HTTP_GET, api_log);
  
  webServer.on("/api/reset", HTTP_POST, api_reset);
  webServer.on("/api/reboot", HTTP_POST, api_reboot);

  webServer.onNotFound([]() {
    webServer.send(404, "text/plain", "404 Not Found");
  });

  webServer.begin();
  Serial.println("[WEB] Serwer HTTP uruchomiony na porcie 80");
}

// ============================================================================
// API HANDLERS
// ============================================================================

void api_root() {
  if (SPIFFS.exists("/index.html")) {
    File f = SPIFFS.open("/index.html", "r");
    webServer.streamFile(f, "text/html");
    f.close();
  } else {
    webServer.send(404, "text/plain", "Brak pliku index.html w SPIFFS");
  }
}

void api_status() {
  tray_update_all(millis());

  float hum_min, hum_max;
  tray_get_chamber_humidity(hum_min, hum_max);

  float temp_chamber = last_sensor.temp[0];
  int aq_idx = configMgr.cfg.sensors.aquarium_sensor_index;
  float temp_aq = (aq_idx >= 0 && aq_idx < MAX_SENSORS) ? last_sensor.temp[aq_idx] : last_sensor.temp[1];

  bool aq_ok = (aq_idx >= 0) ? 
    (temp_aq >= 0 && fabs(temp_aq - configMgr.cfg.sensors.aquarium_target_temp) < 1.0f) : true;

  bool temp_ok = !last_sensor.is_dummy && fabs(temp_chamber - configMgr.cfg.system.target_temp) <= 0.6f;
  bool hum_ok = (last_sensor.humidity >= 0) && 
                (last_sensor.humidity >= hum_min - 5) && 
                (last_sensor.humidity <= hum_max + 5);

  String alert = "";
  if (last_sensor.is_dummy) alert += "TRYB TESTOWY – brak czujników. ";
  if (!temp_ok && !last_sensor.is_dummy) alert += "Temperatura poza normą! ";
  if (!hum_ok && last_sensor.humidity >= 0) alert += "Wilgotność poza normą! ";
  if (!aq_ok && aq_idx >= 0) alert += "Akwarium poza normą! ";
  if (last_sensor.door_open) alert += "DRZWI OTWARTE! ";

  DynamicJsonDocument doc(1536);
  doc["status"] = (temp_ok && hum_ok && aq_ok) ? "OK" : "WARNING";
  doc["alert"] = alert;
  doc["temp_chamber"] = temp_chamber;
  doc["temp_aquarium"] = temp_aq;
  doc["aquarium_ok"] = aq_ok;
  doc["humidity"] = last_sensor.humidity;
  doc["humidity_target_min"] = hum_min;
  doc["humidity_target_max"] = hum_max;
  doc["target_temp"] = configMgr.cfg.system.target_temp;
  doc["heater_pwm"] = (int)heater_pwm_pct;
  doc["water_level"] = last_sensor.water_level;
  doc["door_open"] = last_sensor.door_open;
  doc["diffuser_on"] = diffuser_on;
  doc["test_mode"] = configMgr.cfg.system.test_mode;
  doc["config_version"] = configMgr.cfg.config_version;
  doc["wifi_connected"] = wifi_connected;
  doc["uptime_ms"] = (unsigned long)(last_sensor.elapsed_ms);

  // Oblicz dni i godziny do wylęgu
  TrayState& main_tray = tray_states[0];
  doc["current_day"] = main_tray.current_day;
  doc["days_remaining"] = main_tray.days_remaining;

  String output;
  serializeJson(doc, output);
  webServer.send(200, "application/json", output);
}

void api_trays() {
  String json = tray_status_json(millis());
  webServer.send(200, "application/json", json);
}

void api_tray_set_day() {
  if (!webServer.hasArg("tray") || !webServer.hasArg("day")) {
    webServer.send(400, "application/json", "{\"error\":\"Brak parametrów tray/day\"}");
    return;
  }
  int tray = webServer.arg("tray").toInt();
  int day = webServer.arg("day").toInt();

  if (tray < 0 || tray >= MAX_TRAYS || day < 1 || day > 30) {
    webServer.send(400, "application/json", "{\"error\":\"Nieprawidłowe wartości\"}");
    return;
  }

  if (tray_set_day(tray, day, millis())) {
    webServer.send(200, "application/json", "{\"ok\":true}");
  } else {
    webServer.send(400, "application/json", "{\"error\":\"Nie można ustawić dnia\"}");
  }
}

void api_tray_set_species() {
  if (!webServer.hasArg("tray") || !webServer.hasArg("species")) {
    webServer.send(400, "application/json", "{\"error\":\"Brak parametrów\"}");
    return;
  }
  int tray = webServer.arg("tray").toInt();
  String species = webServer.arg("species");

  tray_set_species(tray, species.c_str());
  webServer.send(200, "application/json", "{\"ok\":true}");
}

void api_tray_set_active() {
  if (!webServer.hasArg("tray") || !webServer.hasArg("active")) {
    webServer.send(400, "application/json", "{\"error\":\"Brak parametrów\"}");
    return;
  }
  int tray = webServer.arg("tray").toInt();
  bool active = (webServer.arg("active") == "true");

  tray_set_active(tray, active);
  webServer.send(200, "application/json", "{\"ok\":true}");
}

void api_config_get() {
  String json = configMgr.to_json();
  webServer.send(200, "application/json", json);
}

void api_config_set() {
  if (!webServer.hasArg("plain")) {
    webServer.send(400, "application/json", "{\"error\":\"Brak body\"}");
    return;
  }

  String body = webServer.arg("plain");

  // Obsługa factory reset
  if (body.indexOf("factory_reset") != -1) {
    configMgr.factory_reset();
    sensors_init();
    tray_init(system_start_ms);
    webServer.send(200, "application/json", "{\"ok\":true,\"message\":\"Factory reset wykonany\"}");
    return;
  }

  if (configMgr.from_json(body)) {
    configMgr.save();
    sensors_init();
    tray_init(system_start_ms);
    webServer.send(200, "application/json", "{\"ok\":true,\"message\":\"Konfiguracja zapisana\"}");
  } else {
    webServer.send(400, "application/json", "{\"error\":\"Nieprawidłowy JSON\"}");
  }
}

void api_species() {
  DynamicJsonDocument doc(4096);
  JsonArray arr = doc.to<JsonArray>();

  for (int i = 0; i < SPECIES_COUNT; i++) {
    JsonObject obj = arr.createNestedObject();
    obj["id"] = SPECIES_LIST[i].id;
    obj["name"] = SPECIES_LIST[i].name;
    obj["days"] = SPECIES_LIST[i].total_days;
  }

  String output;
  serializeJson(arr, output);
  webServer.send(200, "application/json", output);
}

void api_schedule() {
  String sp_id = webServer.hasArg("species") ? webServer.arg("species") : "CHICKEN";
  const SpeciesInfo* sp = get_species(sp_id.c_str());

  if (!sp) {
    webServer.send(404, "application/json", "{\"error\":\"Nieznany gatunek\"}");
    return;
  }

  DynamicJsonDocument doc(8192);
  doc["species"] = sp->id;
  doc["name"] = sp->name;
  doc["total_days"] = sp->total_days;

  JsonArray sched = doc.createNestedArray("schedule");
  for (int i = 0; i < sp->total_days; i++) {
    const IncubationDay& d = sp->schedule[i];
    JsonObject dayObj = sched.createNestedObject();
    dayObj["day"] = d.day;
    dayObj["temp_min"] = d.temp_min;
    dayObj["temp_max"] = d.temp_max;
    dayObj["humidity_min"] = d.humidity_min;
    dayObj["humidity_max"] = d.humidity_max;
    dayObj["turn"] = d.turn;
    dayObj["lockdown"] = d.lockdown;
    dayObj["notes"] = d.notes;
  }

  String output;
  serializeJson(doc, output);
  webServer.send(200, "application/json", output);
}

void api_history() {
  DynamicJsonDocument doc(8192);
  JsonArray dataArr = doc.createNestedArray("history");

  for (int i = 0; i < HISTORY_SIZE; i++) {
    int idx = (history_idx + i) % HISTORY_SIZE;
    if (history[idx].t_min == 0) continue;

    JsonObject p = dataArr.createNestedObject();
    p["timestamp_min"] = (unsigned long)history[idx].t_min;
    p["temp_chamber"] = history[idx].temp0;
    p["temp_aquarium"] = history[idx].temp1;
    p["humidity"] = history[idx].humidity;
    p["heater_pct"] = history[idx].heater_pct;
  }

  String output;
  serializeJson(doc, output);
  webServer.send(200, "application/json", output);
}

void api_log() {
  if (SPIFFS.exists("/inkubator_log.csv")) {
    File f = SPIFFS.open("/inkubator_log.csv", "r");
    webServer.sendHeader("Content-Disposition", "attachment; filename=inkubator_log.csv");
    webServer.streamFile(f, "text/csv");
    f.close();
  } else {
    webServer.send(404, "text/plain", "Brak pliku logu");
  }
}

void api_reset() {
  system_start_ms = millis();
  save_start_time(system_start_ms);
  tray_init(system_start_ms);
  memset(history, 0, sizeof(history));
  history_idx = 0;
  csv_create_header();

  webServer.send(200, "application/json", "{\"ok\":true}");
}

void api_reboot() {
  webServer.send(200, "application/json", "{\"ok\":true}");
  delay(800);
  ESP.restart();
}

// ============================================================================
// WEB SERVER SETUP
// ============================================================================
void webserver_setup() {
  webServer.on("/", HTTP_GET, api_root);
  webServer.on("/api/status", HTTP_GET, api_status);
  webServer.on("/api/trays", HTTP_GET, api_trays);
  
  webServer.on("/api/tray/set-day", HTTP_POST, api_tray_set_day);
  webServer.on("/api/tray/set-species", HTTP_POST, api_tray_set_species);
  webServer.on("/api/tray/set-active", HTTP_POST, api_tray_set_active);
  
  webServer.on("/api/config", HTTP_GET, api_config_get);
  webServer.on("/api/config", HTTP_POST, api_config_set);
  
  webServer.on("/api/species", HTTP_GET, api_species);
  webServer.on("/api/schedule", HTTP_GET, api_schedule);
  webServer.on("/api/history", HTTP_GET, api_history);
  webServer.on("/api/log", HTTP_GET, api_log);
  
  webServer.on("/api/reset", HTTP_POST, api_reset);
  webServer.on("/api/reboot", HTTP_POST, api_reboot);

  webServer.onNotFound([]() {
    webServer.send(404, "text/plain", "404 Not Found");
  });

  webServer.begin();
  Serial.println("[WEB] Serwer HTTP uruchomiony na porcie 80");
}

// ============================================================================
// WEB SERVER + API (definicja poniżej)
// ============================================================================
void webserver_setup();   // forward declaration

// ============================================================================
// Definicje API endpoints (Web Server)
// ============================================================================
void handle_api_status() {
  DynamicJsonDocument doc(2048);
  doc["uptime_ms"] = millis();
  doc["elapsed_since_start_ms"] = last_sensor.elapsed_ms;
  doc["system_start_time_ms"] = system_start_ms;

  JsonArray temps = doc.createNestedArray("temperatures");
  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SENSORS; i++) {
    temps.add(last_sensor.temp[i]);
  }
  doc["humidity"] = last_sensor.humidity;
  doc["water_level"] = last_sensor.water_level;
  doc["door_open"] = last_sensor.door_open;
  doc["heater_pwm_pct"] = (int)heater_pwm_pct;
  doc["diffuser_on"] = diffuser_on;

  JsonArray trays_arr = doc.createNestedArray("trays");
  for (int i = 0; i < configMgr.cfg.tray_count; i++) {
    const Tray* t = tray_get(i);
    if (t) {
      JsonObject to = trays_arr.createNestedObject();
      to["id"] = t->id;
      to["species"] = t->species;
      to["day"] = t->current_day;
      to["target_temp"] = t->target_temp;
      to["target_humidity"] = t->target_humidity;
      to["rotating"] = t->rotating;
    }
  }

  String json;
  serializeJson(doc, json);
  webServer.send(200, "application/json", json);
}

void handle_api_config() {
  String json = configMgr.to_json();
  webServer.send(200, "application/json", json);
}

void handle_api_config_update() {
  if (webServer.hasArg("plain")) {
    String body = webServer.arg("plain");
    if (configMgr.from_json(body)) {
      configMgr.save();
      sensors_init();
      handle_api_status();
      return;
    }
  }
  webServer.send(400, "text/plain", "Config update failed");
}

void handle_api_history() {
  DynamicJsonDocument doc(4096);
  JsonArray arr = doc.createNestedArray("history");
  for (int i = 0; i < HISTORY_SIZE; i++) {
    int idx = (history_idx + i) % HISTORY_SIZE;
    if (history[idx].timestamp_min > 0) {
      JsonObject h = arr.createNestedObject();
      h["timestamp_min"] = history[idx].timestamp_min;
      h["temp_chamber"] = history[idx].temp_chamber;
      h["temp_secondary"] = history[idx].temp_secondary;
      h["humidity"] = history[idx].humidity;
      h["heater_pct"] = history[idx].heater_pct;
    }
  }
  String json;
  serializeJson(doc, json);
  webServer.send(200, "application/json", json);
}

void handle_api_reset_day() {
  int tray_id = 0;
  if (webServer.hasArg("tray")) tray_id = webServer.arg("tray").toInt();
  tray_reset_day(tray_id);
  webServer.send(200, "text/plain", "Day reset");
}

void handle_api_set_day() {
  int tray_id = 0, day = 1;
  if (webServer.hasArg("tray")) tray_id = webServer.arg("tray").toInt();
  if (webServer.hasArg("day")) day = webServer.arg("day").toInt();
  tray_set_day(tray_id, day);
  webServer.send(200, "text/plain", "Day updated");
}

void handle_api_reboot() {
  webServer.send(200, "text/plain", "Rebooting...");
  delay(1000);
  ESP.restart();
}

void handle_root() {
  if (!SPIFFS.exists("/index.html")) {
    webServer.send(404, "text/plain", "index.html not found");
    return;
  }
  File f = SPIFFS.open("/index.html", "r");
  webServer.streamFile(f, "text/html");
  f.close();
}

void handle_not_found() {
  webServer.send(404, "text/plain", "Not Found");
}

void webserver_setup() {
  webServer.on("/", handle_root);
  webServer.on("/api/status", HTTP_GET, handle_api_status);
  webServer.on("/api/config", HTTP_GET, handle_api_config);
  webServer.on("/api/config", HTTP_POST, handle_api_config_update);
  webServer.on("/api/history", HTTP_GET, handle_api_history);
  webServer.on("/api/reset-day", HTTP_GET, handle_api_reset_day);
  webServer.on("/api/set-day", HTTP_GET, handle_api_set_day);
  webServer.on("/api/reboot", HTTP_GET, handle_api_reboot);
  webServer.onNotFound(handle_not_found);
  webServer.begin();
  Serial.println("[WebServer] Uruchomiony na porcie 80");
}

Przykłady użycia (JSON)

2. Ustawienie dnia na tacy:
httpPOST /api/tray/set-day?tray=0&day=12
3. Zmiana gatunku:
httpPOST /api/tray/set-species?tray=1&species=DUCK
4. Zapis konfiguracji:
httpPOST /api/config
Body: { "tray_count": 2, "system": { "target_temp": 37.6, ... } }
5. Factory Reset:
httpPOST /api/config
Body: { "factory_reset": true }

Rekomendowane użycie w JavaScript (Frontend)
JavaScriptasync function api(url, method = 'GET', body = null) {
  const opts = { method };
  if (body) {
    opts.body = JSON.stringify(body);
    opts.headers = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
  }
  const res = await fetch(url, opts);
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
  return res.json();
}

platform = espressif32

board_build.flash_mode = qio

    -D EEPROM_SIZE=512
    -D MAX_TRAYS=3
    -D MAX_SENSORS=4
    -D MAX_DIFFUSERS=3
    -D HISTORY_SIZE=300

    bblanchon/ArduinoJson@^7.2.0

; ==================== Upload ====================

monitor_rts = 0
monitor_dtr = 0

1. platformio.ini – Zaktualizowana wersja (z GitHub + backup)
ini; =============================================
; platformio.ini - Inkubator ESP32-S3
; =============================================

[env:esp32s3]
platform = espressif32
board = esp32-s3-devkitc-1
framework = arduino

; ==================== Build Settings ====================
board_build.mcu = esp32s3
board_build.f_cpu = 240000000L
board_build.flash_mode = qio
board_build.partitions = min_spiffs.csv
board_build.filesystem = spiffs

upload_protocol = esptool
upload_speed = 921600
monitor_speed = 115200

; ==================== Kompilacja ====================
build_flags =
    -D CORE_DEBUG_LEVEL=3
    -D ARDUINO_RUNNING_CORE=1
    -D EEPROM_SIZE=512
    -D MAX_TRAYS=3
    -D MAX_SENSORS=4
    -D MAX_DIFFUSERS=3
    -D HISTORY_SIZE=300
    -D CONFIG_VERSION=102
    -Os
    -fno-exceptions
    -fno-rtti

; ==================== Biblioteki ====================
lib_deps =
    adafruit/DHT sensor library@^1.4.6
    https://github.com/milesburton/Arduino-Temperature-Control-Library.git
    bblanchon/ArduinoJson@^7.2.0

; ==================== Monitor ====================
monitor_filters = esp32_exception_decoder
monitor_rts = 0
monitor_dtr = 0

# 🥚 Inkubator ESP32-S3 – Pełna Dokumentacja

## 📋 Spis Treści
1. [Architektura](#architektura)
2. [Wymagania](#wymagania)
3. [Instalacja](#instalacja)
4. [Kompilacja](#kompilacja)
5. [Upload](#upload)
6. [Konfiguracja](#konfiguracja)
7. [API Endpoints](#api-endpoints)
8. [WebUI Dashboard](#webui-dashboard)

---

## 🏗️ Architektura

### Hardware
- **MCU**: ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 (240MHz, 8MB Flash)
- **WiFi**: 2.4 GHz 802.11 b/g/n
- **Firmware**: ~817KB (75% partycji)
- **SPIFFS**: 19.7KB (HTML + assets)

### System HYBRID
- **Warstwa bazowa**: Grzałka akwariowa 220V (termostat ~36°C, zawsze włączona)
- **Warstwa precyzyjna**: Grzałki PWM (GPIO1, GPIO2) – sterowanie do 50% max
- **Strategia**: Ramp-up 60 minut (0→50%), następnie PID-like maintain (±0.5°C hystereza)
- **Bezpieczeństwo**: Alert jeśli akwarium spadnie <35.5°C lub wzrośnie >36.6°C

### Sensory
- **Temperatura**: 4× DS18B20 (OneWire)
  - GPIO6: Komora jaj
  - GPIO7: Akwarium
  - GPIO4, GPIO5: Dodatkowe
- **Wilgotność**: DHT22 (GPIO8)
- **Woda**: ADC (GPIO9)
- **Drzwi**: GPIO10 (pull-up)
- **Dyfuzory**: GPIO21, GPIO22, GPIO23 (nawilżacze)
- **Tace**: GPIO18, GPIO19, GPIO20 (sterowanie obrotami)

### 6 Gatunków Ptaków
| Gatunek | Dni | Lockdown | Wilg. Faza 1 | Wilg. Faza 2 |
|---------|-----|----------|--------------|--------------|
| 🐔 Kura | 21 | Day 19 | 50-60% | 70-75% |
| 🦆 Kaczka | 28 | Day 26 | 55-65% | 70-80% |
| 🦢 Gęś | 30 | Day 28 | 55-65% | 70-80% |
| 🥚 Przepiórka | 17 | Day 15 | 55-60% | 65-75% |
| 🐦 Perliczka | 26 | Day 23 | 45-55% | 65-70% |
| 🦚 Bażant | 24 | Day 21 | 50-55% | 65-70% |

## 📤 Upload

### Przygotowanie
1. Podłącz ESP32-S3 via USB
2. Zapamiętaj port (COM3, COM4, itd.)

### Uwaga: GPIO0/BOOT Bug
ESP32-S3 DevKit ma problem z automatycznym wejściem w bootloader. Rozwiązanie:
- **Ręczne**: Przytrzymaj GPIO0→GND, potem GND dla programu (esptool pokaże kiedy puścić)
- **Automatyczne**: Zmień circuit/capacitor na CH340 (jeśli posiadasz DevKit z tym chipem)

### Upload Firmware
```bash
platformio run --target upload
```

**Przy pierwszym upload'ie:**
```
Waiting for the new upload port...
# Naciśnij GPIO0→GND
# Po 1-2 sekundach pusć
# Gdy zobaczysz "Connecting..."
```

### Upload SPIFFS (Web Assets)
```bash
platformio run --target uploadfs
```

### Monitor Serial
```bash
platformio device monitor --port COM3 --baud 115200
```

**Oczekiwany output:**
```
=== INKUBATOR ESP32-S3 v2.1 ===
[CFG] Wczytano z SPIFFS
[SENSOR] DS18B20 #0 na GPIO6 (Komora jaj)
[WiFi] Łączenie...................
[WiFi] OK → http://192.168.1.100
[WEB] Serwer HTTP uruchomiony na porcie 80
[SETUP] Inkubator gotowy!
```

```

## 🌐 API Endpoints

### Status & Monitoring
```
GET /api/status
  → Temperatura, wilgotność, status grzałek, alerty
  Response: JSON {temp_chamber, humidity, heater_pwm, alert, ...}

GET /api/history
  → Historia pomiarów dla wykresu (300 punktów)
  Response: JSON {history: [{timestamp_min, temp_chamber, humidity, ...}]}

GET /api/log
  → Pobierz CSV z logami
  Response: File download (inkubator_log.csv)
```

### Tace
```
GET /api/trays
  → Status wszystkich tac
  Response: JSON {trays: [{index, active, species_name, current_day, ...}]}

POST /api/tray/set-day?tray=0&day=12
  → Ustaw dzień dla tacy
  Response: {ok: true}

POST /api/tray/set-species?tray=0&species=DUCK
  → Zmień gatunek
  Response: {ok: true}

POST /api/tray/set-active?tray=0&active=true
  → Aktywuj/dezaktywuj tacę
  Response: {ok: true}
```

### Harmonogramy
```
GET /api/schedule?species=CHICKEN
  → Harmonogram dla gatunku
  Response: JSON {species, schedule: [{day, temp_min, temp_max, humidity_min, humidity_max, turn, lockdown, notes}]}

GET /api/species
  → Lista dostępnych gatunków
  Response: JSON [{id: "CHICKEN", name: "Kura", days: 21}, ...]
```

### Konfiguracja
```
GET /api/config
  → Pobierz pełną konfigurację
  Response: JSON (cały config.json)

POST /api/config
  Body: {system: {target_temp: 37.6, ...}}
  → Zapis nowej konfiguracji
  Response: {ok: true}
```

### Akcje
```
POST /api/reset
  → Reset licznika na dzień 1, wyczyść historię
  Response: {ok: true}

POST /api/reboot
  → Restart ESP32
  Response: {ok: true}
```

- Dropdown: 6 gatunków
- Tabela: dzień, temp, wilg, obrót, lockdown, uwagi

#### 4️⃣ Kontrola
- Szybkie akcje: Reset, Set Day, Restart
- Info systemowe: Sensory, Uptime, WiFi, Config Version

## 🔧 Troubleshooting

### Problema: "Brak połączenia WiFi"
**Rozwiązanie:**
1. Sprawdź SSID `INKUBATOR` i hasło `5465INKUBATOR5465`
2. Restart ESP32: `http://IP/api/reboot`
3. Sprawdź Serial Monitor: `platformio device monitor`

### Problema: "Temperatura poza normą"
**Sprawdzenie:**
- Czy DS18B20 podłączony?
- Czy termometr pracuje (test_mode=true?)
- Czy grzałka PWM pracuje? (sprawdź GPIO1/GPIO2)

### Problema: "WebUI ładuje się ale brak danych"
**Rozwiązanie:**
1. Sprawdź `/api/status` w przeglądarce
2. Sprawdź console (F12 → Network tab)
3. Czy SPIFFS wgrany? (`platformio run --target uploadfs`)

### Problema: Upload zawiesza się
**Rozwiązanie:**
1. Zmień port: `monitor_port = COM4` w `platformio.ini`
2. Zmień szybkość: `upload_speed = 460800`
3. Manualne wejście w bootloader: GPIO0→GND przed upload'em

## 3️⃣ Upload (ESP32-S3)

### ⚠️ WAŻNE: GPIO0/BOOT Bug
ESP32-S3 DevKit ma problem z wejściem w bootloader. Rozwiązania:

#### Opcja A: Manualna
```bash
1. Podłącz ESP32 via USB
2. Sprawdź port: COM3, COM4, itp.
3. Uruchom: platformio run --target upload
4. Gdy zobaczysz "Connecting...", przytrzymaj GPIO0→GND (1-2 sek)
5. Puść – powinno się wgrać
```

#### Opcja B: Modyfikacja sprzętu (deweloper)
- Zmień capacitor na CH340 (jeśli jest)
- Lub wyślij GPIO0 bezpośrednio na DTR przez rezystor

#### Opcja C: esptool bezpośrednio
```bash
python -m esptool --chip esp32s3 --port COM3 --baud 921600 \
  --before default_reset --after hard_reset \
  write_flash -z --flash_mode dio --flash_freq 80m 0x0 .pio/build/esp32s3/firmware.bin
```

### Upload Steps

#### 1. Firmware
```bash
cd j:\inkubator
platformio run --target upload
```

// firmware/data/config.json
"system": {
  "test_mode": true  ← Dane symulowane (demo)
}
```

**Zmiana:**
1. Edytuj `firmware/data/config.json`
2. `test_mode: false`
3. Uruchom: `platformio run --target uploadfs`
4. Restart: `http://IP/api/reboot`

### Gatunek & Tace
- Zmień w WebUI → **Harmonogram** tab (dropdown)
- Lub: `POST /api/tray/set-species?tray=0&species=DUCK`

---

## 🔧 Porty GPIO

| Pin | Funkcja | Rola |
|-----|---------|------|
| GPIO1, GPIO2 | PWM Heater | Grzałki (LEDC 0, 1) |
| GPIO4, GPIO5, GPIO6, GPIO7 | OneWire | DS18B20 sensory |
| GPIO8 | Data | DHT22 (wilgotność) |
| GPIO9 | ADC | Water level |
| GPIO10 | GPIO | Door sensor |
| GPIO18, GPIO19, GPIO20 | GPIO | Tray motors |
| GPIO21, GPIO22, GPIO23 | GPIO | Diffusers (nawilżacze) |

## 📊 Monitorowanie

### Serial Port
```bash
platformio device monitor --port COM3 --baud 115200 --filter esp32_exception_decoder
```

### CSV Log
```bash
# Pobierz logi
curl http://192.168.1.100/api/log > inkubator_log.csv

# Format: time_sec, temp_chamber, temp_secondary, humidity, water_level, door, heater_pct
```

### JSON Endpoints
| Endpoint | Cel |
|----------|-----|
| `/api/status` | Status bieżący |
| `/api/history` | Dane do wykresu |
| `/api/config` | Konfiguracja |
| `/api/trays` | Stan tac |
| `/api/schedule?species=CHICKEN` | Harmonogram |

## 🆘 Troubleshooting

### ❌ Upload fails: "Failed to connect to COM3"
- Sprawdź czy device widoczny w Device Manager
- Zmień port w `platformio.ini`: `upload_port = COM4`
- Spróbuj: `esptool erase_flash` (wymaga GPIO0→GND)

### ❌ Serial garbage output
- Zmień `monitor_speed = 115200` (Check vs DevKit)
- Spróbuj: `platformio run --target monitor` (resetuje device)

### ❌ "Brak czujników" (test_mode=false)
- Sprawdź połączenie DS18B20 / DHT22
- Uruchom test_mode=true i obserwuj symulowane dane
- Sprawdź GPIO pins w Serial Monitor: `[SENSOR] DS18B20 #0 na GPIO6`

### ❌ WebUI się nie ładuje
- Sprawdź czy SPIFFS wgrany: `platformio run --target uploadfs`
- Sprawdź czy masz połączenie WiFi
- Otwórz DevTools (F12) i sprawdź Network tab

---

- [ ] Dyfuzory działają w trybie cyklicznym

2. **Wgranie rzeczywistych jaj**: Zmień test_mode=false, ustaw gatunek
3. **Monitoring**: Obserwuj WebUI co 2-4 godziny
4. **Logi**: Pobierz CSV logi dla analizy po zakończeniu inkubacji

  // Diffusers
  if (doc.containsKey("diffusers")) {
    JsonObject d = doc["diffusers"];
    cfg.diffusers.count = constrain(d["count"] | cfg.diffusers.count, 0, MAX_DIFFUSERS);
    cfg.diffusers.on_time_sec = d["on_time_sec"] | cfg.diffusers.on_time_sec;
    cfg.diffusers.off_time_sec = d["off_time_sec"] | cfg.diffusers.off_time_sec;

    if (d.containsKey("pins")) {
      JsonArray p = d["pins"];
      for (int i = 0; i < MAX_DIFFUSERS && i < (int)p.size(); i++)
        cfg.diffusers.pins[i] = p[i];
    }
    if (d.containsKey("labels")) {
      JsonArray l = d["labels"];
      for (int i = 0; i < MAX_DIFFUSERS && i < (int)l.size(); i++)
        strlcpy(cfg.diffusers.labels[i], l[i].as<const char*>(), 20);
    }
  }

  // System
  if (doc.containsKey("system")) {
    JsonObject sys = doc["system"];
    cfg.system.test_mode = sys["test_mode"] | cfg.system.test_mode;
    cfg.system.fan_pin = sys["fan_pin"] | cfg.system.fan_pin;
    cfg.system.heater_pin_1 = sys["heater_pin_1"] | cfg.system.heater_pin_1;
    cfg.system.heater_pin_2 = sys["heater_pin_2"] | cfg.system.heater_pin_2;
    cfg.system.target_temp = sys["target_temp"] | cfg.system.target_temp;
    cfg.system.log_interval_sec = sys["log_interval_sec"] | cfg.system.log_interval_sec;
  }

  return true;
}

// config_manager.cpp
#include "config_manager.h"
#include <Arduino.h>
#include <SPIFFS.h>
#include <Preferences.h>
#include <ArduinoJson.h>

// ============================================================================
// Implementacja metod ConfigManager
// ============================================================================

bool ConfigManager::load_spiffs() {
  if (!SPIFFS.exists(CONFIG_PATH)) return false;

  File f = SPIFFS.open(CONFIG_PATH, "r");
  if (!f) return false;

  String json = f.readString();
  f.close();

  if (json.length() < 50) return false;

  return from_json(json);
}

bool ConfigManager::save_spiffs() {
  File f = SPIFFS.open(CONFIG_PATH, "w");
  if (!f) {
    Serial.println("[CFG] Błąd zapisu SPIFFS!");
    return false;
  }

  String json = to_json();
  f.print(json);
  f.close();

  Serial.printf("[CFG] Zapisano do SPIFFS (%d bajtów)\n", json.length());
  return true;
}

void ConfigManager::save_preferences() {
  pref.begin(PREF_NAMESPACE, false);
  String json = to_json();

  pref.putString(PREF_KEY_CFG, json);

  // Prosty CRC do weryfikacji
  uint16_t crc = 0;
  for (size_t i = 0; i < json.length(); i++) {
    crc += (uint8_t)json[i];
  }
  pref.putUShort(PREF_KEY_CRC, crc);

  pref.end();
  Serial.println("[CFG] Backup zapisany w Preferences");
}

bool ConfigManager::load_preferences() {
  pref.begin(PREF_NAMESPACE, true);

  if (!pref.isKey(PREF_KEY_CFG)) {
    pref.end();
    return false;
  }

  String json = pref.getString(PREF_KEY_CFG, "");
  uint16_t saved_crc = pref.getUShort(PREF_KEY_CRC, 0);
  pref.end();

  if (json.length() == 0) return false;

  // Weryfikacja CRC
  uint16_t crc = 0;
  for (size_t i = 0; i < json.length(); i++) {
    crc += (uint8_t)json[i];
  }

  if (crc != saved_crc) {
    Serial.println("[CFG] CRC mismatch w Preferences – odrzucam backup");
    return false;
  }

  return from_json(json);
}

// ============================================================================
// JSON Serialization / Deserialization
// ============================================================================

String ConfigManager::to_json() {
  DynamicJsonDocument doc(8192);

  doc["config_version"] = cfg.config_version;
  doc["tray_count"] = cfg.tray_count;

  JsonArray trays = doc.createNestedArray("trays");
  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_TRAYS; i++) {
    JsonObject t = trays.createNestedObject();
    t["active"] = cfg.trays[i].active;
    t["species"] = cfg.trays[i].species;
    t["start_day_offset"] = cfg.trays[i].start_day_offset;
    t["pin"] = cfg.trays[i].pin;
    t["label"] = cfg.trays[i].label;
  }

  // Sensors
  JsonObject sensors = doc.createNestedObject("sensors");
  sensors["ds18b20_count"] = cfg.sensors.ds18b20_count;
  JsonArray ds_pins = sensors.createNestedArray("ds18b20_pins");
  JsonArray ds_labels = sensors.createNestedArray("ds18b20_labels");
  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SENSORS; i++) {
    ds_pins.add(cfg.sensors.ds18b20_pins[i]);
    ds_labels.add(cfg.sensors.ds18b20_labels[i]);
  }
  sensors["dht22_enabled"] = cfg.sensors.dht22_enabled;
  sensors["dht22_pin"] = cfg.sensors.dht22_pin;
  sensors["water_level_enabled"] = cfg.sensors.water_level_enabled;
  sensors["water_level_pin"] = cfg.sensors.water_level_pin;
  sensors["door_sensor_enabled"] = cfg.sensors.door_sensor_enabled;
  sensors["door_sensor_pin"] = cfg.sensors.door_sensor_pin;
  sensors["aquarium_sensor_index"] = cfg.sensors.aquarium_sensor_index;
  sensors["aquarium_target_temp"] = cfg.sensors.aquarium_target_temp;

  // Diffusers
  JsonObject diffusers = doc.createNestedObject("diffusers");
  diffusers["count"] = cfg.diffusers.count;
  diffusers["on_time_sec"] = cfg.diffusers.on_time_sec;
  diffusers["off_time_sec"] = cfg.diffusers.off_time_sec;
  JsonArray d_pins = diffusers.createNestedArray("pins");
  JsonArray d_labels = diffusers.createNestedArray("labels");
  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_DIFFUSERS; i++) {
    d_pins.add(cfg.diffusers.pins[i]);
    d_labels.add(cfg.diffusers.labels[i]);
  }

  // System
  JsonObject system = doc.createNestedObject("system");
  system["test_mode"] = cfg.system.test_mode;
  system["fan_pin"] = cfg.system.fan_pin;
  system["heater_pin_1"] = cfg.system.heater_pin_1;
  system["heater_pin_2"] = cfg.system.heater_pin_2;
  system["target_temp"] = cfg.system.target_temp;
  system["log_interval_sec"] = cfg.system.log_interval_sec;

  String output;
  serializeJson(doc, output);
  return output;
}

// config_manager.cpp
#include "config_manager.h"
#include <Arduino.h>
#include <SPIFFS.h>
#include <Preferences.h>
#include <ArduinoJson.h>

// ============================================================================
// Implementacja metod ConfigManager
// ============================================================================

bool ConfigManager::load_spiffs() {
  if (!SPIFFS.exists(CONFIG_PATH)) return false;

  File f = SPIFFS.open(CONFIG_PATH, "r");
  if (!f) return false;

  String json = f.readString();
  f.close();

  if (json.length() < 50) return false;

  return from_json(json);
}

bool ConfigManager::save_spiffs() {
  File f = SPIFFS.open(CONFIG_PATH, "w");
  if (!f) {
    Serial.println("[CFG] Błąd zapisu SPIFFS!");
    return false;
  }

  String json = to_json();
  f.print(json);
  f.close();

  Serial.printf("[CFG] Zapisano do SPIFFS (%d bajtów)\n", json.length());
  return true;
}

void ConfigManager::save_preferences() {
  pref.begin(PREF_NAMESPACE, false);
  String json = to_json();

  pref.putString(PREF_KEY_CFG, json);

  // Prosty CRC do weryfikacji
  uint16_t crc = 0;
  for (size_t i = 0; i < json.length(); i++) {
    crc += (uint8_t)json[i];
  }
  pref.putUShort(PREF_KEY_CRC, crc);

  pref.end();
  Serial.println("[CFG] Backup zapisany w Preferences");
}

bool ConfigManager::load_preferences() {
  pref.begin(PREF_NAMESPACE, true);

  if (!pref.isKey(PREF_KEY_CFG)) {
    pref.end();
    return false;
  }

  String json = pref.getString(PREF_KEY_CFG, "");
  uint16_t saved_crc = pref.getUShort(PREF_KEY_CRC, 0);
  pref.end();

  if (json.length() == 0) return false;

  // Weryfikacja CRC
  uint16_t crc = 0;
  for (size_t i = 0; i < json.length(); i++) {
    crc += (uint8_t)json[i];
  }

  if (crc != saved_crc) {
    Serial.println("[CFG] CRC mismatch w Preferences – odrzucam backup");
    return false;
  }

  return from_json(json);
}

6. Wklej ścieżkę sterownika:
   ```

```

```

void wifi_keepalive() {
  static unsigned long last = 0;
  if (millis() - last < 30000) return;
  last = millis();

  if (WiFi.status() != WL_CONNECTED) {
    if (wifi_connected) {
      Serial.println("[WiFi] Rozlaczono - reconnect...");
      wifi_connected = false;
    }
    WiFi.reconnect();
  } else if (!wifi_connected) {
    wifi_connected = true;
    Serial.printf("[WiFi] Polaczono! IP: %s\n", WiFi.localIP().toString().c_str());
    webserver_setup();
  }
}
```

Mam bazę wiedzy o sterownikach USB dla ESP32-S3. Oto alternatywne opcje:

## **1. FTDI (Future Technology Devices International)**

### FT232H / FT2232H (JTAG + UART)
- **Sterownik**: FTDI D2XX lub VCP (Virtual COM Port)
- **Download**: https://ftdichip.com/drivers/
- **Modele dla ESP32-S3**:
  - `FT2232H` - najpopularniejszy (2x kanały: JTAG + UART)
  - `FT232H` - kanał pojedynczy  
  - `FT2232HPQ/FT233HPQ` - nowsze wersje
- **Windows**: Autorski FTDI driver VCP (D2XX)

---

## **2. WCH (Nanjing QinhengMicroelectronics)**

### CH340/CH341 (UART)
- **Pobieranie**: https://github.com/WCHSoftware/ch340/releases
- **GitHub releases**: Sterowniki Windows (.exe, .zip)
- **Alternatywa**: https://wch.cn/product/download.html (oficjalny portal WCH)
- **Cechy**: 
  - Très tani (~$0.30)
  - Dobre dla UART/serial, NIE dla JTAG
  - Popularne na płytach Arduino clone'ów

### CH9102F (nowszy)
- Następca CH340
- Również od WCH
- GitHub: WCHSoftware/usb-serial-ch9102f

---

- **Cechy**: 
  - Stary standard (wspierany szeroko)
  - Problemy z Windows 10/11 z powodu zabezpieczeń
  - Lepiej: aktualne niż PL2303HX (PL2303RA)

Pinout: D+ / D- (GPIO 19/20)

- Dokumentacja: [ESP32-S3 USB-Serial-JTAG](https://docs.espressif.com/projects/esp-idf/en/latest/esp32s3/api-guides/jtag-debugging/configure-builtin-jtag.html)
